CHINA PRESS.
AUG 22 1939

Rice Market

The market of white rice was reopened yesterday, after suspension of business for the past three days, the selling price, however, was irregularly higher for purchases, or $6 above the last final rate. The market has received 3,000 bags of fresh rice supplies from the growing centers in the interior coming by truck and rail and another 40 junkloads of white rice were brought here by steamer.

Owing to a brisk demand shown by local dealers and retail shops, the selling price in the session was raised by the rice holders, who kept their rice in the godowns awaiting further development. According to the market record, the first-grade white rice was quoted at $39 per picul, the second-grade of Soochow rice stood at from $35 to $37, and even low-grade white rice was sold at $23 per picul.

Business in provincial rice was firm while a large demand was seen as all the local dealers asked for further supplies. The rice holders, however refused to show their rice samples and only a few offered their rice for sale. Wuhu rice was noted at $33 per picul, or $4 high compared with the last Friday's closing rate. The total sales in the day were estimated at 4,000 bags of different kinds of provincial rice.

The opening rate of Saigon rice was quoted at $46 per bags of 220 lbs, but no business was done. In the later session, the rate fell by $2, with an official rate of $38. As a result, 200 bags of this rice were sold during the entire session.
page_data.zh:
23864
《字林西报》。
1939年8月22日

大米市场

白米市场在暂停营业三天后于昨日重新开市，然而买入价格不规则地上涨，比最后成交价高出6美元。市场收到了来自内地产粮区通过卡车和铁路运来的3,000袋新鲜大米供应，另有40船白米由轮船运抵此处。

由于本地商行和零售店表现出旺盛的需求，持有大米的商人提高了售价，他们将大米存放在仓库中等待事态进一步发展。根据市场记录，一级白米报价为每担39美元，二级苏州米价格在35至37美元之间，甚至低级白米也以每担23美元售出。

外省大米交易坚挺，由于所有本地商人都要求进一步供货，需求量大增。然而，持米者拒绝展示大米样品，只有少数人提供大米出售。芜湖米 noted 为每担33美元，比上周五收盘价高出4美元。当日各类外省大米的总销量估计为4,000袋。

西贡米的开盘价报价为每220磅装46美元，但未达成交易。在后市交易中，价格下跌2美元，官方价格为38美元。因此，整个交易期间售出了200袋此种大米。

page_data.en:
23826
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS
AUG 21 1939

The Rice Shortage
That the rice situation in Shanghai is serious there can be no gainsaying, and the municipal authorities are doing everything in their power to bring about an improvement. Attempts have been made in some quarters to blame the Shanghai Municipal Council for the shortage, but investigation does not support this view of the matter. With exchange as it is at the present moment, it is impossible for the Council to run the risk of very serious losses by purchasing rice to remedy the situation. As a matter of fact the main supply of rice comes from the hinterland which is under Japanese occupation, and what would normally be a daily supply of some 10,000 bags coming from those areas has now dwindled to some 2,000 per diem, or one-fifth of Shanghai's normal consumption. The difficulty of dealing with the matter is increased by the fact that certain unscrupulous rice merchants are undoubtedly hoarding the grain, for the purpose of profiteering. It would seem that at the moment there is sufficient rice in Shanghai to cover the need for the next three or four weeks, and that unless larger supplies are forthcoming from the interior the situation is likely to become very serious. There is nothing whatever to suggest that the Japanese authorities are wantonly holding up the rice supplies which should reach the port from the territories occupied by them, and that whatever difficulty there is in arranging a smooth flow of supplies here arises rather from an incomplete appreciation of the seriousness of the position. It may be, as is suggested in some quarters, that the Japanese are accumulating large stores of foodstuffs against possible emergencies in North China or Manchoukuo, but it is believed that this could still be done without diverting the supplies which should normally come to Shanghai. It is to be hoped that as a result of representations which are being made to the Japanese authorities they will be prevailed upon to permit full supplies reaching Shanghai from the interior. There is no justification whatever for certain Japanese and Chinese newspapers to attempt to lay the blame for what is occurring upon the Municipal Council which is doing all it can in the circumstances, and it is fully realized that with the expected co-operation of the Japanese authorities the present serious situation may quickly be eliminated.

Liu
Col
page_data.zh:
23826
《华北每日新闻》
1939年8月21日

大米短缺

上海的大米形势严峻，这一点无可否认，市政当局正在尽其所能促使局势改善。某些方面试图将短缺归咎于上海公共租界工部局，但调查并不支持这一观点。鉴于目前的汇率情况，工部局不可能冒着遭受严重损失的风险购买大米来补救局势。事实上，大米的主要供应来自被日本占领的内陆地区，通常每天从这些地区运来的约10,000袋大米，现在已减少到每天约2,000袋，即上海正常消费量的五分之一。某些无良米商无疑为了牟取暴利而囤积粮食，这一事实增加了处理该问题的难度。似乎目前上海有足够的大米满足未来三四周的需求，除非内地有更多供应到来，否则局势可能会变得非常严峻。没有任何迹象表明日本当局在故意扣留应从其占领领土运抵港口的米粮，这里安排供应顺畅流动的任何困难，更多是由于对局势严重性认识不足所致。正如某些方面所暗示的那样，日本人可能正在为华北或满洲国可能发生的紧急情况积累大量食品储备，但据信这仍然可以在不转移本应正常运往上海的供应的情况下完成。希望通过对日本当局进行的交涉，能说服他们允许内地的全部供应运抵上海。某些中日报纸试图将正在发生的事情归咎于工部局是毫无道理的，工部局在现有情况下已尽其所能，人们充分认识到，在日本当局预期的合作下，目前的严峻局势可以迅速消除。

刘
上校

page_data.en:
August 20, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Hwa Pao, Chinese-American Daily News,
Central China Daily News:

BANKS NOT HOARDING RICE

The godowns and warehouses of various local
banks are used for the storage of goods belonging to the
clients of the banks. Rice is also being stored.
Recently the authorities of the Foreign Settlements
conducted a close investigation into the quantity and the
names of the owners of the rice stored in godowns, while
banks have submitted reports showing that they have not had
any transactions in rice. The report that banks are
hoarding rice is absolutely untrue.
In view of the serious rice situation in Shanghai,
Mr. Yu Ya-ching, in co-operation with various public bodies
and people, has raised funds to order 18,000 bags of
Saigon rice to alleviate the situation, 10,000 bags being
ordered in the name of the Shanghai Refugee Relief
Association and 8,000 bags in the name of various public
bodies. This rice will arrive at Shanghai on September 8.
It is said that the 8,000 bags of Saigon rice will be
sold at a cheap rice.
With a view to maintaining the food supplies of
the people, the authorities of the Foreign Settlements are
adopting measures to regulate the supplies of rice. At
present they have no intention to order rice from abroad.
According to foreign newspapers, the S.M.C.
and the Japanese authorities are discussing facilities to
be given the transportation of rice to Shanghai.
The report that the S.M.C. will order Saigon rice
is untrue. Enquiries made yesterday morning show that
the transportation of rice to Shanghai has been encountering
many difficulties.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月20日。
晨间翻译。

《申报》、《新闻报》、《华报》、《中美日报》、
《华中日报》：

银行未囤积大米

本地各家银行的堆栈和仓库用于存放属于银行客户的货物。大米也在其中储存。
最近，外国租界当局对堆栈中储存的大米数量及所有者姓名进行了严密调查，而银行提交的报告显示它们未参与任何大米交易。关于银行囤积大米的报道绝对不实。
鉴于上海严峻的大米形势，虞洽卿先生与各公共团体及人士合作，筹集资金订购了18,000袋西贡米以缓解局势，其中以“上海难民救济协会”名义订购10,000袋，以各公共团体名义订购8,000袋。这批大米将于9月8日抵达上海。
据悉，这8,000袋西贡米将以平价米出售。
为了维持民众的食品供应，外国租界当局正在采取措施调节大米供应。目前他们无意从国外订购大米。
据外文报纸报道，上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）和日本当局正在讨论为运往上海的大米运输提供便利。
关于工部局将订购西贡米的报道不实。昨日早晨的查询显示，向上海运输大米一直遇到许多困难。

24751

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & NEWS,

AUG 20 1939

Council Seeks Entry of
Rice to Shanghai

Reports have appeared in the
press that the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Council has placed an
order for the purchase of rice
from Saigon. Such reports are
not correct. Thorough in-
vestigation into the matter has
led to the conclusion that the
only practicable solution of
this rice problem rests in the
free entry of rice into Shang-
hai from the hinterland. For
some time past rice has not
been coming freely into
Shanghai, and it has only been
coming in at a rate that is about
one-fifth of Shanghai's normal
consumption, with the result
that the stock of rice in
Shanghai has been greatly
depleted. Negotiations are going
on with the Japanese authori-
ties with the object of facilitat-
ing the entry of rice into
Shanghai.

Liu
C 90%
page_data.zh:
24751

《上海晚邮报与新闻》，

1939年8月20日

工部局寻求大米
进入上海

新闻界出现报道，称上海公共租界工部局已下令从西贡购买大米。此类报道不正确。对此事的彻底调查得出的结论是，解决这一大米问题的唯一可行办法在于让大米从内地自由进入上海。过去一段时间，大米未能自由进入上海，其入境量仅约为上海正常消费量的五分之一，导致上海的大米库存大幅耗尽。目前正在与日本当局进行谈判，目的是促进大米进入上海。

刘
C 90%

AUG 20 1939

Council Is Not Intending
To Buy Saigon Rice

Local Situation Is Admittedly Serious, But Only
Practicable Solution Is Free Entry Into City
From Hinterland; Several Small Shops Close

The extremely serious and
potentially dangerous situation so
far as the city's rice supplies are
concerned showed no signs of im-
provement yesterday. Investigations
among the rice guilds revealed the
fact that the present supply in
Shanghai is less than 100,000 bags
and very little rice is finding its
way here from the interior. The
bean and rice markets remained
closed yesterday and several small
rice shops, unable to obtain sup-
plies, closed their doors.

There have been repeated rum-
ours in Shanghai that the Shanghai
Municipal Council intended coming
to the rescue by the purchase of
rice from Saigon, but it was offi-
cially ascertained from the Council
that such reports were incorrect.

The Council has made a thorough
investigation of the local rice situa-
tion and has come to the conclu-
sion that the only practicable solu-
tion of this problem rests in the
free entry of rice into Shanghai
from the hinterland.

For some time past, it was stated,
rice has not been coming freely in-
to Shanghai, and it has only been
coming in at a rate that is about
one-fifth of Shanghai's normal con-
sumption, with the result that the
stock of rice in Shanghai has been
depleted.

Seek Free Entry

Negotiations are now going on
with the Japanese authorities with
the object of facilitating the entry
of rice into Shanghai, it was learnt
from the Shanghai Municipal Coun-
cil yesterday.

It was ascertained in local rice
circles that the available rice stocks
to be had and now held by the big
rice operators, excluding the
amount held by retail rice shops,
was less than 100,000 bags. Ship-
ments from the inland to Shanghai
were only in very small quantities
and less than than 3,000 bags of
Nanking and Changshu cereals
reached the city yesterday morning
morning by rail, steamers and
junks.

However, a shipment of 18,000
bags of Saigon rice has been order-
ed by members of the Shanghai
Chinese Rice Merchants' Guild, but
this is not expected to be deliver-
ed before September 1.

No official quotations for rice
were available yesterday as the
market was closed following a re-
cent decision of merchants not to
operate on the market for three
days.

1939年8月20日

工部局无意
购买西贡米

承认本地形势严峻，但唯一
可行的解决方案是从内地自由进入城市；几家小店关门

就城市大米供应而言，极其严峻且具有潜在危险的形势在昨日未见改善迹象。对米业公会的调查显示，上海目前的供应量少于100,000袋，且很少有大米从内地运抵此处。豆市和米市昨日继续休市，几家因无法获得供应的小米店关闭了大门。

上海屡有传言称，上海公共租界工部局打算通过从西贡购买大米来进行救援，但从工部局官方获悉，此类报道不实。

工部局对本地大米形势进行了彻底调查，并得出结论，解决这一问题的唯一可行办法在于让大米从内地自由进入上海。

据称，过去一段时间，大米未能自由进入上海，其入境量仅约为上海正常消费量的五分之一，导致上海的大米库存耗尽。

寻求自由入境

据昨日从上海公共租界工部局获悉，目前正在与日本当局进行谈判，目的是促进大米进入上海。

从本地米圈获悉，大型米商持有的可用大米库存（不包括零售米店持有的数量）少于100,000袋。从内陆运往上海的货物数量极少，昨日早晨通过铁路、轮船和驳船运抵城市的南京和常熟谷物不足3,000袋。

然而，上海华人米业公会成员已订购了18,000袋西贡米，但预计在9月1日之前不会交付。

昨日没有官方大米报价，因为市场遵循商人最近做出的不在市场运营三天的决定而关闭。

CHINA PRESS.
AUG 20 1939
Flour And Wheat
During the period of the rice shortage
the various Chinese flour mills supplied
a large amount of ready flour to
be sold in the market for public relief.
The selling price remained unchanged at
$6 a cash for second-grade product. Most
of the rice retail shops purchased native
flour instead of rice. The selling price
in the retail shops was $6.20 per bag.
Although a brisk demand of further
flour was shown by outport dealers, the
mills refused to accept any order from
North China and South Sea dealers, even
when offered a good price. No
business for outport dealers was recorded
therefore in the entire trading session.
Business in native wheat was quite and
featureless in yesterday's market. The
selling price was high. The market has
received a large amount of fresh supplies
of wheat from the growing centers in the
interior, and the market rate increased
by $0.15, above the previous close. Both
the Fooh Sing and Fou Foong Flour Mills
asked 20 carloads of wheat, and local
dealers bought another 10 carloads of
Soochow and Wusih wheat. The best
newly-harvested wheat was quoted at $8.45
and low-grade sold at $8.80 per bag.

《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）。
1939年8月20日
面粉与小麦
在大米短缺期间，各家华资面粉厂向市场供应了大量成品面粉，用于公众救济。二等产品的售价保持在每袋6元不变。大多数米零售店购买国产面粉而非大米。零售店的售价为每袋6.20元。尽管外埠商人表现出对更多面粉的旺盛需求，但即使出价优厚，各面粉厂也拒绝接受来自华北和南洋商人的任何订单。因此，在整个交易时段内，没有记录到任何外埠商人的业务。昨日市场上国产小麦的交易平淡无奇。售价高昂。市场收到了来自内地产区的大量新鲜小麦供应，市场价格较前一交易日收盘价上涨了0.15元。福新（Fooh Sing）和阜丰（Fou Foong）面粉厂均求购20车皮小麦，本地商人又购买了10车皮苏州和无锡小麦。最好的新收小麦报价为每袋8.45元，低等级小麦售价为每袋8.80元。

page_data.en:
28706
SHANGHAI TIMES.
AUG 19 1939
Rice Position
In Shanghai
Now Serious
Only Ten Days' Supply
Is Available Locally,
Checkup Reveals
PRICE REACHES NEW
PEAK FOR CITY
Council Considers Scheme
For Relief, But Little
Hope Seen Of Success
News gathered from most
reliable sources yesterday
revealed that Shanghai is
facing an extremely serious
situation in the matter of rice
supplies. At the present there
are stocks within the Settlement and Concession for a
further 10 days' supply, and
unless further rice comes in
before the expiration of that
time the closure of many rice
shops is expected.
At this time of the year it is
usual for large quantities of rice to
reach Shanghai from the surrounding countryside but, owing to many
factors and to prevailing conditions,
those supplies are not being received.
The Food Supply Committee of
the Shanghai Municipal Council
have held meetings to consider the
situation and it is still hoped that
before the situation becomes too
critical rice will come to hand. The
question of buying rice from Saigon has been examined, but, owing
to its relatively low quality and
the very high price at which it
would have to be sold at prevailing rates of exchange, it has been
decided to delay action until it is
positively certain that local supply
will not be forthcoming.
But, presuming it is decided to
take action similar to that which
was taken after the outbreak of
hostilities here in 1937, there will
be a gap of more than a week between the enforced closing of rice
shops and the arrival of the Saigon
grain.
（批：Liu 6/8）
page_data.zh:
28706
《上海泰晤士报》（SHANGHAI TIMES）。
1939年8月19日
上海大米形势
现已严峻
调查显示
本地仅存十天供应量
价格创本市新高
工部局考虑救济方案，
但成功希望渺茫
昨日从最可靠渠道收集到的消息显示，上海在大米供应方面正面临极其严峻的局势。目前，公共租界和法租界内的库存仅够再供应10天，除非在该期限届满前有更多大米运入，否则预计许多米店将被迫关闭。
每年的这个时候，通常会有大量大米从周边乡村运抵上海，但由于多种因素和当前状况，这些供应并未到位。
上海公共租界工部局的粮食供应委员会已举行会议审议局势，人们仍希望在局势变得过于危急之前能有大米到手。从西贡购买大米的问题已得到审查，但由于其质量相对较低，且按现行汇率计算售价极高，因此决定推迟行动，直到确实确定本地供应无法到位为止。
但是，假如决定采取类似于1937年此地战事爆发后所采取的行动，那么在米店被迫关闭与西贡粮食运抵之间，将出现超过一周的空档期。
（批注：Liu 6/8）

page_data.en:
High Prices Yesterday
The price of rice yesterday between dealers was $28 per bag, which means that the price to the public was something over $30. The price of imported rice would be at least $8 or $9 more for a similar quantity--a price which would visit tremendous hardship on the vast majority of Shanghai's Chinese population.
In view of the rather serious situation, both the Shanghai Municipal Council and the French Municipal Administration are understood to have given the matter their very close attention, as the problem is bound up intimately with the question of public peace and order.
At the present only a little more than 2,000 bags of rice daily find their way into the two foreign municipal areas, or about one-fifth the quantity required to meet the city's normal daily consumption.
Reports Denied
Reports that Council had decided to purchase 100,000 bags of Saigon rice to relieve the local situation was said by reliable sources yesterday to be incorrect. Such a suggestion had been made by responsible members of the Shanghai Chinese Rice Merchants Guild to the Council, but it appears that no action would be taken in this direction. The matter came up for discussion in Council last Wednesday, but Chinese members of the Council definitely decided against adopting this plan.
If Council were to take action similar to that taken shortly after the outbreak of the local hostilities in 1937, by importing rice on its own account, it would prove a heavy drain upon its financial resources, reliable source stated yesterday. But more important than mere question of finance, such a plan would merely be a palliative and not provide a fundamental solution to the present urgent problem.
Millions Needed
When discussions took place in Council last Wednesday, it was calculated, on the basis of the prevailing foreign exchange, that at least $3 million would be required to ship into Shanghai 100,000 bags of Saigon rice. On top of that the costs of freight and insurance would have to be met. Decidedly the Council must sell to the general public at the price of C$20 (the official rate) per zar, and since each zar of Saigon rice would cost C$30, the Council would have to foot a loss of C$10 on each zar of rice. This would entail a clear daily loss of about $115,000, if the Council were to ensure a supply of 10,000 bags of rice to meet the local daily normal consumption.
The plan, therefore, has been shelved for the time being.
A fundamental solution would be to ensure the free entry of rice from the inland areas.
Market Confusion
In view of the great confusion reigning in the rice market, it is now decided by the Control Committee of the rice and bean markets that the unofficial open market transactions be suspended for two days, beginning from yesterday. As usual there will be no transactions on Sunday.
The usual transactions are expected to be resumed by Monday. The reason for the suspension was declared to be to enable certain "readjustments" in the market to be made.
page_data.zh:
昨日高价
昨日商人之间的大米交易价格为每袋28元，这意味着面向公众的价格超过30元。进口大米同等数量的价格至少要高出8或9美元——这一价格将使上海绝大多数中国民众遭受巨大的苦难。
鉴于局势相当严峻，据悉上海公共租界工部局和法国公董局均已对此事给予密切关注，因为该问题与公共和平秩序问题密切相关。
目前，每天进入两个外国市政区域的大米仅略多于2,000袋，约占满足城市正常日常消费量所需的五分之一。
否认传闻
据可靠消息来源昨日称，有关工部局决定购买10万袋西贡大米以缓解本地局势的报道不实。上海华人米业公会的一些负责人曾向工部局提出过此类建议，但看来不会在此方向上采取行动。此事上周三在工部局会议上进行了讨论，但工部局华员明确决定不采纳此计划。
可靠消息来源昨日表示，如果工部局采取类似于1937年本地战事爆发后不久所采取的行动，即自行进口大米，这将对其财政资源造成沉重负担。但比单纯的财务问题更重要的是，这样的计划仅仅是权宜之计，并不能为当前紧迫的问题提供根本解决方案。
需资数百万
上周三工部局进行讨论时，根据现行外汇汇率计算，将10万袋西贡大米运入上海至少需要300万美元。此外，还必须支付运费和保险费。工部局必须按每担20元中国货币（官方汇率）的价格向公众出售，而由于每担西贡大米的成本为30元中国货币，工部局必须在每担大米上承担10元中国货币的亏损。如果工部局要确保供应1万袋大米以满足本地每日正常消费，这将导致每天约11.5万美元的净亏损。
因此，该计划暂时被搁置。
根本的解决方案是确保内地大米自由进入。
市场混乱
鉴于大米市场存在极大混乱，米豆市场管制委员会现决定，从昨天起暂停非官方公开市场交易两天。像往常一样，周日不进行交易。
预计常规交易将于周一恢复。宣布暂停交易的原因是为了使市场能够进行某些“调整”。

CHINA PRESS.
AUG 19 1939
Rice Supply
Here Said To
Last 10 Days
Market To Be Closed
3 Days As Price
Hits New High
Rice supply in Shanghai can last
only ten days, THE CHINA PRESS
was informed yesterday. The
Shanghai Municipal Council, which
has been rumored intermittently to
have placed orders for 100,000 bags
of foreign rice, has not done so,
according to the same report.
For the first time in the city's
history the rice market closed yes-
terday for a three-day period. This
action was taken when prices of
first quality rice reached a record
breaking high of $32.50 a picul on
Thursday's market. Even low
grade cereal was quoted at $29.
Hungry mutterings as little
groups of coolies gathered outside
empty rice shops were silenced only
by the "keep moving" tactics of
reinforced police squads.
In the meantime, the Municipal
Council continued to consider the
situation from every angle. A new
rumor circulated that the Japan-
ese ban on rice export from the
nearby growing centers might be
lifted; if the Council took no steps
toward purchasing foreign rice.
The rumor could not be confirmed
and the Japanese military to
whom representations were made
by the Council last week continu-
ed its unbroken silence.
One foreign grain expert declar-
ed bitterly that no satisfaction
would be forthcoming from the
Japanese until their apparent
mastery of the present situation
was openly challenged.
The situation which has been
steadily worsening during the past
few weeks is evidently the result of
a definite Japanese blockade
whether intentional or not. The
problem has only become clear with
the rapidity of the past few days'
denouement.
page_data.zh:
23679
《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）。
1939年8月19日
据悉上海
大米供应
仅够维持十天
价格创新高
市场将关闭三天
《字林西报》昨日获悉，上海的大米供应仅能维持十天。据同一报道，传闻间歇性出现的上海公共租界工部局已订购10万袋外国大米一事，并未发生。
该市历史上首次，大米市场于昨日关闭，为期三天。当周四市场上优质大米价格达到创纪录的每担32.50元高位时，采取了这一行动。即使是低等级谷物，报价也达29元。
当一小群苦力聚集在空荡荡的米店外发出饥饿的低语时，只有靠增派警察分队采取“保持移动”的策略才使其平息。
与此同时，工部局继续从各个角度审议局势。一个新的谣言流传开来，称如果工部局不采取购买外国大米的步骤，日本可能会解除对附近产区大米出口的禁令。该谣言无法得到证实，工部局上周向其提出交涉的日本军方继续保持沉默。
一位外国粮食专家愤慨地表示，除非公然挑战日本对当前局势的明显掌控，否则从日本人那里得不到任何满意的结果。
过去几周不断恶化的局势显然是日本实施封锁的结果，无论其是否有意为之。随着过去几天事态的迅速展开，这一问题才变得清晰起来。

23668
CHINA PRESS
AUG 19
Rice Market
On account of the record price of white
rice in Shanghai, the market has been
closed for three days. Within those days,
both authorities of Shanghai Municipal
Council and the Executive Committees of
Rice and Bean Guilds will hold several
meetings to discuss the new maximum
price. The market, however will be
reopened on next Monday.

23668
《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）
8月19日
大米市场
由于上海白米价格创纪录，市场已关闭三天。在此期间，上海公共租界工部局当局和米豆业公会执行委员会将举行多次会议，讨论新的最高限价。然而，市场将于下周一重新开放。

page_data.en:
Shanghai Daily News (上海日報), a mosquito paper, publishes
the following article without any headings-

Of late, this paper has been publishing
articles exposing the profiteering in rice and dissemination
of false reports by dishonest rice dealers. In consequence
and also as a result of wide publicity by other circles, the
matter has attracted the attention of the public who are
unanimously denouncing these dishonest rice dealers.
Yesterday the "Sin Wan Pao" still accepted
the misleading news reports supplied by the "Sing Sung News
Agency" (新声社), but it paid attention to the wording
of such news reports. Henceforth rice dealers will not be
able to deceive the public by false propaganda.
The authorities of the Foreign Settlements
have already drawn up and will enforce positive measures
regarding the stabilisation of the market price of rice and
the source of supply. The purchase of foreign rice has been
vetoed by the Food Control Committee.

Moreover, new crops have of late appeared on
the market, while rice boats are arriving in large numbers.
The selling price of rice has been falling. Nevertheless,
in view of the trickery of the rice dealers, we must watch
them closely lest they should do anything to disturb the
market.
This paper is willing to publish anything
discovered by the people. Besides, the action of banking
circles in accepting mortgages on large quantities of rice
should be immediately stopped so as to put an end to the
activities of speculators and to avoid trouble on the rice
market. For instance, the action of the Kincheng Banking
Corporation and the National Commercial Bank in hoarding
large quantities of Chinese rice is denounced by this
paper and they will certainly be hated by the people.
The National Commercial Bank has sent to this paper a letter
in connection with the matter, but it contains no denial
as to the huge quantity of rice that is being hoarded.
This shows that in the event of banking circles continuing
to accept mortgages on rice, the food supplies of the
people will be affected.
It is learned that there are certain persons
managing these activities.
This paper is collecting evidence for publication
with a view to enabling the public to understand who the
principal offenders are. The matter will be completely
exposed to the public in a few days.
page_data.zh:
《上海日报》（Shanghai Daily News），一家小型报刊，刊登了以下无标题文章——

近期，本报一直刊登文章，揭露不法米商在大米交易中牟取暴利及散布虚假报告的行为。因此，加之其他各界的广泛宣传，此事已引起公众关注，公众一致谴责这些不法米商。
昨日，《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）仍然接受了由“新声社”（Sing Sung News Agency）提供的误导性新闻报道，但它注意了此类新闻报道的措辞。今后，米商将无法通过虚假宣传欺骗公众。
租界当局已经制定并将执行关于稳定大米市场价格和供应来源的积极措施。粮食管制委员会已否决购买外国大米的提议。

此外，近期新粮已上市，运米船只也正大量抵达。大米售价正在下跌。然而，鉴于米商的欺诈手段，我们必须密切监视他们，以防他们做出扰乱市场的行为。
本报愿意刊登民众发现的任何情况。此外，银行界接受大量大米抵押贷款的行为应立即停止，以便终结投机者的活动，避免大米市场出现麻烦。例如，金城银行（Kincheng Banking Corporation）和中国国货银行（National Commercial Bank）囤积大量国产大米的行为受到本报谴责，它们必将遭到民众的憎恨。中国国货银行已就此事项致信本报，但信中并未否认正在囤积大量大米的事实。这表明，如果银行界继续接受大米抵押贷款，民众的粮食供应将受到影响。
据悉，有特定人员在操纵这些活动。
本报正在收集证据以备发表，旨在让公众了解主要肇事者是谁。此事将在几天内向公众完全曝光。

page_data.en:
August 18, 1939.
Afternoon Translation

Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, Eastern
Times:-

RICE SITUATION

Owing to the shortage, the price of rice has
been constantly increasing. Yesterday the market price was
$32.50 per picul.

In view of the tense conditions prevailing in
the rice market, the Rice Trade Guild Control Committee has
decided to suspend business for three days.

At 11 a.m. yesterday, the Control Committee
of the Beans and Rice Trade Guild held a meeting to discuss
the matter of the people's livelihood. The meeting was
attended by Wu Zien-keng (符前耕), Wang Tien-jeu (王天仇),
Chow Tse-tsung (周子桢), and others and terminated
at noon the same day. During the meeting the following
resolutions were discussed and passed:-
"That the Beans and Rice Trade Guild should
request the S.M.C. for relief and that commencing from
August 18, the Guild should suspend business for three days."

With a view to maintaining the people's
livelihood within their jurisdiction, the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements have accepted the proposal submitted by
the Rice Trade Guild as to the purchase of 100,000 bags of
rice from abroad.

It is said that 18,000 bags of rice are now
in transit to Shanghai in a Norwegian vessel, and will
arrive here on September 2, 1939.

At 3 p.m. yesterday, Chen Tse-yee (陈子彝),
Chu Tse-shiang (朱子香), Wu Zien-keng, Chow Tse-tsung,
etc., representatives of the Rice Trade Guild held a short
conference with Mr. T.K. Ho, Chinese Deputy Secretary of the
S.M.C regarding the purchase of foreign rice. The price of
foreign rice is, however, not yet known.

According to the "Wei Pao" (报), a
mosquito newspaper, rice was yesterday sold at $28.60 per
picul in the Lin Van Ta Rice Shop (林萬泰米店), corner of
Honan and Haining Roads.

《新闻报》、《申报》、《中美日报》、《时报》：-

大米形势

由于短缺，大米价格持续上涨。昨日市场价格为每担32.50元。

鉴于大米市场 prevailing 的紧张局势，米业公会管制委员会决定停业三天。

昨日上午11时，米豆业公会管制委员会召开会议，讨论民生问题。符前耕（Wu Zien-keng）、王天仇（Wang Tien-jeu）、周子桢（Chow Tse-tsung）等人出席了会议，并于同日中午结束。会议期间讨论并通过了以下决议：
“米豆业公会应向工部局请求救济，并且自8月18日起，公会应停业三天。”

为了维持其管辖范围内的民生，租界当局已接受米业公会提出的从国外购买10万袋大米的建议。

据悉，目前有1.8万袋大米正由一艘挪威船只运往上海，将于1939年9月2日抵达此处。

昨日下午3时，米业公会代表陈子彝（Chen Tse-yee）、朱子香（Chu Tse-shiang）、符前耕、周子桢等人与工部局华务副总办何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生就购买外国大米一事举行了简短会议。然而，外国大米的价格尚不清楚。

据小型报刊《晚报》（Wei Pao）称，昨日河南路与海宁路交界处的林万泰米店（Lin Van Ta Rice Shop）以每担28.60元的价格出售大米。

Authorities Seek to
Break Rice Racket

It is reported by a reliable
Chinese source having close
connections with official circles
that the Shanghai Municipal
Council has already placed an
order for 100,000 bags of for-
eign rice for Shanghai's con-
sumption in order to offset the
manipulation by big purchasers
of the grain who keep on
storing it to await better
prices, which condition has
caused prices to soar to an
unprecedented scale. The first
consignment of 18,000 bags is
said to be expected to arrive
here on September 2.

1945年8月18日

当局试图打破大米投机垄断

据一位与官方圈子关系密切的可靠中方消息人士称，上海公共租界工部局已下令为上海的消费采购10万袋洋米，以抵消大型粮食买家操纵市场的行为，这些买家不断囤积粮食以待高价，导致价格飙升至前所未有的水平。据悉，首批1.8万袋大米预计将于9月2日抵达此地。

SHANGHAI TIMES,
' 8 18 1909
Fears Felt
Over Local
Rice Price
Police Patrols Seen
Observing Many
Rice Shops
Fearing a general riot or demon-
stration by the city's poor, because
many rice shops had been closed
for the day, special Settlement
police patrols were dispatched to
the various Central District and
Hongkew areas from 5 p.m. onward
yesterday to maintain peace and
order.
Patrol squads were to be seen
guarding Chinese rice shops in the
Sinza, Louza and Hongkew districts
up to a late hour last night, but
no untoward incident was reported
to have occurred.
Utter confusion reigned in the
local rice market yesterday when
prices for first grade white rice
and lower grade cereals generally
gained by another $1 to $2. First
quality white Changshu rice was
quoted at $32.50, as against $29.80
for the day before. Medium and
lower grade cereals were quoted at
$30 and $25.80 respectively.
Shipments of rice from the inland
areas to Shanghai remained scarce
during yesterday. A general ner-
vousness, as a result, was precipi-
tated in the local rice market, big
operators and merchants generally
were disinclined to unload their
stocks.
Poorer Classes Stricken
It was reported that local rice
shops, owing to a shortage of avail-
able stocks, were unwilling to sell
in large quantities. This precipitat-
ed a general rush among the pub-
lic, particularly among the poor-
er classes, to buy. It appeared that
there was not enough rice to go the
rounds, and the working classes of
people had been hard hit as a re-
sult of the soaring prices.
It was to prevent a possible de-
monstration or riot that special
posses of Settlement police were
dispatched to guard the various
rice shops. Fortunately, no unto-
ward incident was reported to have
occurred up to a late hour last
night.

《字林西报》，
1909年8月18日
对本地米价感到担忧
警方巡逻队被派往多处米店视察

由于许多米店当日停业，担心城市贫民发生大规模骚乱或示威，昨日下午5时起，公共租界巡捕房向中央区和虹口区各地派出特别巡逻队，以维持治安秩序。

直至昨晚深夜，仍可见巡逻队在闸北、老闸和虹口地区的华人米店守卫，但据报道未发生任何意外事件。

昨日本地大米市场一片混乱，一级白米和低等级谷物价格普遍再上涨1至2美元。一级常熟白米报价为32.50美元，而前一日为29.80美元。中等和低等级谷物分别报价为30美元和25.80美元。

昨日从内地运往上海的大米 shipment 依然稀少。因此，本地大米市场普遍出现紧张情绪，大运营商和商人普遍不愿抛售库存。

贫困阶层遭受打击

据报道，由于现有库存短缺，本地米店不愿大量出售。这引发了公众，特别是贫困阶层的普遍抢购。似乎没有足够的大米供应，工人阶级因价格飙升而受到严重打击。

为了防止可能发生的示威或骚乱，公共租界巡捕房派出特别小队守卫各家米店。幸运的是，截至昨晚深夜，据报道未发生任何意外事件。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.
AUG 1 8 1909
Rice Prices Cause
Uneasy Rumours
Nearly $30 a Picul Quoted
For First Grade Grain
Fears of trouble among the local
Chinese were freely voiced yester-
day as a result of the rice situation
which has caused prices to reach
nearly $30 a picul, the highest price
ever quoted in Shanghai.
Reports during the past few days
indicated that the situation is beyond
the control of the authorities despite
the fact that the latter had made
stupendous efforts to ease the situa-
tion. Three days ago, a report to
the effect that the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Council would buy 100,000 bags
of foreign rice caused the prices to
drop a little but the tendency is that
the situation is going from bad to
worse. The present price is nearly
$30 per picul for first grade rice but
the grain can hardly be obtained
from rice shops. The official price
is entirely discarded.
Complaints are freely made by the
man-in-the-street, and in Chinese
household discussions the increase of
the prices of rice has been a major
subject. Chinese language news-
papers are receiving numerous let-
ters from readers highly critical of
the situation. Under a big headline,
the "Shun Pao" published a news
article openly suggesting that the
authorities should "force" manipula-
tors to sell their ready stock
which they have stored up to wait
for high prices. Certain "big heads"
in the business world were stated to
be chief manipulators.

《字林西报》
1909年8月18日
米价引发不安谣言
一级谷物报价近30美元一担

昨日，由于大米局势导致价格达到每担近30美元，创下上海有史以来最高报价，人们纷纷表达对本地华人可能发生动荡的担忧。

过去几天的报道表明，尽管当局做出了巨大努力来缓解局势，但局势已超出当局的控制范围。三天前，有关上海公共租界工部局将购买10万袋洋米的报告导致价格略有下降，但趋势是局势每况愈下。目前一级大米的價格接近每担30美元，但在米店几乎买不到大米。官方价格已被完全弃用。

普通市民怨声载道，在华人的家庭讨论中，大米价格上涨已成为主要话题。中文报纸收到大量读者来信，对局势提出严厉批评。《申报》以大标题刊登了一篇新闻文章，公开建议当局应“强迫”操纵者出售他们为等待高价而囤积的现货。据说商界某些“大头目”是主要的操纵者。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.
AUG 18 1939

Creation of Vegetable
Monopoly Postponed
Arrangements Said Not
Yet Completed

Due to the incompleteness of the necessary arrangements, the Japanese-sponsored vegetable monopoly for Hongkew, which was to have become effective as from Wednesday, has not yet begun functioning as vegetable hawkers from Pootung still came into the Settlement and the French Concession yesterday unmolested.

While a monopolistic vegetable market has been functioning inside Hongkew market for the past six months obtaining its supplies from the Kiangwan and Tazang areas, the first indication that vegetable growers in Pootung would henceforth have to bring their supplies to Hongkew was only forthcoming on August 13 when a notice to that effect was issued by the provisional office of the vegetable monopoly in Pootung.

In this proclamation, all vegetable growers were informed that the provisional office would undertake the transportation of all vegetables destined for Shanghai and would unload them at the Chi Chong Wharf, Hongkew. As the required arrangements on the part of the provisional monopoly office had not been completed however, this measure was temporarily postponed.

It could not be learned whether the Pootung vegetable growers and hawkers would merely have to pay a tax to the Hongkew monopoly or whether the latter would buy the production outright and place it on the market for their own account.

While vegetable dealers in the French Concession depend principally on their supplies from Hangchow and other parts in the interior, those in the Settlement receive their cargo from boats coming down Soochow Creek.

Vegetable hawkers coming into the Settlement and the Concession from Hungjao have not been interfered with up to now and no plans about their supplies being included in the monopoly, have as yet been made known.

Well-informed circles pointed out yesterday that the monopoly may eventually result in a general reduction in the cost of vegetables in Shanghai as has been the case with the supply of pork, which has been monopolized for some time.

Poultry, it was understood, was also to become subject to the monopoly but no details could be ascertained concerning this matter yesterday.

《字林西报》
1939年8月18日

蔬菜垄断计划推迟
称安排尚未完成

由于必要安排尚未完备，原定于周三生效的由日本支持的虹口蔬菜垄断计划尚未开始运作，因为昨日来自浦东的菜贩仍不受干扰地进入公共租界和法租界。

虽然过去六个月里，虹口市场内一直有一个垄断性蔬菜市场在运作，其货源来自江湾和大场地区，但直到8月13日浦东蔬菜垄断临时办公室发布通知，才首次表明浦东菜农此后必须将货物运至虹口。

在该公告中，所有菜农被告知，临时办公室将负责运输所有运往上海的蔬菜，并在虹口稽重码头卸货。然而，由于垄断临时办公室方面的所需安排尚未完成，这一措施被暂时推迟。

目前尚不清楚浦东菜农和菜贩是只需向虹口垄断机构缴纳税款，还是后者将直接收购产品并自行投放市场。

虽然法租界的蔬菜商主要依赖杭州及内地其他地区的供应，但公共租界的商人则接收来自苏州河下游船只的货物。

迄今为止，从虹桥进入公共租界和法租界的菜贩未受干扰，且尚未公布将其供应纳入垄断计划的任何方案。

消息灵通人士昨日指出，垄断最终可能导致上海蔬菜成本的普遍降低，正如已被垄断一段时间的猪肉供应情况一样。

据了解，家禽也将成为垄断对象，但昨日未能查明此事的细节。

CHINA PRESS.

Aug 7 8 '

Flour And Wheat

Business in native flour was satisfactory
in yesterday's market, and the selling price
remained unchanged at $6 in cash for
local dealers and retail shops. The out-
port dealers were not yet in the market,
because the mills offered no supplies for
North China and the South Sea, during
the period of the local shortage of rice.
The local buyers were interested in ab-
sorbing and local rice retail shop also
asked a large amount of second-grade
flour for selling instead of rice during the
emergency time. The selling price of
second-grade product stood at $6.15 per
bag at the retail shops.
The trading of native wheat was quiet
and featureless, and brisk demand was
seen in the entire session. The selling
rate was increased by the wheat holders,
on account of the higher rate of white
rice. As a result, the rate rose by $0.10
above the preceding day's final rate.
Both the Fooh Sing and Fou Foong Flour
Mills collected 16 carloads of different
kinds of newly-harvested native wheat,
and the dealers bought more than 20
carloads.

《大美晚报》

1909年8月7日

面粉与小麦

昨日市场上国产面粉交易令人满意，本地经销商和零售店的售价保持在现金6美元不变。外埠经销商尚未入市，因为在本地大米短缺期间，面粉厂未向华北和南洋提供供应。本地买家有兴趣吸纳库存，本地大米零售店也要求在紧急时期大量购买二级面粉以代替大米出售。零售店二级产品的售价为每袋6.15美元。

国产小麦交易平淡无奇，但整个交易时段需求旺盛。由于白米价格较高，小麦持有者提高了售价。结果，价格比前一日的最终价格高出0.10美元。

福新（Fooh Sing）和阜丰（Fou Foong）面粉厂均收集了16车皮各种新收获的国产小麦，经销商购买了超过20车皮。

CHINA PRESS
AUG 18 1929

Rice Market

The stocked white rice in various rice godowns here is sufficient for the local public consumption within the next four months, according to a rumor reported by the China Evening News yesterday. The daily fresh rice supplies, amounting to 10,000 bags of different kinds of white rice, were brought here from the growing centers at Pootung, Wusih, Sungkiang, Tsingpoo and Wuhu port. The reason for the record price of rice lies in that some of the leading rice dealers and famous rice hongs kept the rice in the godowns instead of offering it, and thus sent up prices. They intended to make a profit of 50% for every picul of rice, the evening paper continued, so that some of the local small retail shops had no rice for selling.

100,000 bags of white rice were kept by outsiders who wanted to take a chance of selling at a good price, the evening journal continued. In the early part of this week, some of the local wealthy Chinese had ordered 1,500 tons of foreign rice, which is scheduled to arrive here at some time in September for liquidation.

With reference to the market report, 1,500 bags of white rice were received from the interior, coming by rail and truck and another 19 junkloads transported by steamer. The selling price in yesterday's market was irregularly high, or $1.50 above the preceding day's final rate. The first-grade white rice stood at $32 per picul and second-grade rice was quoted at $30. Low-grade rice was noted at $29 per picul.

Business in provincial rice was weak yesterday, because the operators were reluctant to buy waiting the further improvement. The Nanking provincial rice moved up to $28 and Wuhu rice was sold at $27 per picul.

《大美晚报》
1929年8月18日

大米市场

据《中国晚邮报》昨日报道的一则谣言称，本地各米栈储存的白米足以供本地公众未来四个月消费。每日新鲜大米供应量为1万袋各类白米，来自浦东、无锡、松江、青浦和芜湖港等产地。大米价格创纪录的原因在于，一些主要米商和著名米行将大米存放在栈房而非投放市场，从而推高价格。该晚报继续称，他们意图从每担大米中获取50%的利润，导致本地一些小零售店无米可售。

该晚报继续称，外人囤积了10万袋白米，希望伺机以好价格出售。本周初，一些本地富裕华人订购了1,500吨洋米，计划于九月某时抵达此地进行清算。

关于市场报告，有1,500袋白米通过铁路和卡车从内地运抵，另有19船驳船由轮船运输。昨日市场售价不规则地偏高，比前一日的最终价格高出1.50美元。一级白米价格为每担32美元，二级大米报价为30美元。低级大米记录为每担29美元。

昨日外省大米交易疲软，因为经营者不愿购买，等待进一步改善。南京省产大米涨至28美元，芜湖大米以每担27美元售出。

page_data.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper):

THE RICE PROBLEM

Interviewed yesterday, a rice merchant named
Li ( 李 ) made the following statement:- "The price of
rice in this locality has now exceeded the price limit
by some $10, the best quality rice being sold at more than
$30 per picul and the ordinary quality rice at some $20.
The recent repeated increase in the price of rice was
not due to a shortage of supplies from the interior or
an exhaustion of rice in stock locally. Members of the
rice trade circles all know full well that there are ample
stocks of rice and that large supplies of rice are coming in,
the action on the part of big rice merchants in hoarding
up rice without regard to the livelihood of the people
being responsible for the daily increase in the price of
rice.

"These rice merchants are well organized
and are being financially supported by certain local
banking circles, who wish to throw the local rice market
into disorder. It is not a hard job for the authorities
to ascertain the names of the hoarders nor their secret-
stores, which on discovery should by all rights be sold
at the price limit, otherwise they be charged with
endangering the livelihood of the people and the peace and
order of the district and heavily fined. If this be done,
the several million people in this locality would be
greatly benefitted.

"According to rice hoarders, the price
limit should be reconsidered in view of the fall in the
value of Chinese dollar and the increase in the price of
various other commodities. They hope that the
authorities will change the price limit to about $30.

"The rice supplies hoarded up by these
merchants are native products which have not been affected
in any way by the rise in the foreign exchange. The
reasons for a change in the price limit are not worth
consideration."

Without regard to the livelihood of the
people, traitorous merchants have manipulated the rice
market with the result that the best quality rice is being
sold at $32 per picul.
page_data.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：

大米问题

昨日接受采访时，一位姓李（Li）的米商发表了以下声明：“本地大米价格现已超过限价约10美元，最优质大米售价超过每担30美元，普通质量大米约为20美元。近期大米价格的反复上涨并非由于内地供应短缺或本地库存耗尽。米业界人士都清楚知道，大米库存充足，且大量大米正在涌入，大米价格每日上涨的责任在于大米大商人不顾民生囤积居奇。

“这些米商组织严密，并得到本地某些银行界的资金支持，他们希望扰乱本地大米市场。当局查明囤积者的姓名及其秘密仓库并非难事，一旦发现，理应强制其按限价出售，否则应以危害民生和地方治安罪处以重罚。如果这样做，本地数百万民众将大大受益。

“据大米囤积者称，鉴于中国货币贬值和其他各种商品价格上涨，应重新考虑限价。他们希望当局将限价改为约30美元。

“这些商人囤积的大米供应是国货，未受外汇上涨的任何影响。改变限价的理由不值一提。”

不顾民生的奸商操纵大米市场，导致最优质大米以每担32美元的价格出售。

page_data.en:
August 17, 1939.

MAINICHI

CHUNGKING GOVERNMENT AND THIRD POWERS RESPONSIBLE FOR HIGH
PRICE OF RICE

The Chungking Government's policy
of holding up food-stuffs and the British economic policy of
assisting the Chiang Kai-shek regime are responsible for the
high price of rice in Shanghai. Rice merchants are endea-
vouring to purchase rice but will not sell it. Rice is now
being sold at $30 a picul. The livelihood of the middle and
lower classes of people in Shanghai has been seriously
affected by the high prices of commodities. Fearing that
people of the refugee class in the Western District and
behind the Great World may create disturbances, the French
Police have adopted precautionary measures.
At the beginning of this year
the daily arrivals of rice from the interior amounted to
about 60,000 piculs, but in August only 4,000 piculs are
coming here daily; furthermore, the importation of Rangoon
rice has ceased owing to the high exchange. Four or five
rice shops in the Western District and in the vicinity of
the Great World have closed their doors because rice merchants,
in co-operation with Chinese bankers and capitalists, have
cornered rice in the Foreign Settlements and are unwilling
to sell. This is being done in compliance with the Chungking
Government's policy to hold up food-stuffs.
According to an investigation
made by the authorities of the Foreign Settlements, the rice
stocks on hand on August 15 amount to 133,000 piculs. The
daily consumption in Shanghai amounts to about 10,000 piculs.
An investigation made by Japanese economic organs reveals
that there are enough stocks to supply the population for
four months.
The Chinese people are attempting
to hold Japan responsible for the present rice troubles.
Actually the following are the causes of the present rice
situation :-
1. The high price of imported
rice due to the drop in the value of the legal tender notes.
2. The difficulty of transporting
rice to Shanghai due to the Chungking Government's economic
guerrilla activities.
3. The cornering of rice by
Chinese profiteers in the Foreign Settlements.
4. The independent character of
the Foreign Settlements. (The authorities of the Foreign
Settlements have deliberately refused economic co-operation
with Chapei and Hongkew. The Japanese authorities are
considering measures to deal with the situation).
page_data.zh:
1939年8月17日。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

重庆政府及第三国应对米价高涨负责

重庆政府囤积粮食的政策，以及英国援助蒋介石政权的经济政策，是导致上海米价高涨的原因。米商正努力收购大米，但拒绝出售。目前大米售价为每担30元。上海中下层民众的生计因商品高价而受到严重影响。法租界警方担心西区及大世界后方的难民阶层可能引发骚乱，已采取预防措施。

今年年初，来自内地的每日抵沪大米数量约为6万担，但到了8月，每日抵沪量仅为4,000担；此外，由于汇率高企，仰光米的进口已经停止。西区及大世界附近的四五家米店已关门停业，因为米商与华资银行家及资本家勾结，在外国租界内囤积居奇，不愿出售。此举是为了配合重庆政府囤积粮食的政策。

据外国租界当局调查，截至8月15日，现有大米库存为13.3万担。上海每日消耗量约为1万担。日本经济机构的调查显示，现有库存足以供应人口四个月之需。

中国民众试图让日本对当前的米荒负责。实际上，造成当前米价局势的原因如下：
1. 由于法币贬值，导致进口米价高涨。
2. 由于重庆政府的经济游击活动，导致大米运往上海困难。
3. 中国投机商在外国租界内囤积居奇。
4. 外国租界的独立性质。（外国租界当局故意拒绝与闸北和虹口进行经济合作。日本当局正在考虑采取措施以应对这一局势）。

page_data.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) 1-
THE RICE QUESTION IN THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS
(Comment)
The Chinese people in the International
Settlement and the French Concession are highly alarmed
over the high price of rice. There are indications
that robbery of rice shops may be expected. On August 15,
the S.M.C. ordered the Police to make an investigation
to ascertain whether any rice shop has closed its doors
for fear of robbery by poor people. The situation is
very serious.
page_data.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）1-
外国租界的米价问题
（评论）
公共租界和法租界的中国民众对米价高涨深感恐慌。有迹象表明，可能会发生抢劫米店的事件。8月15日，工部局命令警方进行调查，以确定是否有米店因害怕被穷人抢劫而关门。局势非常严峻。

page_data.en:
August 17, 1939. Morning Translation.

The principal cause of the sharp rise in the price of rice is the control of rice supplies by the Chungking Government to prevent rice from falling into Japanese hands. As a consequence, it is not the Japanese soldiers but the Chinese people who are suffering from a high price of rice. The Chiang regime is ill-treating the Chinese people.

The drop in the value of the dollar and the complicated political, social and international conditions are also some of the causes of the increase in the price of rice. Chinese capitalists and merchants are making use of the opportunity to hoard rice.

On August 11, there were about 185,000 "zah" of rice in stock in Shanghai, but this is being reduced by about 15,000 "zah" every day. On an average, not more than 10,000 "zah" of rice are consumed in Shanghai every day. This shows to what length hoarding of rice by unscrupulous merchants has gone. If this situation continues, Shanghai will be out of stock of rice after two weeks.

According to an investigation made by the S.M.C., about 58,000 "zah" of rice had arrived in Shanghai daily from the interior during June, but the amount fell off to 12,000 about the beginning of August. The S.M.C. lays the blame of this reduction on the control of rice by the Japanese militarists. Actually, it is due to an order from the Chungking Government placing restrictions on the supply of products and also to hoarding by unscrupulous merchants. Rice is now being sold at about $30 per picul. Thus the common people are in danger of starvation.

It is strange that the S.M.C. should try to shift the responsibility for reduced arrivals of rice in Shanghai upon the Japanese military. The Council declares, "The Police of the S.M.C. are strong enough to guard against cases of robbery of rice. Strict precautionary measures are being taken. In case of any disturbances created by poor people, machine guns will be used to deal with them."

The S.M.C. has placed no restrictions on the hoarding of rice by unscrupulous merchants nor has it adopted any plan to relieve the poor people who are in danger of starvation. The S.M.C. is apparently in conspiracy with the Chungking Government, the unscrupulous rice merchants and unscrupulous foreign merchants, thereby endangering the life of the Chinese people. We must correct the mistake of the Council.

The S.M.C. and the British Government are allowing anti-Japanese terrorists to hide in the Settlement to commit violence. It is an inhuman and barbarous act. To-day Britain economically has become a joint enemy of China and Japan.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月17日。晨间译稿。

米价急剧上涨的主要原因是重庆政府控制大米供应，以防止大米落入日本人手中。因此，遭受米价高涨之苦的不是日本士兵，而是中国百姓。蒋政权正在虐待中国人民。

美元贬值以及复杂的政治、社会和国际形势也是米价上涨的部分原因。中国资本家和商人正利用这一机会囤积大米。

8月11日，上海的大米库存约为18.5万“石”（zah），但每天减少约1.5万“石”。上海平均每天消耗的大米不超过1万“石”。这表明无良商人囤积大米的程度之深。如果这种情况持续下去，两周后上海的大米将耗尽。

据工部局调查，6月份每天从内地运抵上海的大米约为5.8万“石”，但到8月初降至约1.2万“石”。工部局将这一减少归咎于日本军国主义者对大米的控制。实际上，这是由于重庆政府下令限制产品供应，以及无良商人囤积居奇所致。目前大米售价约为每担30元。因此，普通百姓面临饥饿的危险。

奇怪的是，工部局竟试图将上海大米抵港量减少的责任推给日本军方。工部局宣称：“工部局警察力量足够强大，可以防范抢劫大米案件的发生。正在采取严格的预防措施。如果穷人制造任何骚乱，将使用机枪予以处置。”

工部局既未对无良商人囤积大米的行为施加限制，也未采取任何计划来救济面临饥饿危险的贫民。工部局显然与重庆政府、无良米商和无良外商串通一气，从而危及中国人民的生命。我们必须纠正工部局的错误。

工部局和英国政府允许反日恐怖分子隐藏在租界内实施暴力行为。这是一种不人道且野蛮的行径。如今，英国在经济上已成为中国和日本的共同敌人。

page_data.en:
Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspapers) :-
HIGH PRICE OF RICE DUE ENTIRELY TO MANIPULATION BY
TRAITOROUS MERCHANTS

Despite the efforts of the authorities of the
Settlements to limit the price of rice at $20 per picul,
there are indications that the price will be increased.
At present the price has reached about $30 a picul.

The High Price of Rice : Serious Allegations Against A
News Agency

This high price is due partly to:-
(1) Interruption of communications, thereby
rendering difficult the transportation of rice from the
interior to Shanghai.
(2) The fact that rice merchants, when making
purchases in the interior, are required to make payments
in Hwa Shing Bank notes which are at a premium of 40% in
terms of the tender notes, thereby indirectly increasing
the cost by 40%.
But the principal reason of this high price
is manipulation of the market by traitorous rice merchants.
According to an investigation made by the
Settlement authorities, there are 240,000 piculs of rice in
stock in godowns. If to this figure are added the rice
stocks hoarded by factories, shops and private individuals,
the total stocks in Shanghai are estimated at not less than
1,000,000 piculs.
The newspapers in Shanghai have published
reports of a shortage of rice in Shanghai. It is said that
the Sin Shun News Agency (新聲社), which specializes in
the dissemination of news about rice conditions in Shanghai,
is in receipt of a monthly subsidy from traitorous rice
merchants. It is for this reason that the agency has been
doing everything in its power to exaggerate the reports of a
shortage of rice in Shanghai.
According to the latest statistics released by
this agency, there are now only 133,094 bags of rice in
Shanghai. This is far below the figures shown in the
statistics issued by the Settlement authorities. This alone
is sufficient to show that the agency is propagating
exaggerated reports on behalf of traitorous merchants.
page_data.zh:
《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：
米价高涨完全由奸商操纵所致

尽管租界当局努力将米价限制在每担20元，但有迹象表明价格还将上涨。目前价格已达到每担约30元。

米价高涨：对一家通讯社的严重指控

米价高涨部分归因于：
(1) 交通中断，致使从内地向上海运输大米变得困难。
(2) 米商在内地采购时，被要求使用华兴银行钞票付款，该钞票相对于法币有40%的溢价，从而间接使成本增加了40%。
但造成米价高涨的主要原因是不法米商的市场操纵。

据租界当局调查，仓库中的大米库存为24万担。如果加上工厂、商店和个人囤积的大米库存，估计上海的总库存不少于100万担。

上海各报纸刊登了上海大米短缺的报道。据说，专门传播上海米情新闻的新声社（Sin Shun News Agency）每月接受不法米商的津贴。正因如此，该通讯社一直竭力夸大上海大米短缺的报道。

根据该通讯社发布的最新统计数据，上海目前仅有133,094袋大米。这远低于租界当局发布的统计数据。仅凭这一点就足以表明，该通讯社正在代表不法商人传播夸大其词的报道。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.
AUG 16 1939
City Has Only
Enough Cereal
For 20 Days
S.M.C. Holds Special
Meeting But No
Action Taken
STOCKS ON HAND
ALARMLY LOW
No Drastic Steps At
Price Control Are Yet
Contemplated
Reprieve at the eleventh hour in
Shanghai's threatening rice famine
came yesterday when the price of
the cereal dropped by one dollar
a picul from Monday's top price of
$29.50. This price adjustment was
a straw of hope held out to a city
which had exactly 20 days' rice
supply on hand according to a
statement yesterday by a pro-
minent foreign rice merchant.
The Shanghai Municipal Council
which held a special meeting yes-
terday to discuss the seriousness of
the present problem, decided to
wait a few days in view of the
slight amelioration, before taking
any drastic steps to regulate rice
supply and consumption.
Favorable Rumors
It was learned that the price
dropped when a combination of
favorable rumors and actual
circumstances joined forces. The
rumors circulating in the market
were that the Council in conjunc-
tion with the Bean and Rice Guild
had purchased 100,000 tons of
Saigon rice and that the Japanese
military were lifting their ban on
the shipment of the grain from
Wuhu to Shanghai. The fact was
that a shipment of 5,000 bags of
rice did arrive here yesterday from
the interior, but Wuhu was not the
port of despatch.
The Council emphatically denied
yesterday that any foreign rice had
been or would be purchased. It
was stated that recent Council re-
presentations made to the Japanese
authorities had received a concilia-
tory reply and that the Japanese
had declared their determination to
"look into the matter."
The Council yesterday admitted
that the present rice supply in
Shanghai was alarmingly low.
Previously it had been claimed
that there were ample stores in
stock to see the City through an
indefinite period of time.
Huge Daily Need
Shanghai needs a little more
than 8,000 bags of rice a day (the
amount of yesterday's shipment)
on which to exist. On Monday
500 bags arrived in the city and
through the past few weeks the
cargoes have been similarly small
and irregular.
Should the rice supply fail there
is an ample stock of flour on hand,
according to experts. This is
manufactured locally from foreign
wheat and is sufficient to feed the
entire population of the city for a
period of six months.
23460
(批：Lil 16/8)
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）。
1939年8月16日
城市谷物仅够
维持20天
工部局召开特别会议
但未采取行动
现有库存
低得令人 alarmingly（原文用词，意为令人担忧/惊恐）
尚未考虑采取
严厉的价格控制措施

在上海迫在眉睫的米荒危机中，最后一刻的缓解于昨日到来，谷物价格从周一的最高价每担29.50元下跌了1美元。一位著名外籍米商昨日发表声明称，这一价格调整为这座城市带来了一线希望，该市手头的大米供应恰好仅够维持20天。

上海工部局昨日召开特别会议讨论当前问题的严重性，鉴于局势略有缓和，决定在采取任何严厉措施 regulate（规范/管制）大米供应和消费之前，再等待几天。

有利谣言

据悉，价格的下跌是多种有利谣言与实际情况共同作用的结果。市场上流传的谣言称，工部局联合豆米公会购买了10万吨西贡米，且日军正在解除从芜湖向上海运送粮食的禁令。事实是，昨日确实有一批5,000袋大米从内地运抵此处，但芜湖并非发货港口。

工部局昨日坚决否认曾购买或计划购买任何外国大米。据称，工部局近期向日本当局提出的交涉已得到和解性的回复，日方表示决心“调查此事”。

工部局昨日承认，上海目前的大米供应低得令人担忧。此前曾声称库存充足，足以让城市无限期地维持下去。

巨大的每日需求

上海每天需要略多于8,000袋大米（即昨日的到货量）才能维持生存。周一有500袋大米运抵市区，而在过去几周内，到货量同样稀少且不规律。

专家指出，如果大米供应中断，手头仍有充足的面粉库存。这些面粉由进口小麦在当地加工而成，足以供应全市人口六个月之久。

23460
（批注：Lil 16/8）

page_data.en:
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.

AUG 16 1939

Rice Prices Fall
Local Chinese breathed a
sigh of relief yesterday when
prices of the various grades of
rice dropped suddenly. The
drop ranged between 70 cents
and $1 per picul. The first
grade rice was sold outside the
Shanghai Rice Market (where
practically no transactions had
been held for several days) at
$28.50 as compared with the
previous day's quotation of
$29. The price, however, is
still more than doubled when
it is compared with the price
quoted a few months ago. The
price decrease was caused by
the report that the Shanghai
Municipal Council was plan-
ning to buy 100,000 bags of
foreign rice in order to relief
the shortage and that two
British banks here had pro-
mised to advance the money
for making the purchase.
page_data.zh:
《华北每日新闻》（NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS）。

1939年8月16日

米价下跌

昨日，随着各级大米价格突然下跌，当地中国人松了一口气。跌幅在每担70美分至1美元之间。一级大米在上海米市外（那里已有数日几乎无交易）的售价为28.50美元，而前一天的报价为29美元。然而，与几个月前的报价相比，目前的价格仍翻了一倍多。价格下跌是由于有报道称上海工部局计划购买10万袋外国大米以缓解短缺，且在此的两家英国银行已承诺垫付购买资金。

page_data.en:
2346J

CHINA PRESS.

AUG 16 1939

Rice Market

Despite the higher rate prevailing during
the previous week, the price of white
rice was low yesterday. The market has
received a small amount of fresh rice
supplies from the growing centers in the
interior. According to an unofficial re-
port, the Shanghai Municipal Council and
the Executive Committee of Bean and
Rice Guild have ordered 10,000 bags of
Saigon Rice from Indo-China, and the
selling price has been fixed at $37 of
Chinese national currency per picul. The
foreign rice, it was learned, would be
shipped to Shanghai in September.
On account of this some of the rice
dealers offered at cheaper quotations. As
a result, the price of white rice dropped
from $0.50 to $1 per picul for different
kinds of white rice. Total sales in the
day were estimated at 6,000 bags, while
the first-grade white Changshu rice was
noted at $27.50; Soochow and Qunsan
at $26.50 and the newly-harvested Footung
rice was sold at $25.50 per picul.
Low demand for provincial rice was
seen in the market yesterday, because the
operators and retail shops were reluctant
to buy at the highest selling rate, on
account of a rumor that the Wuhu rice
ports would be reopened for transportation
by order of Japanese authorities; there in
the shortest time, the rice holders supplied
a considerable amount of provincial rice
to the market for selling.
According to a reliable information yes-
terday, there were a few thousands bags
of provincial rice on their way here from
Wuhu and other parts of the growing
centers, these supplies are expected to
arrive here in the later part of this week.
The total amount of provincial rice sold
yesterday amounted to 2,000 bags. The
price fell from $0.60 to $1 below the
preceding day's final closing rate. The
Nanking provincial rice was quoted at
$23 and Wuhu provincial rice was sold
at $23.20 to $24.50 per picul.
page_data.zh:
2346J

《字林西报》。

1939年8月16日

米市

尽管上周行情走高，昨日白米价格却偏低。市场从内地产区收到少量新米供应。据非官方消息，上海公共租界工部局与豆米业公会执行委员会已自印度支那订购一万包西贡米，售价定为每担法币37元。据悉，这批洋米将于九月运抵上海。受此影响，部分米商报价较低。结果，各类白米价格每担下跌0.50至1美元。当日总销量估计为6,000包，其中一等白常熟米报价为27.50美元；苏州米和昆山米分别为26.50美元，新收获的Footung（音译）米售价为每担25.50美元。

昨日市场上外省米需求低迷，因米行和零售店不愿以最高售价购入，原因是谣传日本当局将下令重新开放芜湖米港进行运输；因此，持米者在极短时间内向市场投放了大量外省米以供销售。

据昨日可靠消息，有数千包外省米正从芜湖及其他产区运往此处，预计这批物资将于本周后期抵达。昨日外省米总销量达2,000包。价格较前一日最终收盘价下跌0.60至1美元。南京外省米报价为23美元，芜湖外省米售价为每担23.20至24.50美元。

CHINA PRESS
AUG 16 1939
Flour And Wheat
Business in native flour was firm in the market yesterday, while the selling price remained steady, as the mills supplied a considerable amount of ready flour for selling to local dealers and retail shops. Although the North China and South Sea dealers took an active part in buying for shipment to Tientsin and Shantung, the mills refused to accept any order from the outport operators.
The official market price of second-grade product was quoted unchanged at $6 per bag to be paid in cash. The whole day's selling amounted to $200,000 bags of native flour. It was reported that flour was sold at $6.50 per bag in the outside market, which seems to be impossible, as according to official reports the retail shops sold at $6.20.
Business in native wheat was firm, while the Chinese mills and local dealers were interested in absorbing at the present higher rate of white rice. The selling price was irregularly high for purchases. According to the market record, the selling price was increased from $0.20 to $0.50 per bag for different kinds of native wheat. Both the Fooh Sing and Fou Fuong Flour Mills bought 10,000 bags of mixed kinds of native wheat, while the local buyers collected another 2,000 bags of this wheat.

《字林西报》
1939年8月16日
面粉与小麦

昨日本土面粉市场交易坚挺，售价保持稳定，因为各面粉厂向本地经销商和零售店提供了大量现货面粉以供销售。尽管华北和华南客商积极采购以便运往天津和山东，但各面粉厂拒绝接受来自外埠经营者的任何订单。

二等产品的官方市场报价保持不变，为每袋6美元，现金支付。全天本土面粉销售量达20万包。据报道，场外市场面粉售价为每袋6.50美元，这似乎不可能，因为根据官方报告，零售店售价为6.20美元。

本土小麦交易坚挺，中国面粉厂和本地经销商有意以目前较高的白米价位吸纳小麦。采购售价参差不齐且偏高。据市场记录，各类本土小麦的售价每袋上涨0.20至0.50美元。福兴（Fooh Sing）和福丰（Fou Fuong）面粉厂均购买了1万包混合种类的本土小麦，而本地买家又收购了2,000包此类小麦。

page_data.en:
August 16, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

RICE SHOPS CLOSE FOR FEAR OF RIOTS

On the afternoon of August 15 a
number of rice shops in the vicinity of the Great World,
French Concession, closed their doors fearing mob attack.
It is said that people of the poor class whose livelihood
has been affected by the high price of rice are about to
resort to rioting.
Although it is said that the
authorities of the Foreign Settlements are making every
effort to control the price of rice, so far they have
failed, thereby showing their inefficiency.
According to information obtained
from circles connected with the rice trade, rice merchants
have sufficient stocks to supply the entire population for 4
months, but they are unwilling to sell the rice and are
spreading reports of a shortage of rice for purposes of
profiteering. It is said that when the authorities
made an investigation into the stocks of rice, the merchants
made false reports. On August 15 the authorities of
the Foreign Settlements issued instructions to all Police
Stations under their control to make an investigation into
the stocks of rice held by rice dealers in their district,
but it is doubtful whether the investigation will have
any result.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月16日。

《大陆新报》

米店因惧怕骚乱而关门

8月15日下午，法租界大世界附近的一些米店因担心遭受暴民攻击而关门停业。据说，生计受高米价影响的贫民阶层正准备采取骚乱行动。

虽然据说外国租界当局正竭尽全力控制米价，但迄今未能成功，从而显示出其无能。

据从米业相关圈子获得的消息，米商拥有足以供应全体人口4个月的充足库存，但他们不愿出售大米，并散布缺粮谣言以图牟取暴利。据说，当当局调查大米库存时，米商作了虚假报告。8月15日，外国租界当局向其管辖下的所有警察局发出指令，要求调查辖区内米商持有的大米库存，但调查是否会有结果尚存疑。

page_data.en:
China Evening News, Ta Mei Wan Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao and
Chinese-American Daily News :-

THE RICE SITUATION

According to information from a certain
foreign source, the Food Control Committee of the S.M.C.
at 3 p.m. August 14 held a meeting to discuss the question
of the people's livelihood.
According to our reporter, rice is still
arriving from the interior. It is learned that the Rice
Trade Guild has requested the S.M.C. to purchase 100,000
bags of rice from abroad. However, owing to the big
drop in the value of Chinese dollars, the suggestion will
be difficult to carry out because of the price.
It is said that the Guild is making this
proposal with the intention of compelling the S.M.C.
to abolish the fixed limit in the price of rice so as
to enable the price to go up.
According to information from well-informed
circles, the S.M.C. will not approve the request for the
purchase of foreign rice and will adopt measures to suppress
manipulation by treacherous merchants.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》、《新闻报》、《申报》及《中美日报》：

米情

据某外籍人士消息，工部局粮食管制委员会于8月14日下午3时召开会议，讨论民生问题。

据本报记者报道，大米仍陆续从内地运抵。获悉米业同业公会已请求工部局从国外购买10万包大米。然而，由于法币大幅贬值，该建议因价格原因难以实施。

据悉，公会提出此提议意在迫使工部局取消米价限价，以便让价格上涨。

据消息灵通人士称，工部局不会批准购买洋米的请求，并将采取措施遏制奸商操纵市场。

CHINA PRESS.
AUG 15 1939

Council Seeks
Solution To
Rice Famine

The Shanghai rice shortage will
be discussed today at a special
meeting of the Municipal Council,
THE CHINA PRESS learned yesterday.

Recommendations for ameliora-
tion of the threatening shortage
will be submitted to the governing
body by the supplies sub-committee
at the meeting. The exact nature
of the propositions was not made
public but it is thought that they
will deal with imposition of increas-
ingly severe penalties for rice deal-
ers who do not comply with regula-
tions governing the local market.

Although there has been some
rumor that the municipal body
might raise the maximum price for
rice which is at present $20 per
picul, it was denied yesterday as
was another report that the Coun-
cil would buy 100,000 tons of foreign
rice to alleviate the present short-
age.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。
1939年8月15日

工部局寻求
解决
米荒方案

《字林西报》昨日获悉，上海米荒问题将在今天举行的工部局特别会议上进行讨论。

供应小组委员会将在会议上向管理机构提交改善迫在眉睫的短缺状况的建议。提案的具体性质未予公开，但据信将涉及对不遵守本地市场管理规定的米商施加日益严厉的惩罚。

虽然有谣言称市政机构可能会提高目前每担20美元的米价上限，但昨日予以否认；另一则关于工部局将购买10万吨洋米以缓解当前短缺的报道也被否认。

page_data.en:
23415
CHINA PRESS.
JUN 15 1930

Rice Market
On account of the continued blockade
of the rice transporting ports in the
interior by the Japanese authorities, the
market received only 10 junkloads of
white rice from the growing centers by
steamers, and another 3,500 bags of fresh
rice supplies from Soochow and Wuhu.
The price of white rice in yesterday's
market was raised by $0.30 per picul, as
compared with the last week-end's final
closing rate. The best quality of rice
was quoted at $29.50 and the low-grade
rice sold at $27.
According to a reliable information yes-
terday, the price of white rice would be
lower for purchases within short time,
because there was a large amount of
stocked rice in the godowns, and other
large shipments of rice would arrive here
from the interior, after the cancelling of
the emergency measures of the second
anniversary of the Sino-Japanese Hostili-
ties in Shanghai.
Business in provincial rice was small
yesterday, and the selling price was high
again in the market, while the operators
awaited a further improvement. There
arrived small quantities of this rice here
from the growing centers. The rate of
Nanking provincial rice was noted at
$25.50 and Wuhu provincial rice was
quoted at from $24 to $24.50 per picul.
page_data.zh:
23415
《字林西报》。
1930年6月15日

米市

由于日本当局持续封锁内地大米运输港口，市场仅通过轮船从产区收到10船白米，以及来自苏州和芜湖的3,500包新米供应。昨日市场白米价格较上周末最终收盘价每担上涨0.30美元。优质米报价为29.50美元，劣质米售价为27美元。

据昨日可靠消息，短期内采购白米价格将会降低，因为仓库中有大量库存大米，且在淞沪抗战两周年纪念日的紧急措施取消后，将有其他大批大米从内地运抵此处。

昨日外省米交易量较小，市场售价再次走高，而经营者等待进一步改善。仅有少量此类大米从产区运抵此处。南京外省米行情 noted at 25.50美元，芜湖外省米报价为每担24至24.50美元。

page_data.en:
23414
CHINA PRESS.
AUG 15 1939

Flour And Wheat

During the period of shortage of white
rice, a brisk demand for native flour
was seen yesterday but the mills refused
to accept the orders from the local buyers
and outport dealers. The rate of second-
grade product moved up by $0.20. The
official market price stood at $6 per bag.
Although the North China dealers asked
a large amount of native flour for trans-
portation, the mills did not offer any goods
for dealers outport, and offered only a
limited quantity of flour to local dealers
and retail merchants.
The wheat market continued closing
purchases yesterday. The unofficial rate
of second-grade of native wheat rose to
$8 per bag.

23414
《字林西报》。
1939年8月15日

面粉与小麦

在白米短缺期间，昨日本土面粉需求旺盛，但各面粉厂拒绝接受本地买家和外埠客商的订单。二等产品价格上调0.20美元。官方市场价格为每袋6美元。尽管华北客商要求大量本土面粉以便运输，但各面粉厂未向外埠客商提供任何货物，仅向本地经销商和零售商人提供有限数量的面粉。

昨日小麦市场继续停止采购。本土小麦二等的非官方报价涨至每袋8美元。

page_data.en:
August 14, 1939.                                Afternoon Translation.

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Hwa Pao, Chinese-American Daily News:

AUTHORITIES TO PURCHASE FOREIGN RICE

        With a view to maintaining    food supplies
for the inhabitants of Shanghai, the Bean and Rice Hong
Owners' Guild and the Rice Shop Owners' Guild have suggested
the following two measures to the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements:-
1) Regulate the importation of rice.
2) Buy foreign rice to relieve the situation.
        It is said that the authorities of the
Foreign Settlements have decided to maintain the food
supplies of the people and will order 100,000 bags of
foreign rice to relieve the rice market in Shanghai. This
project has been passed to the Rice Provisions Committee
for consideration. When this rice arrives, it will be
sold at a reasonable price.
        Some of the smaller of the 800 rice shops
in Shanghai have already suspended business for they are
without stocks.
        It is learned that rice shops are selling
inferior grade of rice at $20 per picul while the best
grade rice will be sold when the price of rice has become
more stable. The authorities are making investigations
into the situation. These rice shops may be severely
dealt with for their action.
        Rice shops will now be allowed to deal in
flour, macaroni etc. in order to enable them to keep up
their business. These provisions are to be sold at
standard prices as fixed by the Rice Shop Owners' Guild.
It is hoped that flour merchants will not cause the price
to go up through hoarding of flour.
        The authorities of the Foreign Settlements
have officially proclaimed that they will protect the
business of the rice shops within their jurisdiction.    A
case of rice snatching by ignorant people is reported to
have occurred on Robison Road in the Western District
yesterday. The matter was reported to police officers
and the crowd was dispersed.    The Police are now paying
close attention to such matters.
        With a view to enforcing the price limit of
$20 and to calm the inhabitants, the authorities, in
addition to despatching officers to supervise the rice
market, are endeavouring to ascertain the daily selling
prices of rice by the 800 rice shops.    The prices will
be exhibited on a board to be displayed in front of the
shop. Rice shops are earnestly advised to maintain the
present situation and to sell rice at the price limit
fixed. It is learned that all rice shops are observing
this order and it is hoped that the authorities will
suppress unlawful transactions.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月14日。                                下午译文。

《申报》、《新闻报》、《华报》、《中美日报》：

当局将购买洋米

为维持上海居民的食物供应，豆米号业主公会与米店业主公会向外国租界当局建议以下两项措施：
1) 规范大米进口。
2) 购买洋米以缓解局势。
据悉，外国租界当局已决定维持民众食物供应，并将订购10万包洋米以缓解上海米市。此计划已移交米粮委员会审议。当这批大米运抵时，将以合理价格出售。
上海800家米店中的一些小店已因无库存而停业。
获悉米店以每担20美元的价格出售劣质米，而优质米将在米价更加稳定时出售。当局正在调查此事。这些米店可能因其行为受到严厉处置。
现允许米店经营面粉、通心粉等，以使其能够维持营业。这些物品应按米店业主公会规定的标准价格出售。希望面粉商不要通过囤积面粉导致价格上涨。
外国租界当局已正式宣布将保护其辖区内的米店业务。据报道，昨日西区罗宾森路发生愚民抢米事件。此事已报告给警务人员，人群被驱散。警方目前正密切关注此类事件。
为执行20美元的限价并安抚居民，当局除派遣人员监督米市外，正努力查明800家米店的每日大米售价。价格将展示在店前悬挂的牌子上。恳切建议米店维持现状，并按规定的限价出售大米。获悉所有米店均遵守此令，希望当局能取缔非法交易。

page_data.en:
August 13, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Eastern
Times (12/8) $-

THE RICE SITUATION

On August 11, the Bean and Rice Hong Trade
Guild sent the following letter to the S.M.C., the French
Municipal Council and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce :-
"It is a fact that the rice stocks in
Shanghai are becoming smaller and only small quantities
of rice are arriving. In April this year, there were
600,000 bags of rice in stock, but this figure has now
dropped to 133,000 bags. About 2,000 to 3,000 "zah"
of rice are being transported to Shanghai every day from
Sungkiang, Tsingpu and vicinity, but no supplies are
coming from Zengchow, Wusih, Soochow or Quinsan.
During the past seven months, no "see mee" has been
sent to Shanghai from Wuhu.
"About 10,000 bags of rice are being consumed
in Shanghai daily, but arrivals are less than one-third
of this figure. This is the true principal cause of
the increase in the price of rice. The people, without
understanding this, are accusing rice merchants of
hoarding rice and with manipulating the market.
"The Autumn harvest will not be ready for
another 40 or 50 days. This Guild has on many occasions
requested that new sources of rice supplies be sought
or foreign rice be ordered to meet requirements, but
these requests were rejected.
"We hereby request you to lose no time in
finding a solution to the rice problem."

The rice situation has become worse. On
August 11, best quality rice was being sold at $27.50
per picul, while the prices of other grades of rice
have also increased. Local rice shops ceased buying
rice and the rice market became disorderly. Although
the authorities of the Foreign Settlements are strictly
dealing with rice speculators, the latter are as avaricious
as ever and transactions were done outside the rice
market. The poor class are seriously affected.
It is learned that a few rice shops suspended
business on August 11.
According to the Publicity Department of
the S.M.C., the Council and the French Municipal Council
have permitted rice shops in the two Foreign Settlements
to sell macaroni, flour, etc. . .
page_data.zh:
1939年8月13日。
晨间译稿。

《中美日报》、《新闻报》、《申报》、《大英晚报》（8月12日）$-

米粮局势

8月11日，豆米业同业公会致函上海公共租界工部局、法公董局及上海市商会，内容如下：“上海存米日益减少，而运抵之米数量甚微，此乃事实。今年四月，库存大米为60万包，但目前已降至13.3万包。每日约有2,000至3,000‘石’大米从松江、青浦及周边地区运往上海，但曾州（音译）、无锡、苏州或昆山方面并无供应来源。过去七个月内，芜湖未向上海发送任何‘西米’（音译）。
“上海每日消耗大米约1万包，但运抵量不足此数的三分之一。这正是米价上涨的真正主要原因。民众因不了解此情，指责米商囤积居奇并操纵市场。
“秋收尚需40或50天方可完成。本公会曾多次请求寻找新的大米供应来源或订购洋米以满足需求，但这些请求均被拒绝。
“特此请求阁下刻不容缓地寻求解决米荒问题的方案。”

米粮局势已进一步恶化。8月11日，上等米售价为每担27.50美元，其他等级米价亦随之上涨。本地米店停止收购大米，米市陷入混乱。尽管租界当局严厉处置米市投机者，但后者贪婪如故，交易转至米市之外进行。贫困阶层受到严重影响。
据悉，少数米店于8月11日停业。
据工部局新闻处称，工部局与法公董局已允许两租界内的米店销售通心粉、面粉等……

page_data.en:
August 13, 1939.
Afternoon Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Hwa Pao,
Central China Daily News :-

THE RICE SITUATION

Members of the Rice Shop Owners' Guild
have been seriously affected by the unlawful transactions
taking place in the rice market. Some small rice shops
have no more rice to sell and have written to the Guild
stating that they will not buy rice at prices over the
limit but the authorities should be requested to suppress
unlawful transactions.
This being an urgent matter, the Rice
Shop Owners' Guild on August 11 detailed representatives
to call on the S.M.C., the French Municipal Council and
the Chamber of Commerce requesting that measures of relief
be devised, the importation of rice be regulated, unlawful
rice transactions be suppressed and the price limit be
strictly enforced. It is learned that the authorities
will probably accept these requests.
The price limit of rice fixed by the
authorities is $20 per picul for first grade rice and
$16 for "see mee", but owing to diminished stocks, lack
of importation and unlawful transactions, the price of
rice has reached $29 per picul. The rice market was in
great confusion yesterday. 6,000 bags of rice were sold.

Eastern Times :-

Besides detailing representatives to call
upon the authorities of the Foreign Settlements on
August 11, the Rice Shop Owners' Guild has also sent
the following letter :-
"During the past few days, the price of rice,
due to unlawful transactions, has risen to $27 per picul
for first grade and $22 for "see mee". Great confusion
reigned in the rice market. As members of this Guild
could not obtain rice at the price limit, it was compelled
to buy rice at prices over the price limit in order to
meet the requirements of the market. As the price
continued to rise to $7 more than the price limit, we
could not make so great a sacrifice, so we stopped
purchasing any more rice.
"Now rice stocks are running low and several
shops have already exhausted their stocks and have sent
reports to this Guild requesting the Police for relief.
We beg you to devise ways to maintain peace and order."
The Rice Shop Owners' Guild has advised
the rice shops to maintain the present situation and
issued a circular to the effect that the authorities
of the Foreign Settlements have permitted the rice shops
to deal in flour and other provisions that can be used
as substitute for rice without taking out another
licence.
The price of rice has exceeded $29 per
picul for first grade rice. A rise of 60 to 70 cents
per picul of inferior quality rice was recorded.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月13日。
午后译稿。

《中美日报》、《新闻报》、《申报》、《华报》、《华中日报》：

米粮局势

米店业主公会会员深受米市非法交易之害。部分小型米店已无米可售，遂致函公会，表示不会以超过限价的价格购米，但应请求当局取缔非法交易。
鉴于事态紧急，米店业主公会于8月11日指派代表拜访工部局、法公董局及商会，请求制定救济措施，规范大米进口，取缔非法大米交易，并严格执行限价规定。据悉，当局可能会接受这些请求。
当局规定的大米限价为上等米每担20美元，“西米”（音译）每担16美元，但由于库存减少、进口缺乏及非法交易，米价已达每担29美元。昨日米市极度混乱。售出大米6,000包。

《大英晚报》：

除于8月11日指派代表拜访租界当局外，米店业主公会还发出了以下信函：
“近几日，由于非法交易，米价涨至上等米每担27美元，‘西米’（音译）每担22美元。米市一片混乱。由于本公会会员无法以限价购得大米，为满足市场需求，被迫以高于限价的价格购买。随着价格持续上涨，超出限价达7美元之多，我们无法承受如此巨大的牺牲，因此停止采购大米。
“目前大米库存告急，数家店铺已耗尽库存，并向本公会报告，请求警方提供救济。恳请阁下设法维持治安秩序。”
米店业主公会已建议各米店维持现状，并发布通告称，租界当局已允许米店在未另行申领执照的情况下，经营面粉及其他可替代大米的食品。
上等米价格已超过每担29美元。劣质米价格每担上涨60至70美分。

page_data.en:
Taishin
Shimpo

OFFICIAL PRICE OF RICE TO BE RAISED: S.M.C. GIVES
IN TO PROFITEERING MERCHANTS

Various quarters are paying
close attention to the rice problem as it affects the
livelihood of the people. . The official price of rice
which was fixed by the S.M.C. and the F.M.C. has been
violated by profiteering merchants. The helplessness
in the matter of the authorities of the Foreign Settlements
is being criticized by people.
On August 10 a picul of rice
was sold at $26 while the official price was $20. The
new price is the highest recorded in Shanghai. The
authorities of the Foreign Settlements should be held
responsible for the increased price because they have
failed to suppress profiteering. The Provisions
Control Committee of the S.M.C. is said to be the highest
authority in control of good-stuffs in Shanghai. It is
learned that this Committee intends to raise the price
of rice in the belief that such a step will prevent
secret transactions in rice. Actually, the price is
being raised at the strong demand of the rice guild. If
this is true, it means that the S.M.C. is giving way to
profiteers.
page_data.zh:
《泰新日报》（音译）

官方米价即将上调：工部局向牟利商人妥协

各界正密切关注影响民生的米粮问题……由工部局和法公董局制定的官方米价已被牟利商人违反。租界当局在此事上的无能正受到民众批评。
8月10日，一担米以26美元售出，而官方价格为20美元。新价格是上海有记录以来的最高价。租界当局应对价格上涨负责，因为他们未能遏制牟取暴利行为。据说工部局粮食管制委员会是上海控制食品的最高权威机构。据悉，该委员会打算提高米价，认为此举可防止大米秘密交易。实际上，提价是应米业公会的强烈要求。如果属实，这意味着工部局正在向投机商让步。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.
23816
AUG 12 1939

Rice Profiteers:
Present Prices Unwarranted
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR,—With reference to the article appearing in your issue this morning on this subject, as one who has had to follow closely the question of the supply and price of rice here, I must say that the higher prices demanded in the last few days by local rice hongs, dealers and shops, are unwarranted. I might add that it is a disgrace that this state of affairs should be tolerated by the Municipal authorities and the local populace.
The reasons put forth for demanding these higher prices are typical of a large number of those men engaged in the rice trade. It is true that during the last two weeks or so, there have been fewer arrivals of rice boats with supplies from the interior. This is due mainly to the fact that we are now at the tail end of the old crop season and supplies are scarce in the interior, quite usual at this time of the year; furthermore, with the approach of August 13 (anniversary of Shanghai's Tragedy) farmers and holders of rice in the interior are temporarily not sending as much rice to Shanghai, in case of trouble.
From all reliable reports to hand, the new rice crop promises to be a bumper one this year if the weather continues favourable as so far it could not be better and Shanghai should see good supplies of the new crop between the end of August and mid-October, after which time, the main crop from the principal rice-growing centres will have been harvested and marketed, when prices should be very cheap. Small parcels of the new crop have already been marketed last week from the Pootung district.
Today's price for Best Kiangsu rice should certainly not be more than CN$18 per 80 kilos (176 lb.) and there are large supplies of it available right here in Shanghai, in hoard. Unquestionably, a heavy drop in prices will be seen about the end of the month from the present high levels now demanded by those who are simply taking advantage of the immediate situation.
The price of native rice has nothing to do with the question of foreign exchange. It is also to the credit of the Japanese authorities in the areas under their control that they have at all times not only permitted rice to enter freely into Shanghai, but have in fact, so far, given every assistance in their power in this direction. Farmers and holders of rice in the interior have also been anxious to send their supplies to Shanghai as soon as possible all throughout last year, so as to realize cash, whereas in years prior to the hostilities they have been known to hoard supplies in the interior when prices in Shanghai were unfavourable to them.
(批：Tilu C 12/2)

《字林西报》
23816
1939年8月12日

米市投机者：
当前价格毫无道理
致《字林西报》编辑先生：

先生，——关于今晨贵报刊登的关于此主题的文章，作为一名不得不密切关注此处大米供应和价格问题的人，我必须说，本地米行、经销商和店铺近几日索要的高价是毫无道理的。我还要补充一点，市政当局和当地民众容忍这种状态是一种耻辱。
提出索要这些高价的理由是从事大米贸易的大量人员的典型表现。的确，在过去两周左右的时间里，从内地运来补给的大米船只抵达较少。这主要是因为目前正值旧作物季节的尾声，内地供应稀缺，这在每年的这个时候是很常见的；此外，随着8月13日（上海悲剧周年纪念日）的临近，内地的农民和大米持有者暂时不向上海发送那么多大米，以防发生麻烦。
根据手头所有可靠的报告，如果天气继续有利（目前为止天气再好不过了），今年的新稻作物预计将是大丰收，上海应在8月底至10月中旬之间看到新作物的充足供应，此后，主要产米中心的主要作物将被收割并上市，届时价格应该非常便宜。上周，浦东地区已有少量新作物上市。
今日江苏优质米的价格肯定不应超过每80公斤（176磅）18元法币，且上海本地就有大量囤积的此类大米可供使用。毫无疑问，那些仅仅利用眼前局势的人所索要的目前高价，将在月底左右大幅下跌。
本土大米的价格与外汇问题无关。同样值得称赞的是，日本当局在其控制区内始终不仅允许大米自由进入上海，而且事实上迄今为止在这方面提供了力所能及的一切援助。去年全年，内地的农民和大米持有者也急于尽快将其供应品运往上海，以便变现，而在战事爆发前的几年里，众所周知，当上海的价格对他们不利时，他们会在内地囤积供应品。
（批注：Tilu C 12/2）

大米贸易从业者建议市政当局进口洋米以缓解此地局势的说法，至少可以说有点厚颜无耻，也非常典型地反映了这些人的本质。在过去两年赚取巨额利润后，他们仍在继续这样做，现在却来请求工部局“协助”他们继续经营。当然，由此类进口大米造成的任何损失都不会由这些人承担。国际租界工部局在1937年9月至12月的紧急时期为上海居民提供了巨大服务。之所以能够做到这一点，是因为当时洋米征收高额关税，而工部局能够凭借免税许可证进行进口。

新稻作物将迎来大丰收。
