PRESS.
1939

Rice Market

Owing to the lack of supplies of fresh
rice and the monetary crisis, the market
price of white rice was irregular yester-
day. The first-grade of Changshu white
rice was quoted at $19,—the highest rate
in the last six month and $0.50 above the
preceding day's closing rate. Although
the weather remained warm, a brisk de-
mand by both local and outport dealers
was displayed in the market and a con-
siderable amount of rice was purchased
during the day.

With the Japanese authorities still de-
manding the payment of a new tax in the
interior, fresh supplies brought here totaled
only two junkloads and 2,000 bags of
white rice coming by steamer and rail.
Local buyers and rice holders took an
active interest in buying for stocks, push-
ing the price higher.

Local operators bought a few thousand
bags of second-grade white rice at $18.20,
or $0.30 above the last final rate. Rice
holders absorbed a considerable amount of
low-grade white rice at $17.50. The first-
grade of white rice dominated the market
although the selling price went up.

Business in provincial rice was very
strong and a very satisfactory price was
registered by sellers. A small shipment
of fresh supplies was brought here from
the ports of Nanking and Wuhu. The
opening price of Nanking provincial rice
was quoted at $0.50 above Monday's rate.

Local operators absorbed 3,000 bags of
both Nanking and Wuhu rice yesterday,
the former at $16.30 and the latter
from $14 to $16. The outport buyers
bought a large amount of provincial rice
for transportation. Even the low-grade
of provincial rice was quoted at $14, or
$0.30 higher than the preceding day's
closing rate. The total sales of various
kinds of provincial rice were estimated
at 6,500 bags.

《字林西报》（Press）
1939年

米市

由于新米供应短缺及货币危机，昨日白米市场价格走势不规则。一级常熟白米报价为19元，创近六个月最高纪录，较前一日收盘价高出0.50元。尽管天气依然炎热，但本地和外埠商号在市场上表现出强劲需求，当日采购了大量大米。

由于日本当局仍在内地征收新税，运抵此地的新供应总量仅为两船驳运量以及经轮船和铁路运来的2,000包白米。本地买家和持米者积极进货囤积，推高了价格。

本地经营者以18.20元的价格购买了数千包二级白米，较最后最终成交价高出0.30元。持米者以17.50元的价格吸纳了大量低级白米。尽管售价上涨，一级白米仍主导市场。

外省米交易非常活跃，卖方取得了非常令人满意的价格。少量新货从南京和芜湖港口运抵此地。南京外省米的开盘价较周一报价高出0.50元。

昨日本地经营者吸纳了3,000包南京和芜湖大米，前者价格为16.30元，后者价格在14元至16元之间。外埠买家购买了大量外省米以供转运。即使是低级外省米，报价也达到14元，较前一日最终收盘价高出0.30元。各类外省米的总销量估计为6,500包。

JUL 1 4 19..

Flour And Wheat

Business in flour showed some improve-
ment in purchases yesterday, and satis-
factory trading was done in the market
throughout the session. Local buyers
dominated in the buying market, as the
price of second-grade product remained
unchanged at $4.65 cash. Due to limited
produce recently, the mills did not offer
their cheaper quotations to the local and
outport traders, although local dealers
bought 10,000 bags of second-grade
native wheat. The Chefoo, Tsingtao
and Weihaiwei buyers also absorbed a
considerable amounts of flour for trans-
portation.
Business in native wheat continued
narrow yesterday, as the Chinese mills
collected native wheat at growing centers
instead of in market. This kept the
price of native wheat steady, while local
buyers awaited a cheaper future price.
Japanese mills were not in the market
as holders of wheat asked too high a
selling price.

《字林西报》（China Press）
1939年7月14日

面粉与小麦

昨日面粉采购业务有所改善，全时段市场交易令人满意。由于二级产品价格保持在现金4.65元不变，本地买家在买方市场占据主导。由于近期产量有限，磨坊未向本地和外埠贸易商提供更低报价，尽管本地商号购买了10,000包二级国产小麦。烟台、青岛和威海卫的买家也吸纳了大量面粉以供转运。

昨日国产小麦交易持续清淡，因为中国磨坊在产区而非市场收集国产小麦。这使得国产小麦价格保持稳定，而本地买家则等待未来更便宜的价格。日本磨坊未入市，因为持麦者要求的售价过高。

page_data.en:
20149
CHINA PRESS.
Rice Cost Expected
To Drop By $7 Here
In the past week, no less than
10,000 bags of rice are being sent
here every day and as a result the
price of rice has dropped by 30
cents yesterday. According to well-
informed circles, more rice will be
sent here in the future and they
believe the Settlement authorities
should change the maximum price
for rice from $21 to $14 per bag.
page_data.zh:
20149
《字林西报》（China Press）
预计上海米价
将下跌7元

在过去的一周里，每天至少有10,000包大米运抵此地，因此昨日米价下跌了30分。据消息灵通人士称，未来将有更多大米运抵此地，他们认为租界当局应将大米最高限价从每包21元调整为14元。

page_data.en:
20147
CHINA PRESS.
Rice Market
Due to the typhoon and heavy rain
yesterday, the white rice market was
inactive and most of the operators failed
to attend. The market received no fresh
rice from the growing centers by truck,
rail or junk. Four hundred bags of
Changshu and Wushih white rice were
offered for liquidation at from $18.90 to
$19.40 per picul, but no business was re-
corded.
Business in provincial rice was also
slight, with the typhoon keeping traders
away. Total sales of provincial rice of
the session were estimated at 600 bags.
The Nanking provincial rice was quoted
at $16.30, and Wuhu provincial rice
stood at $15.40, or $0.20 below the pre-
ceding day's final closing rate.
page_data.zh:
20147
《字林西报》（China Press）
米市

由于昨日台风和暴雨，白米市场交投清淡，大多数经营者未能到场。市场未收到来自产区的经卡车、铁路或驳船运输的新米。四百包常熟和无锡白米以每担18.90元至19.40元的价格挂牌清算，但未记录到成交。

外省米交易也很少，台风使贸易商望而却步。当次交易的外省米总销量估计为600包。南京外省米报价为16.30元，芜湖外省米价为15.40元，较前一日最终收盘价低0.20元。

page_data.en:
20148
CHINA PRESS.
Flour And Wheat
Slight business in native flour was done
in the market yesterday, because the out-
port buyers were reluctant to buy and
the interior dealers were not in the market.
Local traders bought small amounts of
second-grade product at $4.65 in cash.
According to an official report, trading
would become still more narrow in the
near future, with the Foo Sing Mills
temporarily suspending work to repair
machinery and the Van Feng Mills res-
tricting production for the duration of
shortage of cash in the market.
The native wheat market remained
closed yesterday. The market received no
fresh wheat and the operators were ab-
sent because of the heavy rain.
page_data.zh:
20148
《字林西报》（China Press）
面粉与小麦

昨日市场上国产面粉交易轻微，因为外埠买家不愿购买，且内地商号未入市。本地贸易商以现金4.65元的价格少量购买了二级产品。据官方报告，近期交易将更加清淡，福新磨坊（Foo Sing Mills）因修理机器暂时停工，而丰益磨坊（Van Feng Mills）因市场现金短缺而在期间限制生产。

昨日国产小麦市场休市。市场未收到新小麦，且由于大雨，经营者缺席。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS.
JUL 1 1 1939

Plenty of Rice in
Shanghai
Hot Weather Results in
Unloading of Stocks As
Storage Deteriorates

A the hot weather is unfavour-
able for rice storage those mer-
chants and manipulators who have
bought large stocks of grain are
trying to sell their cargo as quick-
ly as possible and, as a result, rice
shops in town have more than
enough rice for sale. Local Chinese
have breathed a sigh of relief as
the prices of the second and third
grade rice is following a downward
trend while the price for the first
grade rice is quoted at $21 per
picul which is the officially fixed
price,

Apart from the fact that mani-
pulators can no longer play against
the public owing to the unfavour-
able weather condition rice boats
carrying more than 4,000 bags of
rice are reported to be arriving
here daily from the interior. The
ready stock in various godowns
here alone will keep the Shanghai
population well supplied for at
least three months. Representatives
from the Shanghai Municipal Coun-
cil have been supervising transac-
tions in the market daily.

Some merchants are also reported
to be buying Saigon rice for local
consumption and about 2,000 tons
of the foreign grain are expected
to arrive here next month. This
business has been done with a local
French firm serving as a middleman.
Some orders placed in May have
been cancelled, however, owing to
the unfavourable changes in the
foreign exchange market but the
merchants are still keen about buy-
ing foreign rice.
page_data.zh:
20 00
《华北每日新闻》（North China Daily News）
1939年7月11日

上海大米充足
炎热天气导致存货卸载
因储存条件恶化

由于炎热天气不利于大米储存，那些购买了大量粮食存货的商人和投机者正试图尽快出售其货物，结果，市内的米店待售大米供过于求。随着二级和三级大米价格呈现下降趋势，而一级大米报价为每担21元（即官方固定价格），本地华人松了一口气。

除了由于天气不利，投机者无法再与公众对抗这一事实外，据报道，载有超过4,000包大米的米船每天从内地抵达此地。仅此处各栈房内的现有库存就足以保证上海人口至少三个月的充足供应。上海公共租界工部局代表每日监督市场交易。

另有报道称，一些商人正在购买西贡米供本地消费，预计下个月将有约2,000吨这种外国谷物运抵此地。此项业务由一家本地法国公司作为中介完成。然而，由于外汇市场的不利变化，5月份下达的一些订单已被取消，但商人们仍热衷于购买外国大米。

CHINA PRESS
JUL 10 1938
Price Of Rice Said
Due To Make Further
Declines This Week
Despite speculators' attempts to
export rice from Shanghai, local
grain traders were hopeful over the
week-end that the price of the
cereal would show further declines

scheduled to reach Shanghai by the

1938年7月10日
称本周米价
将进一步下跌

尽管投机者试图从上海出口大米，但据消息灵通人士昨日称，本地粮食贸易商在周末对下周谷物价格将进一步下跌抱有希望。

据报道，大量谷物已从产区运抵上海，总量每天超过20,000包。据称，这些货物主要来自常熟、芜湖和苏州。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS

JUL 7 1939

Prices Soar As
Buying Power
Of Dollar Falls

Cost Of Living Rockets
By 7% Over May, Also
Record Month

LARGEST INCREASE
NOTED IN FOOD

Rice Higher Now Than
At Any Other Time
In Local Annals

Shanghai's working people in
June experienced the most difficult
month in the city's history as the
price of rice rose to an unprece-
dented high while the purchasing
power of the Chinese dollar made
further appreciable declines.

Statistics issued yesterday by the
Industrial Section of the Shanghai
Municipal Council revealed that
the living cost of the workers last
month had taken nearly a 7 per
cent jump as compared with the
figures for May, a record breaking
month, and an increase of 15.48
per cent as compared with the
figures for June, 1938.

The largest increases were noted
in the food group which, the re-
port indicated, rose nearly 11 per
cent last month as compared with
the preceding month. Fuel and
light cost rose nearly 4 per cent,
it was stated.

Exchange Situation

According to the report, the sud-
den drop in the foreign exchange
value of the Chinese dollar last
month directly or indirectly affect-
ed the living cost of the workers.
Among commodities the prices of
which soared upward as a result
of the exchange situation was rice.
The price of non-glutinous rice,
the report said, rose to $22.40 per
shih during the month for which,
it added, various reasons have
been given:

1.—The effect of foreign ex-
change restrictions on the prices
of foreign rice rendering it unpro-
fitable to order from abroad;
2.—Heavy taxes on rice in the
occupied areas;
3.—The rise in the price of and
the embargo laid on rice in the
producing districts;
4.—Excessive buying on the part
of residents in view of the tense
situation in Tientsin;
5.—Manipulation of the grain
market by unscrupulous dealers.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》（China Press）
1939年7月7日

美元购买力下降
导致价格飙升

生活成本激增
5月环比上涨7%，亦创月度纪录

食品涨幅最大

米价高于本地史料记载的任何时期

6月，上海工人经历了该市历史上最艰难的月份，米价涨至前所未有的高位，而中国法币的购买力进一步显著下降。

上海公共租界工部局工业科昨日发布的统计数据显示，上月工人的生活成本较创下纪录的5月跃升近7%，较1938年6月增长15.48%。

报告显示，食品类涨幅最大，上月较前月上涨近11%。据称，燃料和照明费用上涨了近4%。

汇兑形势

报告指出，上月中国法币外汇价值的突然下跌直接或间接影响了工人的生活成本。受汇兑形势影响而价格飙升的商品中包括大米。报告称，非糯米价格当月涨至每石22.40元，并列举了各种原因：

1.—外汇管制对进口米价格的影响，使得从国外订购无利可图；
2.—沦陷区对大米征收重税；
3.—产区大米价格上涨及实施禁令；
4.—鉴于天津局势紧张，居民过度购买；
5.—不法商人操纵粮食市场。

page_data.en:
Price Of Rice Soars

After the price of rice had soared to the all-time high on June 23, the report went on to state, Settlement and Concession Authorities and representatives of the Rice Guild jointly fixed the market price of rice at $21 per shih. This quotation continues to be the official rate to this day.

An interesting review of the cost of rice in this city was given in the report, indicating that rice from 1884 to 1911 cost from $3 to $7 per shih. Peak prices were recorded at $9 in 1912, $13 in 1920, $18 in 1925 and $23 in 1930.

It was pointed out that although the 1930 quotation was fixed at $23 per shih, the "shih" according to the current "market system" is only 35 per cent by weight of the "shih" which prevailed in and before 1930. Figured on the old basis, it was added, the present official rate is equivalent to $24 per shih in 1930.

In the case of fuel, the Coal Briquette Guild announced increases in prices three times in succession during the month. Retail price was increased from $1.60 per 100 chin to $1.80, again to $1.90, and toward the end of the month to $2.10.

Plants Curtail Work

Commenting on the industrial condition of the city, the report indicated that a few enterprises dependent on raw materials from abroad have curtailed operations. It was stated in informed circles, according to the report, that recent financial measures might further affect the ability of some plants to continue operations at their former rate.

The report announced that the services of a social worker connected with the Community Church had been placed at the disposal of the Child Protection. She will take up her duties on October 1, it was stated.

Sixty-one cases were handled by the Section during the month of June, the majority coming to attention through police stations. Fifty were new cases. Ten stations sent in cases, the greatest number, 22, coming through the Louza Station.
page_data.zh:
米价飙升

报告接着指出，在6月23日米价飙升至历史新高后，公共租界和法租界当局与米业公会代表共同将米的市场价格定为每石21元。该报价至今仍是官方牌价。

报告对本市米价进行了有趣的回顾，显示1884年至1911年间，米价为每石3至7元。最高价格记录为：1912年9元，1920年13元，1925年18元，1930年23元。

报告指出，虽然1930年的报价定为每石23元，但根据目前的“市场制度”，“石”的重量仅为1930年及之前通行的“石”的35%。报告补充说，按旧制计算，目前的官方牌价相当于1930年的每石24元。

在燃料方面，煤球公会在本月内连续三次宣布涨价。零售价格从每百斤1.60元涨至1.80元，又涨至1.90元，月底时涨至2.10元。

工厂缩减开工

报告在评论本市工业状况时表示，少数依赖进口原料的企业已缩减运营。据报告称，知情人士透露，最近的金融措施可能会进一步影响某些工厂维持原有开工率的能力。

报告宣布，一名与社区教堂（Community Church）有关联的社会工作者已听由儿童保护部门（Child Protection）调遣。据悉，她将于10月1日上任。

该科在六月份处理了61起案件，大多数是通过警察局发现的。其中50起为新案件。十个分局报送了案件，其中数量最多的是老闸捕房（Louza Station），共22起。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUL 7 1939

Flour And Wheat

Business in native flour showed improve-
ment in the market yesterday as the out-
port dealers started to purchase small
shipments for transportations after a
three weeks' absence from the floor be-
cause of a lack of cash and the crisis
in North China.
Local dealers bought fractionally yes-
terday. The second-grade product was
still quoted at $4.65 in cash. Foreign
flour was not in the market.
There was slight trading in native
wheat, while the wheat holders refused
to sell their goods at cheaper quotations
due to the new high tax on transporta-
tion here from the interior. The opera-
tors were reluctant to absorb, and no big
business was done during the day. Jap-
anese mills bought a few hundred bags,
and the price was higher than the pre-
ceding day's final rate.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》（CHINA PRESS）。

1939年7月7日

面粉与小麦

由于缺乏资金以及华北危机，外埠客商已有三周未入市交易。昨日，随着他们开始购买少量货物以便运输，国产面粉市场交易有所改善。
本地商号昨日仅有零星买入。二等品现货报价仍为4.65元。洋面粉未在市场出现。
国产小麦交易清淡，持货者因内地运抵此间的新增运输税而拒绝以较低报价出售货物。经营者不愿吸纳，当日无大宗交易。日本纱厂购买了数百包，价格高于前一日的收盘价。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUL 7 1939

Rice Market

The price of white rice in the market
was very weak yesterday and the opera-
tors were not interested in buying for
stocks. The market received 2,000 bags
of fresh rice from the interior by truck
and rail. No rice was transported by
junks.

Because the local buyers were reluctant
to absorb during the hot weather, the
selling price of various kinds of white
rice displayed weakness during the day's
trading, and no big business was recorded.
First-grade white rice remained unchanged
at $17 per picul.

Owing to the large amount of stocked
provincial rice in godowns, the selling
rate of Nanking and Wuhu provincial
rice weakened in the market yesterday.
Both local and the interior traders were
unwilling to buy. No shipments of fresh
supplies of provincial rice were reported
to have been made to Shanghai from the
growing centers in recent days.

The opening price of provincial rice
fell by from $0.10 to $0.25, and local
and interior buyers bought 2,000 bags.
The Wuhu provincial rice was quoted at
from $16 to $17, and Nanking provincial
rice stood at $15.90.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》（CHINA PRESS）。

1939年7月7日

米市

昨日白米市场行情疲软，经营者无意购货囤积。市场通过卡车和铁路收到来自内地的2,000包新米。无驳船运米抵市。

由于本地买家在炎热天气下不愿吸纳，各类白米的售价在当日交易中表现疲软，未见大宗交易记录。一等白米价格保持不变，为每担17元。

由于仓库中存有大量外省米，昨日南京和芜湖外省米的市场售价走弱。本地和内地商人都不愿购买。据报道，近日未有新的外省米从产地运抵上海。

外省米开盘价下跌0.10至0.25元，本地和内地买家购买了2,000包。芜湖外省米报价为16至17元，南京外省米价格为15.90元。

page_data.en:
10391
CHINA PRESS.
JUL 1 1939
Rice Market
The selling rate of second-grade white rice was higher in the market yesterday and a satisfactory business was done during the day, mainly because the market could be closed for business until Tuesday on the occasion of a bank holiday.
Local dealers bought a large amount of rice for stocks. Second-grade white rice was quoted at $20.40, or $0.20 above the previous closing price, while first-grade Changshu white rice remained unchanged at $21 per picul.
Sixteen hundred bags of rice were brought here from the interior by truck and rail, but no rice was received by the market in junks. Outport buyers were not in the market because of a lack of cash.
Business in provincial rice was also very active in the market yesterday, and the price showed firmness during the day. The market received a small shipment of provincial rice from Nanking and Wuhu, the selling price rising by from $0.20 to $0.30 and the total sales during the day being estimated at 4,000 bags.
Both local and interior buyers dominated the market, Nanking provincial rice was quoted at $17 and Wuhu provincial rice at from $15.70 to $16.70, or $0.20 above the preceding day's closing rate. Low-grade provincial rice was quoted at from $15.30 to $15.60.
Lil
C'y
page_data.zh:
10391
《大美晚报》（CHINA PRESS）。
1939年7月1日
米市
昨日二等白米的市场售价较高，当日交易令人满意，这主要是因为适逢银行假日，市场休市直至周二。
本地商号大量购米囤积。二等白米报价为20.40元，比前一收盘价高出0.20元，而一等常熟白米价格保持不变，为每担21元。
一千六百包米通过卡车和铁路从内地运抵此处，但市场未收到驳船运来的米。外埠买家因缺乏资金而未入市。
昨日外省米市场交易也非常活跃，价格全天坚挺。市场收到来自南京和芜湖的小批外省米，售价上涨0.20至0.30元，预计当日总销量为4,000包。
本地和内地买家主导了市场，南京外省米报价为17元，芜湖外省米报价为15.70至16.70元，比前一日的收盘价高出0.20元。低等级外省米报价为15.30至15.60元。
Lil
C'y

page_data.en:
10893
CHINA PRESS.
JUL 1 1939
Flour And Wheat
Flour trading in yesterday's market remained narrow, while the outports were inactive awaiting financial improvement when the banks re-open for business on Tuesday. The mills still refused to accept cheque orders from both local and outport buyers. Local operators were also reluctant to buy. The price of second-grade product stood at $4.65 in cash, while an unofficial price of flour was quoted at $5, payment in order cheque, but no business was recorded.
Although there was a large shipment of newly-harvested wheat brought here from growing centers in Nanking and Wuhu, the selling price of native wheat was very steady, because the holders transported their goods directly to godowns. None of this wheat was supplied to the market for liquidation. The mills are keeping a large quantity of foreign wheat in stock.
Local buyers bought about 1,000 bags of Nanking newly-harvested native wheat at $6.53.
page_data.zh:
10893
《大美晚报》（CHINA PRESS）。
1939年7月1日
面粉与小麦
昨日面粉市场交易依然狭窄，外埠方面因等待周二银行复业后的金融状况改善而处于停滞状态。各厂仍拒绝接受本地和外埠买家的支票订单。本地经营者也不愿购买。二等品现货价格为4.65元，同时有一种非官方面粉报价为5元，凭有序支票（order cheque）支付，但无成交记录。
尽管有大量新收获的小麦从南京和芜湖的产地运抵此处，但国产小麦售价非常稳定，因为持货者直接将货物运往仓库。这批小麦均未供应市场进行抛售。各厂库存大量外国小麦。
本地买家以6.53元的价格购买了约1,000包南京新产国产小麦。

page_data.en:
June 30, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Morning Leader, Hwa Pao, Chinese-American Daily News :-

THE RICE SITUATION

As rice shops and dealers have failed to observe the market regulations and carry on transactions privately with the result that the price of rice is not uniform, the Bean and Rice Market Control Committee held a meeting of rice merchants at 11.30 a.m. yesterday at the Chengshu San Ching Yuen Restaurant (常熟山景園), Foochow Road. During the meeting, discussions took place regarding a revision of the market regulations so that all the merchants would have to observe them.
It is learned that a satisfactory result was reached at the meeting.
A reporter of the Sin Sun News Agency made enquiries from the rice market and learned that the price of rice again dropped yesterday by from 10 cents to 30 cents. Officials of the S.M.C. are visiting the rice market every day to supervise the sales and names of rice merchants or shops that are found to have raised the price of rice are sent to the Council. They will be fined according to the regulations. The officials are attaching great importance to the limited price, but as an order for 3,000 tons of Saigon rice has been arranged, there will be no fear of a shortage of rice in Shanghai.
The Sin Sun News Agency has learned that the price of rice will soon drop for the following reasons :-
(1) Rice now stored in local godowns or shops will last at least three months.
(2) Some 5,000 piculs of rice are being transported to Shanghai every day.
(3) The Autumn rice harvest is hopeful.
(4) New harvest will arrive on the market after two months.
(5) An order for foreign rice has been arranged.
(6) It is reported that the S.M.C. will again lower the fixed price of rice.

《申报》、《新闻报》、《大英日报》（Morning Leader）、《华报》、《中美日报》：-

米情

由于米店和商贩未能遵守市场规定，私下进行交易，导致米价不统一，豆米市场管理委员会于昨日上午11时30分在福州路常熟山景园餐厅召集米商开会。会议期间，讨论了修订市场规定事宜，以便所有商人均须遵守。
据悉，会议取得了令人满意的结果。
《新闻报》记者向米市查询得知，昨日米价再次下跌10至30分。工部局官员每日巡视米市监督销售，凡发现抬高米价的米商或米店，其名单将送交公董局。他们将按规定被处以罚款。官员们高度重视限价令，但由于已安排订购3,000吨西贡米，上海无需担心米荒。
《新闻报》获悉，米价即将下跌，原因如下：-
(1) 目前储存在本地仓库或店内的米至少可维持三个月。
(2) 每天约有5,000担米运抵上海。
(3) 秋收有望。
(4) 两个月后新粮将上市。
(5) 已安排订购洋米。
(6) 据报道，工部局将再次降低米价固定价格。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 30 1939
Rice Situation Now Easier
In Shanghai Markets
Downward Trend Developed Since Last Week-end
As Traders Have Begun To Unload Stocks As
Plenty New Supplies Arrive From Interior
Following efforts made by the
F.M.C. and the S.M.C. to regulate
prices on which unofficial open
market transactions are to be con-
ducted, the local rice market has
developed a downward trend since
last week-end. A steadier under-
tone, however, was being maintain-
ed, it was reported yesterday.
Reacting to the restrictions, rice
market speculators who previously
had been absorbing heavily, have
begun to unload their heavy stocks,
thus tending to bring about the
downward trend. On the other
hand, rice merchants generally,
anticipating heavy shipments of
cereals from the inland areas, are
now less inclined to renew heavy
stocktaking.
Arrivals from the inland areas
yesterday totalled only around
2,400 bags of white rice, and these
were traded in by local merchants
to meet their scattered demands.
Prices for first, medium and lower
quality cereals sustained losses of
from 20 to 50 cents yesterday, dur-
ing the closing sessions. First
quality Changshu rice were quoted
at $20.80, medium quality cereals
at $20.30, and lower grade cereals
at $19.90. Only around 5,000 bags
changed hands during the day. Local
rice merchants circles expressed
the belief yesterday that the down-
ward trends in the rice market
would continue.
Saigon Order
Orders for 3,000 tons of second-
grade Saigon rice, meanwhile, have
been placed by local rice dealers
with Louis Dreyfus and Company,
and delivery is expected to be made
sometime in the latter part of July,
it was reported yesterday. Prices
were quoted at $20.40 per bag, ac-
cording to the report.

1939年6月30日
上海市场米情趋缓
自上周周末以来呈现下跌趋势
随着大量新货从内地抵达
交易者已开始抛售库存
继粮食管理委员会（F.M.C.）和工部局（S.M.C.）努力规范非官方公开市场交易的定价后，本地米市自上周周末以来呈现下跌趋势。然而，据报道，昨日市场基调保持较为稳定。
受限制措施影响，此前大量吸纳货物的米市投机者已开始抛售其沉重库存，从而促使下跌趋势形成。另一方面，广大米商预期内地将有大量谷物运抵，现在不太倾向于大量补货。
昨日来自内地的到货总量仅约2,400包白米，这些货物由本地商人交易以满足零散需求。
昨日收盘时段，上、中、下等谷物的价格均遭受0.20至0.50元的损失。一等常熟米报价为20.80元，中等谷物为20.30元，下等谷物为19.90元。当日成交量仅约5,000包。本地米商圈子昨日表示，相信米市的下跌趋势将持续。
西贡订单
与此同时，据报道，本地米商已向路易·德雷福斯公司（Louis Dreyfus and Company）订购了3,000吨二等西贡米，预计将在七月下旬某个时候交货。据报道，报价为每包20.40元。

JUN. 30 1939
Rice Market
The selling rate of white rice was weak in the market yesterday and no big business was done during the day's trading, because of the lack of cash. A large amount of fresh rice supplies was bought here from the interior, and the total shipment was estimated at 6,000 bags.
Trading in white rice was slight yesterday, although the rate was reduced lower, because the outport buyers were inactive in absorbing the grains. Local dealers were also reluctant to buy. As a result, the first-grade white rice was quoted at $20.60, or $0.40 below the previous closing rate, and the second-grade stood at $20.30 per picul.
Owing to closure of accounts at the end of the month, business in provincial rice was very slight yesterday, and the price was weak on the market. Local buyers were not interest in buying during the hot season, and the interior buyers bought only a small amount of Nanking rice at $17 per picul. The total sales in the day reached 2,000 bags of various kinds of provincial rice.

米市
昨日白米市场售价疲软，由于缺乏资金，当日交易无大宗业务。此处从内地购入大量新米供应，估计总运量为6,000包。

JUN 30 1939
Flour And Wheat
With local Chinese banks continuing to restrict the withdrawal of deposits, the purchases of native flour remained small on the market yesterday. The mills refused to accept the wei wah checks from both the local and outport buyers. Out-port operators were not in the market yesterday and waited for financial improvement. Local dealers bought small amounts with payment in cash. The second-grade product was still quoted at $4.65 per bag.
The market received a large shipment of newly-harvested native wheat from the interior yesterday, but no business was recorded in market, because all the operators were reluctant to buy for stock. The Japanese mills, however, bought 1,000 bags of newly-harvested wheat at $6.53.

Morning Leader, China Evening News (June 27) :-

S.M.C. ENDEAVOURS TO CONTROL PRICE OF RICE

According to information from reliable
sources, the price of rice had been decreasing following
the enforcement of a price limit of $21 per picul by the
S.M.C. on June 23; however, the Rice Market Control
Committee of the seven rice trade organizations arbitrarily
fixed the price of various grades of rice on June 24. The
Committee openly prevented the price of rice from going
down.

The S.M.C. promulgated the price of rice on
the afternoon of June 22. On June 23, the market price
of Soochow rice fell to $20.40 or $20.50, but on June 24
the Rice Market Control Committee arbitrarily fixed the
price of Soochow, Quinsan and Changshu rice at $20.80,
thereby causing a rise of some $0.30 per picul. The price
of inferior grades of rice, therefore, also increased by
20 or 30 cents. For the sake of maintenance of peace and
order in the Foreign Settlements and of the livelihood of
the 5,000,000 inhabitants, such facts should be revealed so
as to draw the attention of the authorities of the Settlements.

According to the Sing Sung News Agency, the
Food Committee of the S.M.C. held a meeting at 2 p.m.
yesterday and the following decisions were reached :-
(1) That in order to stabilize the rice market, the impor-
tation of rice should first be regulated.
(2) That officials be sent to the rice mart to advise dealers
to observe the price limit.
(3) That rice dealers be encouraged to procure rice for
Shanghai.

A reporter ascertained that the figures of the
third stock-taking of rice issued by the Bean and Rice Trade
Guild yesterday are 436,427 bags, less by 87,395 bags
compared with the figures of the previous stock-taking.

During the past few days, rice has been
arriving here in ample quantities. On June 26 more than
4,000 bags arrived from Hankong and on June 27 some 4,000
bags also came to Shanghai.

《晨报》、《中国晚报》（6月27日）：

工部局努力控制米价

据可靠消息来源称，自工部局于6月23日实施每石21元的限价令后，米价曾一度下跌；然而，七大米业团体的米市管制委员会于6月24日擅自规定了各等级大米的价格。该委员会公然阻止米价下跌。

工部局于6月22日下午公布米价。6月23日，苏州米的市场价格跌至20.40元或20.50元，但6月24日，米市管制委员会擅自将苏州、昆山和常熟米的价格定为20.80元，导致每石价格上涨约0.30元。因此，劣质米的价格也上涨了20或30分。为了维护外国租界的和平与秩序以及500万居民的生计，应当揭露这些事实，以引起租界当局的注意。

据新声通讯社报道，工部局粮食委员会于昨日下午2时举行会议，并达成以下决定：
(1) 为稳定米市，应首先规范大米进口。
(2) 派遣官员前往米市，劝告商人遵守限价规定。

一名记者获悉，豆米同业公会昨日发布的第三次大米库存盘点数据为436,427包，较上次盘点数据减少87,395包。

过去几天，大量大米运抵此地。6月26日，有4,000多包大米从汉口运抵，6月27日，另有约4,000包大米运抵上海。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 23 1939

Shanghai Councils Act
To Limit Price Whereat
Rice Can Be Sold Here

Approval Given To Posting Of Notice Limiting Price
Of First Quality Rice At $21 Per Zar; Action
Taken In Interests Of Public

EXPLANATION GIVEN REGARDING CAUSES
BEHIND RECENT SOARING FIGURES

In response to a petition by local rice merchants, the Shanghai Municipal Council and the French Municipal Administration have decided to exercise their powers to fix maximum prices at which rice may be sold in the city.
As from to-day the price of first quality white rice must not exceed $21 per zar, and the price of See Mee is not to exceed $17 per zar.
The two Councils have given their approval to the posting in the Rice Market of a notice in the following terms:
"After consultation between the Rice Guilds and the Shanghai Municipal Council and the French Municipal Administration, the price, until further notice, of first-grade rice is not to exceed $21 per zar, and the price of See Mee is not to exceed $17 per zar.
"Any prices over and above these prices will not be recognised by the Guilds and should be reported to the Police."

Previous Anxiety

The meteoric rise in prices of cereals during the past fortnight had caused grave anxiety among local rice merchants and the general public as a whole. A little over a fortnight ago, prices for first-grade rice were quoted at around $17.50, but since then the rising trends had developed unchecked until prices firmed up to $22 on the eve of the Dragon Boat Festival.
Although the S.M.C. and the F.M.C. had declared themselves to be unwilling to interfere with open market transactions, it has now been decided, in the interests of the general public, to fix the price for first-grade rice at $21 per zar. It will be recalled that grave anxiety was expressed a few days ago that the rising trend had yet to reach its zenith unless the two foreign municipal authorities stepped in to check speculations and profiteering.

Merchants Explain

Explaining what appeared to be the causes of the recent rise, local rice merchants stated that the Tientsin and Kulangsu incidents had caused general apprehension among the local populace who, as a result, had been buying heavily. On the other hand, restrictions on the sales of foreign exchange, and the current depreciation of Chinese national currency has made it impossible for dealers to import Saigon rice to sell at a profit. Speculators, therefore, had become active, and had practically dominated the unofficial open market transactions by refusing to unload, but had continued to absorb the local stocks of rice, thus rocketing the price.

No Shortage Expected

There is no anxiety that Shanghai will face an immediate shortage of rice, it was stated in local rice dealing circles yesterday. Heavy shipments have continued to arrive in Shanghai from inland areas. Up till last week-end, local holders had in stocks a total of 523,622 bags of rice, according to a statement issued by the Shanghai Rice Guild yesterday. Apart from this quantity, it was also estimated that local rice merchants (the retailers) have still available stocks totalling around 600,000 bags.

《字林西报》
1939年6月23日

上海市政条例
限制本地大米售价

批准张贴通知，将一等米价格限制在每担21元；出于公共利益采取行动

就近期价格飙升背后的原因作出解释

应本地米商的请愿，上海公共租界工部局和法公董局决定行使权力，规定本市大米销售的最高价格。
即日起，一等白米的价格不得超过每担21元，“西贡米”（See Mee）的价格不得超过每担17元。
两局已批准在米市张贴如下内容的通知：
“经米业公会与上海公共租界工部局及法公董局协商，直至另行通知，一等米的价格不得超过每担21元，‘西贡米’的价格不得超过每担17元。
“任何高于上述价格的价格均不被公会承认，并应向警方举报。”

此前的担忧

过去两周谷物价格的急剧上涨引起了本地米商和广大公众的严重焦虑。两周稍前，一等米的报价约为17.50元，但此后上涨趋势 unchecked（原文如此，意为未受遏制），直到端午节前夕价格坚挺在22元。
虽然工部局和法公董局曾表示不愿干预公开市场交易，但为了公众利益，现已决定将一等米的价格定为每担21元。回想几天前，人们曾表达严重担忧，认为除非两个外国市政当局介入制止投机和牟取暴利，否则上涨趋势尚未达到顶峰。

商人解释

在解释近期看似导致价格上涨的原因时，本地米商表示，天津和鼓浪屿事件引起了当地民众的普遍恐慌，导致民众大量购买。另一方面，外汇销售限制以及中国法币目前的贬值，使得商人无法进口西贡大米以获利销售。因此，投机者变得活跃，通过拒绝抛售实际上主导了非官方的公开市场交易，并继续吸纳本地大米库存，从而导致价格火箭式飙升。

预计不会出现短缺

昨日，本地米业圈人士表示，不必担心上海会立即面临大米短缺。来自内陆地区的大批货物持续运抵上海。根据上海米业公会昨日发表的声明，截至上周末，本地持有者的库存大米总量为523,622包。除这一数量外，据估计本地米商（零售商）仍有约600,000包的可用库存。

June 23, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

"SHANGHAI CITY GOVERNMENT REQUESTS THE S.M.C. AND THE
F.M.C. TO DEAL WITH PROFITEERING RICE MERCHANTS"

The price of rice has been
going up since June 2. On June 20 it reached as
high as $23 per picul. This is a menace to the livelihood
of the people. For this reason, the Social Bureau of
the Shanghai City Government made an investigation and
found that the high price of rice was caused by rice
dealers in the International Settlement and the French
Concession who are cornering rice.
On June 22 Mayor Fu of the
Shanghai City Government sent a letter to the S.M.C. and
the F.M.C. requesting them to deal with the rice merchants
who are attempting to make profit by cornering rice.
The Mayor also sent a letter to the Anhuei Provinicial
Government inquiring into the price of rice; he will
purchase rice from the province to solve the rice problem.

The letter

The following is the letter
addressed to the S.M.C. and the F.M.C. by Mayor Fu:-
Rice is an indispensable
foodstuff of the people, rich or poor. According to
information received, there are more than 3,000,000 piculs
of rice in Shanghai but the price of rice is increasing
daily due to unlawful speculation by rice brokers. For
this reason, I hope that you will suppress the unlawful
activities of profiteers and make every possible effort
to solve the rice problem.

The S.M.C. and the F.M.C. fix price of rice and will
deal with offenders

At the request of the Shanghai
City Government the S.M.C. and the F.M.C. summoned rice
dealers in the Foreign Settlements and discussed with them
the price of rice.
As a result, the conference
decided to fix the price of the best quality rice at $21
per picul and $17 for the second grade rice and that
persons violating the above decision are to be dealt with
severely.
According to the above resolution,
the authorities of the Foreign Settlements will issue
warning to all rice dealers to the above effect on June 23.

1939年6月23日。

《大陆新报》

“上海市政府请求工部局和法公董局处置囤积居奇的米商”

自6月2日以来，米价一直上涨。6月20日，米价高达每石23元。这对人民生计构成威胁。为此，上海市政府社会局进行了调查，发现米价高涨是由国际租界和法租界的米商囤积大米造成的。
6月22日，上海市市长傅向工部局和法公董局致函，请求他们处置企图通过囤积大米牟利的米商。市长还致函安徽省政府查询米价；他将从该省购买大米以解决大米问题。

信件内容

以下是傅市长致工部局和法公董局的信件内容：
大米是贫富百姓不可或缺的食品。据收到的消息，上海有大米300多万石，但由于米经纪人的非法投机，米价每日上涨。为此，我希望你们镇压奸商的非法活动，并尽一切努力解决大米问题。

工部局和法公董局规定米价并将处理违规者

应上海市政府的请求，工部局和法公董局召集了外国租界的米商，并与他们讨论了米价问题。
结果，会议决定将最优质大米的价格定为每石21元，二等米定为17元，违反上述决定的人将受到严厉惩处。
根据上述决议，外国租界当局将于6月23日向所有米商发出上述内容的警告。

June 21, 1939.
Morning Translation.

Morning Leader, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Hwa Pao, Chinese-American Daily News:

THE PRICE OF RICE : APPEAL TO S.M.C. FOR ACTION

The unusual rise in the price of rice is being caused through manipulation by speculators.
At 11 a.m. yesterday, the Bean and Rice Trade Guild, the Rice Hong Owners' Guild and other rice trade bodies detailed Chen Tse-ye (陳子彝), Chu Tse-hsiang (朱子香), Wu Zien-keng (符前耕) and Chang Nian-sien (張念萱) to call on Mr. T.K. Ho, Chinese Deputy Secretary of the S.M.C., and to report to the S.M.C. the cause of the rise in the price of rice and to request the authorities of the Settlement to suppress manipulation, to regulate the importation of rice and to adopt effective measures to stabilize the price of rice. Mr. T.K. Ho promised to refer the matter to the Rice Provisions Control Committee for investigation.

FILE
The price of first class Changshu rice rose to over $22 yesterday. The mart will be closed to-day and to-morrow on account of the Dragon Boat Festival and will resume operations on June 23.
The Market Control Committee at 3 p.m. yesterday assembled various rice hongs and shops to a meeting and advised them to stabilize the rice price so as to maintain the food supplies of the people.
A representative of the rice trade stated that as the rice trade is not in a position to check the price, the Settlement authorities be requested to devise effective measures.
There is now a stock of 523,322 bags of rice in addition to private holdings. The total quantity of rice is estimated at 2,000,000 bags. Besides, rice is also arriving from the producing areas. There is no reason to worry about supplies.

1939年6月21日。
《晨译》。

《晨报》、《新闻报》、《申报》、《华报》、《中美日报》：

米价：呼吁工部局采取行动

米价的异常上涨是由投机者操纵造成的。
昨日上午11时，豆米同业公会、米号业主公会及其他米业团体委派陈子彝、朱子香、符前耕和张念萱拜访工部局华务副总办何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生，向工部局报告米价上涨的原因，并请求租界当局制止操纵行为，规范大米进口，并采取有效措施稳定米价。何德奎先生承诺将此事项移交粮食管制委员会进行调查。

档案
昨日一等常熟米价格涨至22元以上。由于端午节，米市今明两天休市，将于6月23日恢复营业。
昨日下午3时，市场管制委员会召集各家米号和店铺开会，劝告他们稳定米价，以保障人民粮食供应。
米业代表表示，由于米业无力控制价格，请求租界当局制定有效措施。
目前除私人持有量外，尚有库存大米523,322包。大米总量估计为2,000,000包。此外，大米也正从产区运来。无需担心供应问题。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 21 1939
（批：S. G. D... Date）

Rice Situation Locally Is
Steadily Getting Worse

Another Increase Yesterday Brings Price To New
High Record; Authorities Asked To Adopt Some
Method Of Control; Supplies Are Abundant

An impossible situation exists in Shanghai now. The city is full of rice, and yet the price of rice is at a record high—$21.80 per "zar." Rice is being steadily imported into Shanghai because of the high prices it is fetching here.

The price yesterday continued to be unsteady and high. After soaring to $21.70 per "zar" on Monday, it dropped to $21.50 yesterday and then reached a new high at $21.80. Meanwhile local Chinese in the two foreign areas have been purchasing large quantities of rice, fearing that the prices will continue to rocket. However, it is generally believed that the situation will have improved considerably when the rice market re-opens on Friday after the Dragon Boat Festival holiday.

According to reports, a petition has been submitted by local Chinese rice merchants to the Shanghai Municipal Council and also to the French authorities requesting these bodies to regulate the prices of rice imported into Shanghai. The Councils are also requested to persuade rice dealers to unload their stocks and have been asked to deal in cereals themselves, in order to regulate and lower the price and to sell their rice to the poorer Chinese.

Questioned about this petition, a responsible member of the S.M.C. stated that he had not seen it, and that he had no knowledge of it having reached the Council yet. However, he considered it possible that the petition was being translated and had not, as yet, been brought before the competent officials.

Yesterday the Food and Supplies Committee was stated to be carefully studying the whole rice problem, but it had not made any decision yet. The present question is a much more difficult one for the Council to deal with than the shortage of 1937, when the Council had large supplies of rice itself, and could, therefore, more easily regulate the prices of rice here.

Available Stocks

Available stocks of rice yesterday totalled 523,822 bags, showing a decrease of 43,766 bags as compared with last week-end, according to an investigation made by the Shanghai Provision Dealers' Guild.

Local rice merchants are much concerned by trends, and have been exchanging views regarding preventive measures.

"The rise in prices has been caused by big speculators who have been absorbing heavily. But shipments of rice into Shanghai have continued steadily, and there does not appear to be any possibility of interruption. Daily arrivals are reported to total around 4,000 bags from the inland cities (along Nanking-Shanghai Railway).

Besides the available stocks of rice investigated by the Shanghai Provision Dealers Guild, there are reported to be over 500,000 bags of rice with local rice merchants. There appears to be no reason, therefore for the rocketing of prices, except that it has been caused by speculation and profiteering.

Reacting to the rising trends on the previous day, prices for first quality white rice (Changshu rice) dropped to $21.50 yesterday, while medium and lower quality rice were quoted at $20 and $17, respectively. This drop said due to big operators, who, instead of continuing to absorb, unloaded heavily when the market opened yesterday causing the market to react rather nervously.

The rice market will be closed for two days beginning to-day, on the occasion of the Dragon Boat Festival, and reopen for unofficial open market transactions on Friday.

The Shanghai First Special District Citizens Federation has petitioned the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce to take suitable measures to cope with the local rice market situation. It has proposed the following:—(1) that an investigation be started to ascertain the cause of the rising trends, and to punish the guilty speculators, (2) to officially fix the prices on which transactions are to be based; (3) to take measures to regulate the supplies and demands, and generally to ease the local market conditions.

It is generally anticipated among local rice merchants that the rice situation will have improved considerably when the market transactions resume on Friday. Heavy shipments are expected from the interior. A good harvest is expected to be had within the next two months or so, in the outlying areas of Shanghai, particularly in Pootung, where the rice is to be harvested shortly. This will aid materially in swelling the available stocks of rice in this city, it was stated.

《字林西报》。
1939年6月21日
（批注：S. G. D... 日期）

本地米价形势
持续恶化

昨日再次涨价，创历史新高；当局被吁请采取某种管制措施；供应充足

上海目前存在一种难以应对的局面。城中大米充斥，然而米价却创下历史新高——每“石”21.80美元。由于在上海能卖得高价，大米正源源不断地输入上海。

昨日米价继续波动且居高不下。继周一飙升至每石21.70美元后，昨日跌至21.50美元，随后又触及21.80美元的新高。与此同时，两租界内的华人因担心价格继续飞涨，大量购入大米。不过，人们普遍认为，端午节假期过后，米市将于周五重新开市，届时形势将大有改善。

据报道，本地华商米商已向工部局及法国当局提交请愿书，请求这些机构对输入上海的大米价格进行监管。还请各公董局劝说米商抛售库存，并请求公董局自行经营谷物，以调节并降低米价，将大米出售给贫困华人。

就该请愿书一事询问工部局一位负责人时，他表示未曾见过该请愿书，亦不知其已送达公董局。但他认为，该请愿书可能正在翻译中，因此尚未呈交主管官员审阅。

据悉，粮食供应委员会昨日正在仔细研究整个大米问题，但尚未作出任何决定。对于公董局而言，当前的问题比1937年的短缺问题更难处理，当时公董局自身拥有大量大米储备，因此更容易调节本地的米价。

现有库存

根据上海粮业同业公会的调查，昨日大米现有库存总量为523,822包，较上周末减少43,766包。

本地米商对趋势深感忧虑，并就预防措施交换意见。

“价格上涨是由大肆吸纳的大投机商造成的。但运往上海的大米 shipments 持续稳定，似乎没有任何中断的可能。据报道，每日从内地城市（沿京沪铁路）抵达的总量约为4,000包。

除了上海粮业同业公会调查的现有大米库存外，据报道本地米商手中还有超过50万包大米。因此，除了投机和牟取暴利所致外，米价飞涨似乎没有其它理由。

受前一日上涨趋势的影响，昨日上等白米（常熟米）价格跌至21.50美元，而中等和下等米报价分别为20美元和17美元。据说这一下跌是由于大操纵者所致，他们在昨日开市时并未继续吸纳，而是大量抛售，导致市场反应相当紧张。

适逢端午节，米市将从今日起休市两天，并于周五恢复非正式公开市场交易。

上海第一特区市民联合会已向上海总商会请愿，要求采取适当措施应对本地米市形势。其提出如下建议：(1) 展开调查，查明价格上涨趋势的原因，并惩罚有罪的投机者；(2) 官方规定交易基准价格；(3) 采取措施调节供需，总体上缓解本地市场状况。

本地米商普遍预期，周五恢复市场交易后，米荒形势将大有改善。预计将有大量大米从内地运来。预计在未来两个月左右，上海周边地区，特别是浦东，将迎来丰收，那里的稻米即将收割。据悉，这将极大地增加本市的大米现有库存。

CHINA PRESS.

JUN 21 1939

Rice Market

Because of the higher selling price of
white rice in the last few days, trading
in white rice was very narrow early
yesterday, with the operators awaiting
improvement. The market received only
700 bags of white rice from the interior
yesterday brought by truck and rail. No
supplies were brought here by junks.
Because of the Dragon Boat Festival
today and tomorrow, during which days
the market will be closed, local dealers
bought a considerable amount of white
rice for preservation.
Outport dealers were reluctant to buy
as the price continued to rise in the
market yesterday. Price of various kinds
of white rice moved up by from $0.20
to $0.30 per picul. The market will begin
liquidation on Friday.
The price of provincial rice was irre-
gular in the market yesterday, and a brisk
demand was shown by all the dealers.
The market also received a considerable
amount of fresh rice supplies from Nan-
king, Wuhu and other growing centers.
With the weather becoming warm from
time being, rice holders were reluctant to
keep their goods in godowns where it
would be spoiled, and made their price
increases very small. Woosung and Pao-
shing buyers bought 3,000 bags of pro-
vincial rice for transportation.
The total sales during the day were
estimated at 5,000 bags of Nanking and
Wuhu provincial rice, the former being
quoted at $18 and the latter at $16.50.
The interior dealers bought 1,000 bags
of second-grade Wuhu provincial rice at
$14.80, or $0.20 above the previous closing
rate.

《大美晚报》。

1939年6月21日

米市

由于近几日白米售价较高，昨日早盘白米交易非常清淡，经营者都在等待行情好转。昨日市场仅通过卡车和铁路从内地收到700包白米。没有舢板船运来供应。由于今明两天是端午节，期间市场休市，本地商贩购买了相当数量的白米以备储存。

外埠商贩因昨日市场价格持续上涨而不愿购买。各类白米价格每担上涨0.20至0.30美元。市场将于周五开始清算。

昨日市场上外省米价格不规则，所有商贩均表现出旺盛的需求。市场还收到了来自南京、芜湖和其他产米中心的大量新鲜大米供应。由于天气时而变暖，持米者不愿将货物存放在可能变质的仓库中，因此提价幅度很小。吴淞和宝兴买家购买了3,000包外省米用于运输。

估计当日总销量为5,000包南京和芜湖外省米，前者报价为18美元，后者为16.50美元。内地商贩以14.80美元的价格购买了1,000包二等芜湖外省米，比前一收盘价高出0.20美元。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUN 21 1939

Flour And Wheat

A strong buying tendency was displayed yesterday by dealers hoping to benefit by higher prices in the future. The mills, however, checked speculative manipulations by refusing to release native flour for liquidation. The price of second-grade product native flour for local buyers consequently rose to $4.65 in cash.
Because the mills kept the selling price higher, both North China and South Sea operators were reluctant to buy for transportation, and the selling price for outport buyers stood at $4.96, paid in order cheque. Foreign flour attracted outport dealers in the market yesterday, but the rate was quoted high at $4.80 and only fractional purchases were recorded.
The market received a large shipment of newly-harvested native wheat from Nanking, Soochow and Kuanshan yesterday. Although the mills were not in the market, the selling price was very firm, while local buyers and wheat holders absorbed actively.
Local buyers also bought 14 trucks of native wheat from the growing centers in the Shanghai-Nanking Railway area at $7.03 for both Taiyang and Soochow wheat.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》。

1939年6月21日

面粉与小麦

昨日商贩表现出强烈的买入倾向，希望从未来的高价中获利。然而，面粉厂拒绝释放国产面粉进行清算，从而遏制了投机操纵。因此，供本地买家购买的二等国产面粉现金价格涨至4.65美元。

由于面粉厂保持较高的售价，华北和华南运营商都不愿购买用于运输，外埠买家的售价维持在4.96美元，以即期支票支付。昨日外国面粉吸引了市场上的外埠商贩，但报价高达4.80美元，仅录得零星购买。

昨日市场收到来自南京、苏州和昆山的大量新收国产小麦。虽然面粉厂未入市，但售价非常坚挺，本地买家和小麦持有者积极吸纳。

本地买家还以7.03美元的价格购买了来自京沪铁路沿线产区的14卡车国产小麦，太阳牌和苏州小麦价格相同。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

JUN 21 1939

S.M.C. Studying
Rice Situation
Present High Prices
Said Resulting from
Manipulations

Following a call made on Mr. T. K.
Ho, Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai
Municipal Council, by four representa-
tive rice merchants, the S. M. C. Food
Committee held a meeting yesterday
afternoon to devise measures whereby
the increase in the local prices of rice
could be checked. No definite deci-
sion has been reached, however, and
the four suggestions submitted by the
deputation, regarding the creation of
larger sources of supply, the fixing
of the price, the re-organization of
the weight and distribution systems
and a stricter S. M. C. control over
the rice market in order to prevent
profiteering, are at present being
studied by the committee which will
meet again before the end of the
week.
Meanwhile, manipulators became
more cautious yesterday, when it was
learned that some official action may
be taken in fixing the price of this
essential commodity and they bought
only smaller lots for future deliveries,
presumably awaiting the outcome of
Friday's meeting.
Rumours current in the past few
days, according to which existing
stocks of rice were very small, were
discounted by reliable sources yester-
day, where it was stated that over
2,000,000 bags of rice were available
at the present, with more arriving
each day.
The best quality is at present being
sold at $21 per picul as against the
former price of $14 which had been
set by the Price Fixing Commission
some months ago. The sudden rise
occurred when, unable to enforce a
price increase of $1 per picul, the
Commission was dissolved some time
ago.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。

1939年6月21日

工部局研究
米价形势
称目前高价
系操纵所致

继四位代表性米商拜访工部局副秘书何德奎（T. K. Ho，音译）先生后，工部局粮食委员会昨日下午举行会议， devised 措施以抑制本地米价上涨。然而，尚未达成明确决定，代表团提交的关于扩大供应来源、固定价格、重组称重和分配体系以及工部局加强对米市管制以防止牟取暴利的四项建议，目前正由委员会进行研究，该委员会将在本周末前再次开会。

与此同时，昨日操纵者变得更加谨慎，因为获悉官方可能会采取行动固定这种必需商品的价格，他们仅购买了少量期货，大概是在等待周五会议的结果。

可靠消息来源昨日驳斥了过去几天流传的关于现有大米库存非常少的谣言，并称目前有大米200多万包可用，且每天都有更多大米运抵。

目前最优质大米售价为每担21美元，而此前数月由平价委员会设定的价格为14美元。当平价委员会无法强制执行每担1美元的涨价时，该委员会于不久前解散，随即出现了价格的突然上涨。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUN 21 1939

Traders Here Said Planning
Commodity Price Fixing Body

Official Confirmation Of Proposal Lacking
While Many Merchants Reject Scheme

The organization of a price-fixing committee to regulate general commodity prices under Settlement and Concession authorities has been proposed by Shanghai merchants in an attempt to check rising living cost here, it was learned in Chinese trading circles yesterday.

While confirmation of the report could not be obtained at official circles yesterday, well-informed quarters believed that such a committee, even if granted official sanction, would not achieve the results desired.

The same quarters pointed to the dismal failure of the price fixing committee of the Rice and Bean Association here as an example, adding that the proposed committee would be totally incapable of handling the situation here.

Committee Fails

The committee organized by rice merchants here, it was recalled, was formed by wholesalers and retailers in the trade in an attempt to check the rising cost of grain. Following its organization, it issued many letters to members of the sponsoring association, counselling the maintenance of a $14 per picul price.

About a month ago, however, admitting its inability to maintain prices, the committee dissolved itself at a time when the cost of rice had reached far beyond the $14 quotation.

According to the plans of local merchants who proposed the organization of the commodity price-fixing committee, this body was expected to take suitable action to check the current wave of price soaring and to carry out the registration of the stocks of all merchandise in the city.

Proposal Not Favored

Merchants interviewed by THE CHINA PRESS expressed the opinion that the proposed committee would not be able to carry out its projected plans. Unanimously they stated that the solution at present was "to rid the city of speculators". The consensus of opinion indicated that these "speculators" were the parties most responsible for the mounting costs of all commodities in the Settlement and Concession, especially of rice and flour despite the huge stock of these commodities which is still held in the foreign areas.

Meanwhile, the price of rice continued its upward trend yesterday. The best rice was still quoted at all retailers at $21.80, an increase of another 20 cents as compared with Tuesday's quotation.

Call At S.M.C.

Several representatives of the Rice and Bean Association called at the S.M.C. in the afternoon to present the merchants' proposal that more rice be brought in from the grain producing areas in the interior and that speculation of unscrupulous dealers here be drastically curbed.

They also requested that a supervisor of the rice market be appointed by the Council in an attempt to check further speculation, it was learned.

While only about 3,000 bags of rice arrived in the foreign-administered areas yesterday optimism was expressed in informed circles that Japanese restrictions against the shipment of the grain from occupied areas might soon be released.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》。

1939年6月21日

据称本地商人计划
成立商品价格平准机构

缺乏官方确认
许多商人反对该方案

据悉，上海商人提议在租界和法租界当局下组织一个价格平准委员会，以调节一般商品价格，试图遏制本地生活成本的上升。这是昨日从中国商界获悉的消息。

虽然昨日在官方圈子未能证实该报道，但消息灵通人士认为，即使获得官方批准，此类委员会也无法达到预期的效果。

同一消息来源指出，本地米豆业公会价格平准委员会的惨淡失败就是一个例子，并补充说，拟议中的委员会完全无力处理本地的局势。

委员会失败

回想起来，由本地米商组织的委员会是由行业内的批发商和零售商组成的，试图遏制粮食成本的上升。成立后，它向发起协会的成员发出了许多信函，建议维持每担14美元的价格。

然而，大约一个月前，该委员会承认无力维持价格，在米价远远超过14美元报价之时自行解散。

根据提议组织商品价格平准委员会的本地商人的计划，该机构预计将采取适当行动遏制当前的价格飙升浪潮，并对全市所有商品的库存进行登记。

提案不受欢迎

接受《大美晚报》采访的商人表示，拟议中的委员会将无法执行其预定计划。他们一致表示，目前的解决办法是“清除城中的投机者”。普遍意见表明，这些“投机者”是对租界和法租界所有商品成本上涨，尤其是大米和面粉成本上涨负有最大责任的各方，尽管外国区域仍持有大量这些商品的库存。

与此同时，昨日米价继续呈上升趋势。所有零售商对最优质大米的报价仍为21.80美元，较周二的报价又上涨了20美分。

拜访工部局

据悉，米豆业公会的几位代表昨日下午拜访工部局，提出商人的建议，即从内地产粮区调入更多大米，并严厉遏制本地无良商贩的投机行为。

他们还请求公董局任命一名米市监督员，以试图进一步遏制投机。

虽然昨日抵达外人管理区域的大米仅约3,000包，但消息灵通人士乐观地表示，日本人对从占领区运出谷物的限制可能很快解除。

Morning Leader, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Hwa Pao, Chinese-
American Daily News, Eastern Times :-

THE RICE SITUATION

As a result of enormous hoardings by
speculators, the price of rice has now broken all records.
At the opening of the bean and rice mart, first class
Changshu rice rose to a new level of $21.70 per picul.
In spite of the advice given by the Market
Control Committee to buyers not to speculate in rice, the
prices continued to rise due to manipulation by speculators.
The Market Control Committee has submitted a report to the
Bean and Rice Trade Guild.
The Guild declares that the rise in the
price of rice is due to manipulation by speculators and
a report to this effect has been made to the authorities
of the International Settlement and the French Concession
with a request that the following effective measures be
adopted :-
1) To suppress manipulation of the rice market by speculators.
2) To regulate the importation of rice from the interior
in order to maintain the food supplies of Shanghai.
Various rice trade leaders have held an
informal meeting. The conclusion was reached that they
are unable to do anything more to cope with the rice
situation but hope the authorities of the Settlements
will devise good measures. The Rice Control Committee
has been urged to advise the rice dealers to dispose of
their stocks. The Committee yesterday exhorted the
105 rice hongs and shops to stabilize the price, regulate
rice importation and not to hoard rice. About 3,500
bags of rice arrived from Changchow and Quinsan yesterday.
According to a prominent rice dealer, the
present increase in the price of rice is most unexpected
for it is dangerous to store rice during summer season.
It is said that rice hoarders are not bona fide rice
dealers. There is now a rice stock of more than 500,000
bags in Shanghai, in addition to some 500,000 bags already
ordered. So there is no need to worry about rice
supplies for Shanghai. If hoarding can be suppressed,
the price will naturally go down. It is hoped that
the authorities of the Settlements will take action,
otherwise there will be further increase in price.
page_data.zh:
《晨报》、《新闻报》、《申报》、《华报》、《中美日报》、《字林西报》：

米价局势

由于投机商大量囤积，米价现已打破所有纪录。在豆米市场开市时，一等常熟米涨至每担21.70元的新高位。尽管市场管制委员会建议买家不要投机炒米，但由于投机商的操纵，价格继续上涨。市场管制委员会已向豆米业公会提交了一份报告。

该公会宣称，米价上涨是由于投机商操纵所致，并就此向公共租界和法租界当局提交了报告，请求采取以下有效措施：
1) 镇压投机商对米市的操纵。
2) 调节从内地进口大米，以维持上海的粮食供应。

多位米业领袖举行了一次非正式会议。结论是他们无法采取更多措施来应对米价局势，但希望租界当局能制定出良好的措施。有人敦促米业管制委员会建议米商处理其库存。该委员会昨天劝告105家米行和米店稳定物价，规范大米进口，不要囤积大米。昨天有约3,500袋大米从常州和昆山运抵。

据一位知名米商称，目前米价的上涨最出人意料，因为在夏季储存大米是危险的。据说囤积者并非真正的米商。上海现有大米库存超过50万袋，此外还有约50万袋已订购。因此，无需担心上海的粮食供应。如果能遏制囤积，价格自然会下降。希望租界当局采取行动，否则价格将进一步上涨。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
JUN 19 1939
Price of Rice Hits
New Record
Chinese May Ask Council
To Take Action : Increase
Due to Manipulators
Hope is expressed in Chinese circles in Shanghai that the Settlement authorities should do something now to check the sudden increase in the price of rice as a result of the alleged manipulation by those who hold large ready stock. First grade rice is being sold at $21 or more for a picul, a price never quoted in Shanghai for rice for about a decade, and is still following an upward trend.
It is pointed out that the price was only once quoted at about $20 or more many years ago when two provinces of Chekiang and Kiangsu were at war and that even when the Chiangnan hostilities were at their height more than a year ago when rice riots broke out here rice was sold for not more than $14. The officially fixed price of $14 has long been exceeded and without the operation of the Price Fixing Committee manipulators are reported to have been active.
It is stated by the Chinese press that the sudden increase in price during the past few days is the result of big purchases made by manipulators who are trying to control the market disregarding the welfare of the general public. When the rice market was opened for daily business on Saturday those in charge of the market were forced to close business earlier because while buyers were shouting for rice, sellers were reluctant to sell. Rice merchants are expected to meet soon to discuss the serious situation.
Cattle Market Dispute
Chinese reports state that the deadlock between pig dealers and authorities of the new Shanghai Cattle Market in Hongkew, which has monopolized the pig transportation business resulting in the price of pork being increased, may be settled if the principles for settling the dispute laid down by authorities concerned are accepted and carried out. A settlement will mean a reduction in prices.
Freedom of transportation of pigs from north Kiangsu districts to Shanghai is one of the principles maintained, it is stated. In this connection, it will be recalled, the new market announced many weeks ago that all steamers carrying pigs to Shanghai must be appointed by the market. As appointed steamers carried pigs to the new market with which pig dealers operating south of the creek refuse to co-operate supplies have decreased and hence the increase of price.
Another principle is to let pig dealers have their own choice of leaving their pigs to the care of pig hongs in Shanghai not necessarily the new market. If these two principles are accepted and carried out by the parties to the dispute then the dealers, who once called a strike as a protest against the monopoly, will resume full operations and an adequate supply of pigs will then be obtained.

《字林西报》。
1939年6月19日
米价创
新纪录
华人可能要求工部局
采取行动：涨价系
操纵者所致

上海华人圈子表示希望租界当局现在应采取行动，遏制因据称持有大量现货者操纵而导致的米价突然上涨。一等米以每担21元或以上的价格出售，这是上海近十年来从未出现过的米价，且仍呈上升趋势。

指出的是，多年前仅在浙江和江苏两省交战时，米价曾一度报出约20元或以上；甚至在一一年多前江南战事最激烈、此处发生米骚动时，米价售价也不超过14元。官方规定的14元限价早已被突破，据报道，在没有平价委员会运作的情况下，操纵者活动猖獗。

中文报刊称，过去几天价格的突然上涨是操纵者大肆采购的结果，他们试图控制市场，不顾公众福祉。周六米市开始日常交易时，市场管理人员被迫提前休市，因为买家高声求购，而卖家不愿出售。预计米商将很快开会讨论这一严峻局势。

牲畜市场纠纷

中文报道称，如果有关当局制定的解决纠纷原则得到接受和执行，虹口新上海牲畜市场的当局与猪贩之间因垄断生猪运输业务导致猪肉价格上涨而形成的僵局可能会得以解决。达成和解意味着价格下降。

据悉，维持的原则之一是允许从苏北地区向上海自由运输生猪。在此方面，值得回顾的是，新市场在数周前宣布，所有运载生猪到上海的轮船必须由市场指定。由于指定的轮船将生猪运往新市场，而浜南（苏州河以南）经营的猪贩拒绝合作，导致供应减少，从而引起价格上涨。

另一项原则是让猪贩自行选择将其生猪交由上海的猪行保管，而不一定是新市场。如果争议双方接受并执行这两项原则，那么曾经罢工抗议垄断的商贩将恢复全面运营，届时将获得充足的生猪供应。

CHINA PRESS
JUN 19 1939
15770

Speculators Held
Responsible For
Mounting Rice Costs

Grain speculators in the city
were believed to be "cashing in"
again over the weekend as prices
of rice continued mounting yes-
terday.
The best rice, quoted on
Saturday at $20.40 was sold for
20 cents above that figure yes-
terday, while corresponding in-
creases were also noted in
Changshu, Wusih and Sung-
kiang rice.
While some quarters were of
the opinion that the rising cost
was due to the diminishing im-
ports from the rice-producing
areas, informed circles pinned
the blame entirely on local
speculators who had been
hoarding the grain in order to
manipulate the market.
The Rice and Bean Guild
was reported to be seeking the
aid of S.M.C. officials, stating
that it was helpless in dealing
with the present crisis.
The present stock of rice in
Shanghai was reported to total
more than 500,000 bags by the
Guild.

《大美晚报》
1939年6月19日
15770

投机商被指
对不断上涨的
米价负责

据信，随着昨天米价继续上涨，城里的粮食投机商周末再次“趁机牟利”。

周六报价为20.40元的优质米，昨天以高出该价格20分的价格售出，同时常熟、无锡和松江米也出现了相应的涨幅。

虽然某些方面认为成本上升是由于来自产米区的进口减少所致，但知情各界将责任完全归咎于当地投机商，他们一直囤积粮食以操纵市场。

据报道，豆米业公会正在寻求上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）官员的援助，称其在应对当前危机方面无能为力。

据公会报告，上海目前的大米库存总量超过50万袋。

JUN 18 1939

Changshu White
Rice Price Hits
Record Of $20.40

Shooting up to a price not
seen on the local market since
the outbreak of hostilities in
1937, Changshu white rice yes-
terday was being sold for the
unprecedented sum of $20.40
per picul, outstripping the pre-
vious day's quotation by 70
cents.
Other kinds of rice gained
from $0.30 to $0.60 a picul,
mainly as the result of smaller
arrivals of rice in this city.
For full details on the ever-
more-serious situation, turn to
the Financial Page of THE
CHINA PRESS today.
