《大美晚报》。

1939年6月18日

常熟白米
价格创下
20.40元纪录

常熟白米昨天的售价达到每担20.40元的前所未有的高位，比前一天的报价高出70分，这一价格在1937年战事爆发以来的本地市场上未曾见过。

其他种类的米每担上涨0.30元至0.60元，主要原因是抵达本市的大米数量减少。

关于日益严峻局势的详细信息，请参阅今天《大美晚报》的金融版。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS

JUN 18 1939

Flour And Wheat

Owing to the blockade of the British
Concession in Tientsin by the Japanese
authorities, North China dealers remained
inactive in the flour market yesterday,
awaiting improvement. Slight business
was done in the market yesterday and
the price remained steady.
Local buyers were also reluctant to buy.
Owing to the low rate of Chinese national
currency, the mills refused to offer the
"Wealthy God" at $4.70 to the South Sea
and demanded $4.80 in order cheque. A
small amount was bought for transporta-
tion.
No large business was done in the
market yesterday, and the rate of second-
grade native flour remained unchanged at
$4.80. Foreign wheat was not in the
market yesterday.
A large shipment of newly-harvested
native wheat was brought here yesterday
from the growing centers in Nanking and
the interior, but most of the wheat was
sent to godowns instead of being offered
in the market for liquidation, because
of the low quotations in the market re-
cently.
After Swatow's purchase of a con-
siderable amount on Thursday, the holders
kept their price high in selling yesterday.
No business, however, was done, and
Nanking newly-harvested native wheat
stood at $6.60 per bag.
No official rate for the various kinds
of newly-harvested native flour was re-
corded in the market, because the Chin-
ese mills were not interested in buying for
stocks.
The foreign wheat was not quoted in the
market yesterday, because of the higher
rate of foreign exchange.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》

1939年6月18日

面粉与小麦

由于日本当局封锁天津英租界，华北商贩昨天在面粉市场上保持观望，等待局势改善。昨天市场交易清淡，价格保持稳定。

本地买家也不愿购买。由于中国法币汇率低，磨坊拒绝以4.70元的价格向南洋兄弟烟草公司（注：此处原文为South Sea，通常指南洋兄弟，但在面粉语境下可能指特定商行或泛指南方买家，依惯例保留直译或根据上下文理解，此处按字面译为南洋/南方买家，但考虑到“ Wealthy God ”即“财神牌”面粉，常销往南方）提供“财神牌”面粉，并要求以保付支票支付4.80元。少量面粉被购买用于运输。

昨天市场没有达成大宗交易，二等国产面粉的价格保持在4.80元不变。昨天市场上没有外国小麦。

昨天，大量新收获的国产小麦从南京及内地产区运抵此处，但由于近期市场报价低迷，大部分小麦被送入仓库，而非在市场抛售。

在汕头周四购买了大量小麦后，持货商昨天在出售时坚持高价。然而，没有达成交易，南京新收国产小麦价格为每袋6.60元。

市场上没有记录各种新收国产面粉的官方价格，因为中国磨坊对进货储备不感兴趣。

昨天市场上没有对外国小麦进行报价，因为外汇汇率较高。

page_data.en:
SnANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 20 1939
Price Of Rice
Sets Record
For All Time
Speculators Busy On
Cereal Front, Make
Enormous Profit
PLENTY OF SUPPLIES
BEING HOARDED
Danger Of Unrest Among
Chinese Populace Seen
If Rise Continues
Rising on a renewed wave of
speculations, prices for first
quality white rice yesterday hit
the record new level of $21.70,
with the rocketing trends still
unchecked. The supervisory
committee of the Shanghai Rice
Market declared its inability to
control the speculative activi-
ties over the week-end, which
they attributed to the opera-
tions of big speculators outside
the unofficial open market.
Local Chinese rice merchants
have sent a petition to the Shang-
hai Municipal Council and the
French Municipal Council urging
that measures be promptly adopted
to check and control speculations
in the local rice market.
During last week-end, prices for
first quality white rice ruled steady
at $19.50, as compared with $17.50
nearly two weeks ago. However, on
Sunday big operators continued to
absorb heavily, while refusing to
unload, with the result that prices
touched the record high of $21.70
yesterday. Shipments of rice from
the island cities to Shanghai have
declined somewhat, it was stated,
and this partially reacted on the
market trends.
May Cause Unrest
Commenting on the situation,
local rice merchants stated that the
$21.70 price level was something
unprecedented, but indicated that
unless general profiteering can be
successfully checked, the zenith of
the rising trend has yet to be
reached. Regarding the general
far-reaching effects of profiteering
and speculations among unscrupul-
ous rice dealers, attention has been
drawn to the possibility of an in-
crease of social unrest among the
working classes of the local popu-
lace, and unless the municipal
authorities of the two foreign areas
take prompt action in good time,
social peace and food order will
be gravely endangered.
Medium and lower quality cereals
also gained by around $1 yesterday,
reacting in sympathy with the gen-
eral rising trends. Of late un-
founded rumours had also been
circulated by speculators for profit-
taking, and the local rice market
has been practically dominated by
rumour-mongers who worked hand
in glove with the speculators, it
was pointed out by local rice mer-
chants.
page_data.zh:
《上海泰晤士报》。
1939年6月20日
米价
创下历史
最高纪录
投机商在谷物领域
活跃，获取
巨额利润
大量供应
被囤积
若涨势持续
恐引发华人民众
动荡

在新一轮投机浪潮的推动下，昨天一等白米价格触及21.70元的新的历史纪录高位，飙升趋势仍未得到遏制。上海米市监理委员会宣布其无法控制周末的投机活动，他们将其归因于非官方公开市场之外的大投机商的操作。

本地华人米商已向上海工部局和法国公董局递交请愿书，敦促迅速采取措施，遏制和控制本地米市的投机行为。

在上周末，一等白米价格稳定在19.50元，而近两周前为17.50元。然而，周日大操盘手继续大量吸纳，同时拒绝抛售，结果导致昨天价格触及21.70元的历史高点。据称，从岛屿城市（注：可能指舟山或其他沿海岛屿）运往上海的大米 shipment 有所下降，这在一定程度上影响了市场趋势。

可能引发动荡

评论这一局势时，本地米商表示，21.70元的价格水平是前所未有的，但指出，除非成功遏制普遍的牟取暴利行为，否则上涨趋势的顶点尚未到来。关于无良米商牟取暴力和投机产生的广泛深远影响，人们注意到当地民众工人阶级中社会动荡加剧的可能性，除非两个外国区域（指公共租界和法租界）的市政当局及时采取果断行动，否则社会和平和粮食秩序将受到严重威胁。

中低档谷物昨天也上涨了约1元，随整体上涨趋势联动。本地米商指出，最近投机商为了获利散布了毫无根据的谣言，本地米市实际上已被与投机商勾结的造谣者所主导。

page_data.en:
Review Of Month
The following report on the rice
situation for May is contained in
the Police Report for that month:-
During the month under review the
prices of various grades of rice
soared despite the continuous ar-
rival of stocks from the producing
areas. An increase ranging from
$2.50 to $3.30 per "zar" was record-
ed in the price of Chinese rice and
an increase of $1.40 and $0.70 per
bag in the price of Saigon and
Rangoon rice respectively. Increas-
ed buying prices in the producing
areas and manipulation and specula-
tion by dealers were the chief rea-
sons for the upward trend.
page_data.zh:
月度综述

以下关于五月份米价局势的报告包含在该月的警务报告中：

在本审查月期间，尽管来自产区的库存持续运抵，各级大米价格仍飙升。中国米价每“扎”（zar，音译，可能指某种计量单位或包）记录了2.50元至3.30元的涨幅，西贡米和仰光米的价格每袋分别上涨了1.40元和0.70元。产区收购价格提高以及商贩的操纵和投机是价格上涨的主要原因。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS
JUN 20 1939

Appeal Made
For Council
Rice Control

Committee Of S.M.C.
Centers Attention
On Situation

MANIPULATORS ARE
SCORED BY PAPERS

Municipal Body Asked
To Censure Dealers,
Bring In Rice

Petitioned by the Bean and Rice Association to take direct and forceful measures, including importations, to prevent further increases in the price of rice, it became known yesterday that Food and Supplies Committee of the Shanghai Municipal Council was directing an extraordinary degree of attention to the situation.

Several reports weekly on the rise in the cost to consumers of the city's most important staple were being received by the committee instead of the single weekly report received under normal circumstances, but a spokesman said the matter of official price-fixing was highly problematical, even improbable.

It was pointed out that when the Council fixed the price of rice during the 1937 shortage it had imported large stocks. Now, with no rice of its own, the Council felt it was not in position to act effectively, and might, should it fix a price, bring about a result contrary to the desired outcome.

Problem Tricky

"It is a tricky thing to interfere with supply and demand of one of the trickiest of commodities," the spokesman amplified. "It is a matter for experts. However, there are experts in the Food and Supplies committee, and, better, several of them were members of the committee in the 1937 crisis."

At that time, it was pointed out, the Council acted under its broad discretionary powers to meet emergencies of all kinds.

A report from the Shanghai Municipal Police yesterday said that during May the prices of various grades of rice soared despite continuous arrivals of stocks from the producing areas.

An increase ranging from $2.50 to $3.30 per "zan" was recorded in price of Chinese rice and an increase of $1.40 and 70 cents per bag in the price of Saigon and Rangoon rice respectively.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》
1939年6月20日

呼吁工部局
管控米价

工部局委员会
密切关注局势

报刊谴责投机商

要求市政机构谴责米商，
调运大米入沪

据悉，上海公共租界工部局粮食供应委员会正对当前局势给予异乎寻常的关注。豆米业公会已 petitioned（请愿）工部局采取直接且有力的措施，包括进口大米，以防止米价进一步上涨。

该委员会每周收到数份关于本市最重要主食消费者成本上升的报告，而在正常情况下仅收到一份周报。但一位发言人表示，官方固定价格的问题极具争议，甚至不太可能实现。

有人指出，工部局在1937年米荒期间固定米价时，曾进口大量库存。如今，工部局自身没有大米储备，感到无法有效采取行动；如果强行定价，可能会导致与预期目标相反的结果。

问题棘手

“干预这种最棘手商品之一的供需关系是一件棘手的事情，”该发言人进一步阐述道，“这是一个需要专家处理的问题。然而，粮食供应委员会中有专家，而且更好的是，其中几位曾是1937年危机期间委员会的成员。”

当时有人指出，工部局是在其广泛的自由裁量权下采取行动，以应对各种紧急情况。

上海公共租界警务处昨日的一份报告称，尽管来自产区的库存持续运抵，但5月份各级大米的价格仍然飙升。

国产米每“担”（zan）价格上涨了2.50至3.30美元，西贡米和仰光米每袋价格分别上涨了1.40美元和0.70美元。

page_data.en:
Manipulation Charged
"Increased buying prices in
the producing areas and
manipulation and speculation
by dealers were the chief
reasons for the upward trend,"
the police report stated.
Simultaneously, it was re-
ported that all business houses
and families sufficiently pro-
sperous to make large pur-
chases had stocked up enough
rice to last many months.
Stocks in Shanghai were re-
ported above 2,000,000 bags,
500,000 bags being in the go-
downs.
A report from Chinese sources
said that local merchants who
obtained foreign exchange to buy
rice from Annam and Saigon were
making enormous profits.
The Bean and Rice Association
appealed to the Council to stop
speculation and bring in rice from
the interior producing areas. Sun-
day's arrivals from Changchow
and Quinsan amounted to only 3,-
500 bags, far below normal.

Newspapers Aroused

Chinese newspapers generally are
denouncing rice speculators. An
editorial in the Sin Wan Pao
attacked hoarders for "menacing
the welfare of 5,000,000 Shanghai-
landers."
The editorial continued:
"We see no reason for the rice
dealers to raise their prices. The
foreign exchange situation should
not affect the rice market too
much, in view of the fact that most
of the rice came from points
where foreign exchange is now
needed.
"Despite the special taxes which
the shippers from the rice-produc-
ing areas must pay, shipments are
still arriving in Shanghai. Toge-
ther with the existing stock, there
should be no shortage here."
The editorial expressed the hope
that Settlement authorities will
take action against the "un-
scrupulous" practices of the
speculators.
page_data.zh:
指控操纵市场

“产区收购价格上涨，
以及经销商的操纵和投机
行为，是价格上涨的主要
原因，”警方报告称。
与此同时，据报道，所有
有能力进行大宗采购的商
号和家庭都已囤积了足够
维持数月的大米。
据报道，上海的库存超过
200万包，其中50万包存
放在仓库中。
来自中方消息源的报告称，
那些获得外汇从安南和西
贡购买大米的本地商人正
在获取巨额利润。
豆米业公会呼吁工部局制
止投机，并从内地产区运
入大米。周日从常州和昆
山运抵的大米仅有3,500
包，远低于正常水平。

报刊群情激愤

中文报纸普遍谴责大米投
机商。《新闻报》的一篇社
论抨击囤积者“威胁着500
万上海市民的福祉”。
社论继续写道：
“我们看不出米商提高价
格的理由。鉴于大部分大
米来自目前急需外汇的地
区，外汇状况不应过多影
响大米市场。
“尽管来自产区的运输商
必须缴纳特别税，但货物
仍在运抵上海。加上现有
库存，这里不应出现短缺。”
社论表达了希望，即租界
当局将对投机商“无良”
的做法采取行动。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUN 20 1939

Rice Market

The market rate of white rice was again irregular yesterday, while no demand was displayed in the morning session. The price weakened in the afternoon, first-grade Changshu white rice being quoted at $21.50, or $1.10 above the week-end's closing rate. Other kinds of white rice moved up by from $0.30 to $0.50, but no big business was done during the day.

It was generally noted that the selling price of Changshu white rice was $6.10 higher per picul than the maximum price set by the committees of Bean and Rice Guild on May 10. The market received only 600 bags of white rice from the interior by rail and steamer yesterday. Owing to the lack of fresh supplies, the holders kept the selling rates very firm in the morning.

Since the Japanese ban on the transportation of rice to Shanghai from Changshu, Wusih, Kuanshan and other rice centers, rice holders have been feverishly seeking further supplies in the area fringing the Shanghai-Nanking Railway.

Owing to closure of selling accounts on the Dragon Boat Festival tomorrow, the operators were reluctant to buy for stocks at a high rate, and slight business was recorded. According to an interview granted by a dealer in the market yesterday, the prices will remain irregular this week unless fresh supplies are brought here by junk.

Trading in provincial rice remained narrow in the market yesterday, and the price was very firm in the early session. The market received no supplies from the growing centers. The dealers were quiet, expecting lower rates for liquidation.

Local and interior buyers bought a small amount of Nanking provincial rice at $18 per picul, or $0.80 above the last week-end's closing rate. Wuhu provincial rice stood at $17.30, while low-grade provincial rice was sold at $16. The sales of various kinds of provincial rice during the day were estimated at 3,000 bags.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》

1939年6月20日

大米市场

昨日白米市价再次波动不定，早市毫无需求。午后价格走弱，一等常熟白米报价为21.50美元，比上周末收盘价高出1.10美元。其他种类的白米价格上涨0.30至0.50美元，但全天成交量不大。

人们普遍注意到，常熟白米的售价比豆米业公会5月10日设定的最高限价每担高出6.10美元。昨日市场仅通过铁路和轮船从内地收到600包白米。由于缺乏新鲜货源，持货商在上午坚持售价非常坚挺。

自从日本禁止从常熟、无锡、昆山等大米中心向上海运输大米以来，大米持货商一直在沿京沪铁路沿线地区疯狂寻求更多货源。

由于明日端午节停止交易结算，经营者不愿以高价买入存货，成交寥寥。据昨日市场上一位经销商接受采访时称，除非有帆船运来新鲜货源，否则本周价格将继续波动不定。

昨日外省米在市场上的交易依然清淡，早盘价格非常坚挺。市场未收到来自产区的任何供货。经销商保持观望，期待更低的价格以便抛售。

本地和内地买家以每担18美元的价格购买了少量南京外省米，比上周末收盘价高出0.80美元。芜湖外省米价格为17.30美元，而低等级外省米售价为16美元。估计当日各类外省米的销量为3,000包。

page_data.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

JUN 17 1939

New Fruit Market is
Organized
Local Dealers Protest Against
Monopolistic Project

While the Shanghai Cattle Marke'
has been organized in Hongkew to
monopolize the pork and pig trans-
portation business in Shanghai.
another new market is being estab-
lished in Chapei by Japanese and
"puppets" for the purpose of con-
trolling the sale of fruit and native
products The new organization is
called the Shanghai Central Green
Fruit and Native Products Market.
It is reported that by co-operating
with Chinese fruit merchants here
the Japanese have been able to
organize the new market in the old
warehouse of the Joint Savings
Bank in Chapei with a capital of
$1,000,000. Branch markets are to
be established in Nantao near the
French Bund, Tsaokadoo (western
district) and Siccawei.
Managers of the more than 50 big
fruit hongs which distribute fruits
to retail dealers held a meeting on
Thursday to oppose the new
organization. While denouncing the
few fruit merchants who have
participated in the new organization,
those present at the meeting de-
cided not to have anything to do
with the new market.
Like the Shanghai Cattle Market,
the new fruit market is expected to
monopolize the transportation and
distribution of fruit in Shanghai
which has been obtaining a regular
supply from neighbouring districts,
Fukien, Kwangtung and Tientsin.
Many kinds of fruit arrive from
foreign countries. While Canton is
an occupied area two important
districts in Fukien, are closed to
shipping unless with permission
from the Japanese military.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》

1939年6月17日

新水果市场成立
本地经销商抗议垄断项目

继上海牛市场已在虹口成立以垄断上海的猪肉和生猪运输业务之后，日本人和“傀儡”又在闸北建立了一个新市场，旨在控制水果和土特产的销售。该新组织名为“上海中央青果土产市场”。
据报道，通过与在沪的中国水果商人合作，日本人已在闸北四行储蓄会（Joint Savings Bank）的旧仓库内组织了这一新市场，资本为100万美元。计划在靠近法租界外滩的南市、曹家渡（西区）和徐家汇设立分市场。
周四，向零售经销商分销水果的50多家大型水果行的经理举行会议，反对这一新组织。与会者在谴责少数参与新组织的水果商人的同时，决定不与新市场发生任何关系。
与上海牛市场一样，预计新水果市场将垄断上海的水果运输和分销，而上海一直从邻近地区、福建、广东和天津获得定期供应。许多种类的水果从国外运抵。虽然广州是占领区，但福建的两个重要地区除非获得日军许可，否则禁止航运。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES,

JUN 15 1939

RICE PRICES SOAR
TO $19 LEVEL

Jump Due To Speculation
And Not Exchange, Say
Local Merchants

Speculative activities on the
local rice market sent prices for
first quality white rice up to the
$19 level yesterday, while medium
and lower quality cereals also re-
acted in sympathy, it was learnt
from local rice merchants.
On the plea that Chinese curren-
cy has depreciated in terms of for-
eign exchange, it was further
learnt, holders of rice stocks arbi-
trarily fixed the prices for first
quality white rice at a little over
$19 yesterday. Such activities, it
was stated in local rice circles,
were not the result of any short-
age of rice on the local market.
Moreover, prices of Chinese rice
have not been affected by foreign
exchange, with which they have no
relation, it was further stated.
The soaring of prices was the
direct result and solely due to
speculation, it was stated. There
were, up till yesterday, over 560,000
bags of rice still available on the
local market, while shipments into
Shanghai from inland areas con-
tinued to be heavy.
Local rice merchants yesterday
expressed the hope that the F.M.C.
and the S.M.C. authorities would
take the necessary measures to
prevent profiteering and specula-
tion, which is jeopardizing the
livelihood of thousands of the
poor, and which in turn might
cause widespread social unrest.
page_data.zh:
《泰晤士报》

1939年6月15日

米价飙升至
19美元水平

本地商人称上涨源于
投机而非汇率

据本地米商透露，昨日本地大米市场的投机活动导致一等白米价格升至19美元水平，中低等谷物也随之联动上涨。
进一步获悉，持货商以中国货币对外汇贬值为借口，于昨日任意将一等白米价格定在略高于19美元的水平。本地米业界称，此类活动并非本地市场大米短缺所致。
此外，据进一步陈述，国产米价格并未受到与其无关的外汇影响。
据称，价格飙升是投机的直接结果，且完全归因于投机。截至昨日，本地市场上仍有超过56万包大米可供销售，而从内陆地区运往上海的货物依然大量涌入。
本地米商昨日表示，希望法国公董局（F.M.C.）和工部局（S.M.C.）当局采取必要措施，防止危及数千穷人生计并可能引发广泛社会动荡的牟取暴力和投机行为。

page_data.en:
14560
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
JUN 15 1939

Rising Prices:
The Authorities Reproached
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR, "PUBLICITY'S" letter in your
columns this morning is timely and
accurate. What he says is absolutely
true, but what can we do about it?
Everybody knows that certain lucky
employees are getting their pay in
gold, whereas local people are either
getting nothing, or a mere 10, 15 or
20 per cent. Increase in cost of living
is about 65 per cent, thanks to all
the profiteers we have around us.
I suppose rents are going up in
spite of the fact that summer is on
us and landlords have no coal bills
to pay. Maybe the Council can do
something about everything, but it is
a foregone conclusion that they will
not, except sanction every surcharge
presented to them by utility concerns.
I priced some goods at local stores
yesterday and in one well-known
pharmacy everything has been raised
50 per cent. Pay or go without.
That must be the slogan of every local
shop today.
From the discrimination shown by
most firms between local employees
and home staff by according the
former a small allowance and the
latter salaries on a gold basis, one
would think that only the home staff
are paying the increases and sur-
charges. Probably they think that
local employees know the art of
cheap living. We are facing a brick
wall and the authorities do nothing
because they do not care. They are
not suffering, so why should they
worry about the less lucky ones who
are!
TIRED JANE.
Shanghai, June 14.
page_data.zh:
14560
《字林西报》
1939年6月15日

物价上涨：
当局受到指责
致《字林西报》编辑先生

先生，今晨贵报刊登的“PUBLICITY”来信及时且准确。他所说的绝对真实，但我们能做什么呢？众所周知，某些幸运的员工正以黄金领取薪水，而本地人要么一无所获，要么仅增加10%、15%或20%。由于周围所有的牟取暴利者，生活成本上涨了约65%。
我想，尽管夏天已经到来，房东无需支付煤账单，但租金仍在上涨。也许工部局能在各方面做些事情，但毫无疑问，他们不会这样做，除非批准公用事业公司提出的每一项附加费。
我昨天在本地商店查询了一些商品的价格，在一家知名药店里，所有商品价格都上涨了50%。“要么付钱，要么别买。”这一定是今天每家本地商店的口号。
从大多数公司在本地员工和本国职员之间的歧视性待遇——给予前者微薄津贴，而后者按黄金基准领取薪水——来看，人们会认为只有本国职员在承担涨价和附加费。也许他们认为本地员工懂得廉价生活的艺术。我们正面对一堵砖墙，当局无所作为，因为他们不在乎。他们没有受苦，所以何必担心那些正在受苦的较不幸的人呢！

疲惫的简
上海，6月14日

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUN 15 1939

Flour And Wheat

The opening price of native flour continued to rise in the market yesterday, and the second-grade product was quoted at $4.80 to outport dealers by the mills. Because of lack of supplies, mills refused to sell their goods at cheaper quotations.
Although the rate was higher, and a large demand was witnessed, local buyers dominated, and both North China and South Sea dealers absorbed a considerable amount for transportation. Business done in the market was estimated at 10,000 bags.
Also because of higher exchange rates the price of foreign flour strengthened and the market rate stood at $4.90. Both local and outport dealers bought 2,000 bags from the market.
The native wheat business still remained slight in yesterday's market, because the market received only a small shipment of newly-harvested native wheat from the interior. The opening price was quoted at $6.20. A few hundred bags of native wheat were purchased in the day's session.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》

1939年6月15日

面粉与小麦

昨日市场上国产面粉开盘价继续上涨，磨坊向外地经销商报价二等品为4.80美元。由于缺乏供应，磨坊拒绝以较低报价出售货物。
尽管价格较高，且需求旺盛，但本地买家占主导地位，华北和华南经销商也吸收了相当数量的货物用于运输。估计市场成交量为10,000包。
同样由于汇率较高，洋面粉价格走强，市场价为4.90美元。本地和外地经销商从市场购买了2,000包。
昨日市场上国产小麦交易依然清淡，因为市场仅收到来自内地的少量新收国产小麦。开盘价报价为6.20美元。当日交易中购买了数百包国产小麦。

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS.

JUN 15 1939

Rice Market

White rice was again irregular in the
market yesterday, as a small consignment
was brought from the interior by rail and
steamer, while no goods transported by
junkload were received by the market.
The total amount of rice received by
holders was more than 3,000 bags.
Owing to lower exchange, and reports
that Japanese authorities would close the
International Settlement on July 7, white
rice opened at $19.50 per picul, or $0.50
above the previous closing rate.
Local operators took active interest in
buying a considerable amount of first-
grade Changshu white rice and second-
grade at $18.50; low-grade was quoted at
$17.
Trading in provincial rice showed
strength in yesterday's market, when the
market received a message from the
growing-centers at Nanking and Wuhu
and declared that every picul of provincial
rice would be increased by $1 for the
time being.
Dealers were reluctant to buy at the
higher rate, and the opening price of
various kinds of provincial rice was irre-
gular by $0.40 and $0.60, while the Nanking
first-grade provincial rice stood at $16.50,
and the Wuhu provincial rice was quoted
at $16.20.
Local dealers offered fractional bids and
outport buyers bought a considerable
amount of low-grade provincial rice
at $14.60. The whole day's trading was
estimated at 7,000 bags of provincial rice.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。

1939年6月15日

米市

昨日白米行情再次波动，因有少量货物经铁路和轮船从内地运抵，而市场未收到任何经民船运输的货物。持货人收到的大米总量超过3,000包。由于汇率下跌，且有消息称日本当局将于7月7日关闭公共租界，白米开盘价为每担19.50美元，较前一交易日收盘价上涨0.50美元。

本地商人对购买大量一级常熟白米表现出浓厚兴趣，二级米价格为18.50美元；低级米报价为17美元。

外省米交易在昨日市场中表现坚挺，当时市场收到南京和芜湖产粮中心的消息，宣布暂时每担外省米价格上涨1美元。

经销商不愿以较高价格买入，各类外省米的开盘价波动幅度为0.40至0.60美元，其中南京一级外省米价格为16.50美元，芜湖外省米报价为16.20美元。

本地经销商出价零星，外地买家以14.60美元的价格购买了大量低级外省米。预计全天外省米交易量约为7,000包。

CHINA PRESS.
JUN 14 1939
Local Rice
Prices Soar
To New High
Monetary troubles and Japanese
interference yesterday joined hands
in driving the price of Changshu
white rice to $19 per picul,—the
highest rate registered in six
months.
Restricted supplies of rice arriv-
ing from the outports, where the
Japanese military authorities seek
to impose a new tax, apparently on
behalf of the puppet regime in
Nanking.
The local rice market witnessed
heated bidding yesterday, with all
kinds of rice enjoying gains ranging
from $0.30 to $0.50. Second grade
rice gained $0.30, to soar to $18.20
a picul.
With their orders for Saigon rice
cancelled a few days ago, local rice
firms quoted the Indo-China staple
at $20 a bag of 220 lbs., but there
were no buyers.
R
14/6
File
Cte

《字林西报》。
1939年6月14日
本地米价
飙升至
新高

昨日，货币危机与日本方面的干涉共同作用，推动常熟白米价格涨至每担19美元——创下六个月来的最高纪录。

来自外港的大米供应受限，日本军事当局试图在那里征收新税，显然是代表南京傀儡政权行事。

昨日本地米市竞价激烈，各类大米价格涨幅在0.30至0.50美元之间。二级米上涨0.30美元，飙升至每担18.20美元。

由于几天前取消了西贡大米的订单，本地米行将这种印度支那主要粮食品种报价为每袋（220磅）20美元，但无人问津。
R
14/6

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 1 4 1939
RISING PRICE TREND IN RICE MARKET
No Shortage Foreseen But Small Quantities Only Change Hands

The local rice market continued to display
a rising trend yesterday, when first quality cereals were
quoted at $17.05, showing an increase of five cents compared
with the day before, but little trading was recorded in the
commodity market, it was stated in local rice merchants
circles.

The rising trend, it was stated, was caused
by keen stocktaking among merchants, but holders displayed
little inclination to unload, with the result that only
small quantities were reported to have changed hands.

Kiangying, Kunshan, Soochow and other cereals
from the Nanking-Shanghai Railway cities were quoted at
from $17.10 to $17.60. The market generally ruled firm,
demand and supplies continued to maintain a steady balance.

According to a statement issued by the Shanghai
Provisional Dealers' Guild, the available stocks of rice
held by member merchants totalled 567,589 bags on Monday,
showing a decline of 11,371 bags as compared with last week.
However, the local available stocks were said to be sufficient to
meet local consumption for the next three months, by which
time more rice crops will be harvested in the inland areas.
No anxiety was therefore felt for a possible shortage of rice
in Shanghai, as under present circumstances, shipments of rice
to Shanghai from the interior have continued without
interruption, it was revealed.

《上海泰晤士报》。
1939年6月14日
米市价格呈上升趋势
预计不会出现短缺，但成交量仅少量

据本地米商圈子称，昨日本地米市继续呈现上升趋势，一级谷物报价为17.05美元，较前一日上涨5美分，但商品市场 recorded 的交易量很少。

据称，上升趋势是由商人积极盘点库存引起的，但持货人出货意愿不强，导致据报道仅有少量货物易手。

京盈（Kiangying，音译）、昆山、苏州以及其他来自京沪铁路沿线城市的谷物，报价在17.10至17.60美元之间。市场总体走势坚挺，供需继续保持平稳平衡。

根据上海临时米业公会发布的声明，周一会员商户持有的大米可用库存总计为567,589包，较上周减少11,371包。然而，据说本地可用库存足以满足未来三个月的本地消费，届时内地将有更多稻米收获。因此，鉴于目前情况下，从内地运往上海的米船一直未中断，人们对上海可能出现的米荒并不感到焦虑。

CHINA PRESS
JUN. 1 4 1939 .

Rice Market

Owing to the lack of supplies of fresh
rice and the monetary crisis, the market
price of white rice was irregular yester-
day. The first-grade of Changshu white
rice was quoted at $19,—the highest rate
in the last six month and $0.50 above the
preceding day's closing rate. Although
the weather remained warm, a brisk de-
mand by both local and outport dealers
was displayed in the market and a con-
siderable amount of rice was purchased
during the day.

With the Japanese authorities still de-
manding the payment of a new tax in the
interior, fresh supplies brought here totaled
only two junkloads and 2,000 bags of
white rice coming by steamer and rail.
Local buyers and rice holders took an
active interest in buying for stocks, push-
ing the price higher.

Local operators bought a few thousand
bags of second-grade white rice at $18.20,
or $0.30 above the last final rate. Rice
holders absorbed a considerable amount of
low-grade white rice at $17.50. The first-
grade of white rice dominated the market
although the selling price went up.

Business in provincial rice was very
strong and a very satisfactory price was
registered by sellers. A small shipment
of fresh supplies was brought here from
the ports of Nanking and Wuhu. The
opening price of Nanking provincial rice
was quoted at $0.50 above Monday's rate.

Local operators absorbed 3,000 bags of
both Nanking and Wuhu rice yesterday,
the former at $16.30 and the latter
from $14 to $16. The outport buyers
bought a large amount of provincial rice
for transportation. Ex. the low-grade
of provincial rice was quoted at $14, or
$0.30 higher than the preceding day's
closing rate. The total sales of various
kinds of provincial rice were estimated
at 6,500 bags.

《字林西报》
1939年6月14日

米市

由于缺乏新米供应以及货币危机，昨日白米市场价格波动。一级常熟白米报价为19美元，创过去六个月来的最高价，较前一交易日收盘价高出0.50美元。尽管天气持续炎热，但本地和外地经销商在市场上表现出旺盛的需求，当日购买了大量大米。

由于日本当局仍要求在内地缴纳新税，运抵此地的新鲜供应总量仅为两船民船装载量以及经轮船和铁路运来的2,000包白米。本地买家和持米人积极购入存货，推高了价格。

本地经营者以18.20美元的价格购买了数千包二级白米，较最后成交价高出0.30美元。持米人以17.50美元的价格吸纳了大量低级白米。尽管售价上涨，一级白米仍主导市场。

外省米交易非常活跃，卖方取得了非常令人满意的价格。一小批新鲜供应从南京和芜湖港口运抵此地。南京外省米的开盘价较周一报价高出0.50美元。

昨日本地经营者吸纳了3,000包南京和芜湖大米，前者价格为16.30美元，后者价格在14至16美元之间。外地买家购买了大量外省米用于运输。除外，低级外省米报价为14美元，较前一交易日收盘价高出0.30美元。各类外省米的总销量估计为6,500包。

CHINA PRESS.
JUN 1 4 1939

Flour And Wheat

Because of the higher rate of foreign exchange, the opening price of foreign flour stood at $5 in the market yesterday. The rate of foreign flour has thus risen by $0.70 during the last two weeks.

The price of native flour also went up, the mills supplying a small amount of native flour to both North China and South Sea buyers. Outport operators remained inactive, awaiting business improvement. Slight business was done throughout the day's trading.

The mills opened their price for liquidation to local dealers at a reasonable level. The second-grade product was quoted $0.05 higher, at $4.75, paid in order cheque, and foreign flour at $4.70 cash. Local buyers absorbed 2,000 bags of latter flour for stocks. A considerable amount of foreign flour was also purchased by wholesalers at $4.90 paid in order cheque, or $0.20 above the cash price.

A considerable shipment of newly-harvested native wheat was brought here from the interior yesterday, but none was sent to the market for liquidation by the holders, and no market rate was quoted.

Owing to the lower rate of newly-harvested native wheat in the market during last two weeks and the higher price of flour, the holders prefer to keep their goods in godown and await price improvement. Chinese mills will not be interested in buying until sometimes next week. Both the Japanese mills and outports were not in the market.

After the rice hongs here cancelled their order for foreign rice, the price of Saigon rice remained irregular in the market, the official rate having been declared at $20 per bag of 220 lbs. No business was done during the day's trading.

《字林西报》。
1939年6月14日

面粉与小麦

由于外汇汇率较高，昨日外国面粉的市场开盘价为5美元。因此，外国面粉的价格在过去两周内上涨了0.70美元。

国产面粉价格也上涨，磨坊向华北和南洋买家供应了少量国产面粉。外地经营者保持观望，等待业务改善。全天交易清淡。

磨坊以合理水平向本地经销商开出清仓价格。二级产品报价上涨0.05美元，至4.75美元，以订货支票支付；外国面粉现金价为4.70美元。本地买家吸收了2,000包后者面粉作为库存。批发商也以4.90美元的订货支票价格（即比现金价高0.20美元）购买了大量外国面粉。

昨日有一大批新收获的国产小麦从内地运抵此地，但持货人未将其送入市场进行清算，因此未报出市场价格。

由于过去两周市场上国产新麦价格较低，而面粉价格较高，持货人倾向于将货物存放在仓库中，等待价格改善。中国磨坊直到下周某个时候才会有兴趣购买。日本磨坊和外地市场均未参与交易。

在此地米行取消外国大米订单后，西贡大米的市场价格依然波动，官方宣布的价格为每袋（220磅）20美元。当日交易中没有达成任何业务。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.
JUN 13 1939

Rice Profiteering
The strong increase in the local
price level of native rice which
followed the second devaluation of
Chinese national currency is not
to be justified. The present price
of $18 per picul for first-grade
rice represents a price increase of
40 percent within a few months.
Its height is seriously affecting
the budget of the vast majority
of the local population.
Chinese importers of foreign
rice, apparently, are playing ball
with merchants securing supplies
from the hinterland to boost rice
prices further. The local Chinese
daily Shun Pao reports an appal-
ling story of exchange profiteering
on the part of a group of Shang-
hai Chinese rice merchants. These
merchants, some time ago, order-
ed a shipment of rice from Saigon
and obtained settlement of ex-
change at the former rates.
When last week the foreign ex-
change rates suddenly dropped,
these merchants preferred to can-
cel their rice contract and to pay
the penalty for cancelling, while
selling the exchange secured for
that rice in the local money mar-
ket, harvesting a substantial ex-
tra profit on exchange. Our voca-
bulary unfortunately lacks a
word strong enough to qualify
such action.

File
Rice
14/6

《上海晚邮报与水星报》。
1939年6月13日

大米投机

继中国法币第二次贬值之后，本地国产大米价格水平的强劲上涨是毫无道理的。一级大米目前每担18美元的价格，代表着几个月内价格上涨了40%。其高位严重影响了绝大多数本地人口的预算。

外国大米的中国进口商显然正与从内地获取供应的商人勾结，以进一步推高米价。本地中文日报《申报》报道了一起令人震惊的故事，讲述了一群上海中国米商进行汇兑投机的行为。这些商人在不久前订购了一批来自西贡的大米，并按旧汇率办理了汇兑结算。

当上周外汇汇率突然下跌时，这些商人宁愿取消大米合同并支付违约金，同时将为此批大米所获得的汇兑额度在本地货币市场上出售，从而在汇兑上攫取了巨额额外利润。不幸的是，我们的词汇中缺乏足够有力的词语来定性这种行为。

档案
大米
14/6

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 10 1939
4350

Prices On All Local Market
Provisions Showing Rise

Food Commodities Show Increase Of 15 To 30 Per
Cent; Flour Goes Up $1 Per Bag; Changes Of
Price In General Shops Expected Soon

Unable to predict the future value
of the Chinese dollar, or how long
it will remain at its present de-
pressed level, the merchants and
retailers of the city of Shanghai
have apparently arrived at the
quick conclusion that it is safer
for them to revalue their stocks
than to philosophize on economics,
according to a canvass of business
houses yesterday. Already new
price tags will be found on num-
erous commodities, both imported
and native, while a near-panic was
noted in some business and com-
mercial circles.

The more reputable firms were
using good judgment and acting in
a businesslike manner but other
shops were found to be merely
using the downward trend of the
Chinese currency to secure sub-
stantial price enlargement. Some
small Chinese shops and street
stalls were attempting to sell
matches, for instance, at five cents
per box, an increase of three cents
per box.

Among the most seriously affect-
ed classes of people, aside from
pure speculators, are the merchants
conducting import business. It was
revealed yesterday that many mer-
chants had placed large orders in
foreign currency and that these
orders had not as yet been paid
for in foreign exchange.

Importers' Meeting

Dollar quotations yesterday show-
ed a drop of 1½ pence as compared
with the rate for Wednesday. Local
importers in foreign goods yester-
day held an informal meeting to
exchange views about measures
that might be taken to safeguard
their interests.

Stores dealing in foreign mer-
chandise are doing a roaring trade,
that is, those stores that have not
as yet raised their prices. Several
of the leading department stores in

Increase In Price
Of Gasoline

It was announced by gasoline
distributors here yesterday that
from to-day the price of gasoline
at the pump will be increased by
ten cents per gallon, the price
moving up from $1.40 to $1.50 per
gallon.

the city have not as yet made any
changes in the price tags of their
merchandise, but from all indica-
tions they will put up prices next
week. Consequently, they have
been exceptionally busy during the
last few days since the public is
trying to spend its money now
and obtain necessities before the
rise.

Camera films, an item in constant
demand, have already risen 65 per
cent. in many department stores
and shops. The supply in many
quarters is very limited, however,
especially the 120 size, most com-
monly used. Even at the 65 per
cent. rise in the price of films, it
is not possible to obtain any large
quantities on the general market.

Housewives Suffer

Housewives going marketing to-
day may expect to pay a 15 to 30
per cent increase for their food pro-
visions. The S.M.C. Public Health
Department was busy yesterday try-
ing to obtain the compradore shops'
new prices. No doubt they will
compile new price lists to-day for
all provisions sold in the better type
of compradore shops.

Meat and pork have increased five
cents per pound yesterday over the
prices they were sold at previous
to the crash. Some of the better
and more select cuts were even sold
at a higher price, and no doubt, if
the value of the dollar remains low,
a still higher increase is to be
feared.

Flour, a commodity in universal
demand, sprang up almost instant-
ly after the news broke of the dol-
lar's decline. Flour is now selling
at $1 extra per-bag, an excessive
increase of two cents per pound.

Cigarettes And Tobacco

Prices of cigarettes and tobacco
will go up at the beginning of next
week, according to inquiries. The
Hwa Chang Tobacco Company, a
leading Chinese cigarette manufac-
turer, has already increased the
prices on certain brands popular
locally. The labouring classes, who
smoke a brand known as "The Rat,"
are going to suffer heavily since
they will now have to pay 20 cop-
pers for a package of 10 of these
cigarettes instead of 16 to 18 cop-
pers previously. The same applies
to various other kinds of cigarettes
popular with the poorer people, the
investigations reveal.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。
1939年6月10日
4350

本地市场所有副食品价格均呈上涨之势

食品类商品价格上涨15%至30%；面粉每袋上涨1美元；预计普通商店的价格也将很快变动

据昨日对各家商号的调查显示，由于无法预测中国货币未来的币值，也无法知晓其将在目前的低迷水平维持多久，上海城的商人和零售商显然已迅速得出结论：重新评估库存比空谈经济理论更为稳妥。目前，许多进口及国货商品上已贴上了新的价签，而在一些商业圈子里甚至出现了近乎恐慌的情绪。

较为信誉良好的商行判断得当，行事符合商业规范，但其他一些店铺被发现 merely 利用中国货币贬值的趋势来大幅抬高价格。例如，一些中国小 shop 和街边摊试图以每盒五分钱的价格出售火柴，每盒涨价三分钱。

除了纯粹的投机者外，受影响最严重的群体之一是从事进口业务的商人。昨日获悉，许多商人已以外币下了大量订单，但这些订单尚未以外汇支付。

进口商会议

昨日的美元报价较周三的汇率下跌了1½便士。昨日，本地洋货进口商举行了一次非正式会议，就可能采取的维护自身利益的措施交换意见。

经营洋货的商店生意兴隆，当然，这里指的是那些尚未提价的商店。市内几家主要百货公司

汽油价格上涨

此地的汽油分销商昨日宣布，从今天起，加油泵的汽油价格每加仑将上涨十美分，即从每加仑1.40美元涨至1.50美元。

尚未对其商品的价签进行任何更改，但从各种迹象来看，他们将在下周提价。因此，在过去几天里，这些商店异常忙碌，因为公众正试图在涨价前花掉手中的钱并购买必需品。

作为持续需求项目的照相胶卷，在许多百货公司和商店的价格已经上涨了65%。然而，许多地方的供应非常有限，尤其是最常用的120型胶卷。即使胶卷价格已上涨65%，在一般市场上仍无法买到大量现货。

家庭主妇受苦

今日前去采购的家庭主妇们可能要为其食品副食多支付15%至30%的费用。工部局公共卫生处昨日忙于获取买办商店的新价格。毫无疑问，他们将于今日编制一份在所有较优质的买办商店销售的副食品新价目表。

肉类和猪肉昨日的价格较崩盘前的售价每磅上涨了五分钱。一些较好且精选的部位甚至以更高的价格出售，而且毫无疑问，如果美元价值保持低位，恐怕还会有更大幅度的上涨。

面粉作为一种普遍需求的商品，在美元贬值的消息传出后几乎立即暴涨。目前面粉每袋额外加价1美元出售，相当于每磅过度上涨了二分钱。

香烟与烟草

据查询，香烟和烟草的价格将在下周初上涨。华昌烟草公司（Hwa Chang Tobacco Company）作为一家主要的中国香烟制造商，已经提高了某些在当地受欢迎的品牌的价格。那些吸食一种被称为“老鼠牌”（The Rat）香烟的劳工阶层将遭受重创，因为他们现在必须为每包10支的这种香烟支付20个铜板，而此前只需16至18个铜板。调查显示，其他几种受穷人欢迎的香烟情况也是如此。

page_data.en:
4351

The foreign cigarette manufactur-
ing firms may also increase prices
next week. If prices are increased
on their cigarettes and tobacco, the
import duties may also be increased
ad valorem, and this is generally
expected among general consumers
accustomed to Shanghai.
The tailoring business from all
appearances has not as yet decided
to increase prices, but declare that
the tailors certainly will increase
them the instant the wholesalers in-
crease the price of materials. The
local financial situation is still in a
state of flux, one large tailoring firm
stated they did not anticipate taking
steps in this direction as yet.

Cereals
The depreciation in Chinese cur-
rency in terms of foreign exchange
is tending to aid the marketing of
Chinese cereals, further inquiries re-
veal. Imported rice, for instance, is
being paid for in foreign exchange
and consequently it cannot be
sold at competitive prices with the
native cereals. Prices for first qua-
lity white rice were quoted at $17.50
per picul, showing an increase of
50 cents already compared with last
week-end. Medium and lower qua-
lity rices also has increased from
40 to 50 cents, following reaction to
depreciation in Chinese currency.
Local rice merchants however,
view this as only a temporary situa-
tion, and expect that the prices will
again find their lower levels because
shipments of rice into Shanghai
from the Inland cities continue to
be very brisk

Hardware Dealers
Hardware dealers also are expect-
ed to revise their price lists early
next week. The Shanghai Hard-
ware Dealers Guild may hold a
meeting at 4 o'clock to-day to take
a final decision on the matter. They
contend that American and Euro-
pean hardware manufacturers are
revising their price lists and in-
creasing the prices from 20 to 30
per cent. They maintain that to
cover their losses, they must make
a corresponding revision in their
price lists.
Many other commodities in con-
stant demand are expected to be
raised the beginning of next week
unless the exchange rate returns
to a more normal level, it was
learnt. More details regarding the
increase of food commodities in
the local compradore shops will in
all probability be available to-day.
Local coal merchants, it appears,
have also revised their price lists.
Indian coal was quoted yesterday
at $43 per ton, Kaiping at $43,
Hongay coal at $48, Kaiping coal
dust at $39.50 and Kaiping second-
grade coal at $28. Coal lumps were
quoted at $29 per ton.
Prices in the Hongkew district
are also in line for an increase,
and contrary to popular belief,
they are not cheaper than those of
the rest of Shanghai, in general.
page_data.zh:
4351

外国香烟制造公司下周也可能提高价格。如果其香烟和烟草价格上调，从价进口关税也可能随之增加，这在习惯于上海生活的普通消费者中是普遍预期的。

从各方面情况来看，裁缝业尚未决定提价，但声称一旦批发商提高材料价格，裁缝们肯定会立即提价。一家大型裁缝店表示，本地金融局势仍处于动荡状态，他们预计目前不会采取这方面的行动。

谷物

进一步的调查显示，中国货币对外汇的贬值趋势倾向于促进中国谷物的销售。例如，进口大米需用外汇支付，因此无法以与国货谷物竞争的价格出售。上等白米的价格报为每担17.50美元，较上周末已上涨50美分。受中国货币贬值反应的影响，中等和下等大米的价格也上涨了40至50美分。

然而，本地米商认为这只是暂时情况，并预计价格将再次回落至较低水平，因为来自内陆城市运往上海的米船运输依然非常繁忙。

五金经销商

预计五金经销商也将在下周初修订价目表。上海五金同业公会可能于今日四时召开会议，就此事项做出最终决定。他们声称，美国和欧洲的五金制造商正在修订价目表，并将价格提高20%至30%。他们坚持认为，为了弥补损失，他们必须对价目表进行相应的修订。

据悉，除非汇率恢复到更正常的水平，否则许多其他持续需求的商品预计将在下周初涨价。关于本地买办商店食品类商品涨价的更多详情，很可能于今日公布。

看来本地煤商也已修订了价目表。昨日印度煤报价为每吨43美元，开平煤为43美元，洪崖（Hongay）煤为48美元，开平煤屑为39.50美元，开平二等煤为28美元。块煤报价为每吨29美元。

虹口地区的价格也面临上涨，而且与普遍看法相反，总体而言，那里的价格并不比上海其他地区便宜。

CHINA PRESS.

JUN 10 1939

Flour And Wheat

The price of both native and foreign
flour was irregularly higher in yesterday's
market. Outport dealers asked for cheaper
quotations during the current wheat
harvesting season, but the mills refused
to lower their price pending the stabiliza-
tion of Chinese national currency.
Second-grade native flour official opened
yesterday at $4.55 in order cheque, or
$0.10 above the preceding day's final rate.
Both the North China and South Sea traders
were reluctant to buy for transportation,
and awaited further improvement. For-
eign flour brought a good price at li-
quidation.
Local operators bought a considerable
amount of second-grade native flour at the
market price, and also bought few thou-
sand bags of "Kao Tang" at $0.10 above
Wednesday's closing rate.
Later in the session, Tientsin dealers
absorbed a large amount of native and
foreign flour for their stocks. The former
was quoted at $4.50 and the latter at
$4.55.
Trading in newly-harvested native wheat
was still very slight and narrow yesterday.
Although the market received a large
amount of sample bags for liquidation,
the mills were not interested in buying,
because some of the newly-harvested native
wheat was shipped directly to the mills.
Chinese mills did not buy the newly-
harvested native wheat in the market yes-
terday because of its wetness and also
because of large supplies of foreign wheat
in stock.
The interior producers sold a consider-
able amount of newly-harvested native
wheat in the market to foreign mills at
an undisclosed price. The wheat will be
delivered to mills in a fortnight. The
stocked native wheat was still quoted at
$5.90, but no sales to local buyers were
recorded. There were 140 bags of newly-
harvested native wheat brought here from
Nanking and shipped directly to the
Japanese mills at $5.70 per bag.

《大美晚报》。

1939年6月10日

面粉与小麦

昨日市场上，国产和进口面粉的价格均出现不规则上涨。在外埠正值小麦收获季节之际，外地经销商要求更便宜的报价，但磨坊主拒绝降价，以待中国法币稳定。

昨日，二等国产面粉的官方开盘价为凭期票4.55美元，较前一日最终收盘价高出0.10美元。华北和华南的交易商都不愿购货运出，而是等待进一步改善。进口面粉在清算交易中价格良好。

本地经营者按市场价购买了相当数量的二等国产面粉，并以高于周三收盘价0.10美元的价格购买了数千袋“高汤”（Kao Tang，音译）牌面粉。

交易后期，天津经销商吸收了大量国产和进口面粉作为库存。前者报价为4.50美元，后者为4.55美元。

昨日，新收获的国产小麦交易仍然非常清淡且范围狭窄。尽管市场收到了大量用于清算的样袋，但磨坊主无意购买，因为部分新收获的国产小麦已直接运往磨坊。

昨日中国磨坊主未在市场上购买新收获的国产小麦，原因是其湿度较大，且库存中有大量进口小麦。

内地生产商以未公开的价格向外国磨坊出售了相当数量的新收获国产小麦。这批小麦将在两周内交付给磨坊。库存国产小麦的报价仍为5.90美元，但未记录到向本地买家的销售。有140袋新收获的国产小麦从南京运抵此处，并以每袋5.70美元的价格直接运往日本磨坊。

CHINA PRESS.
JUN 10 1929
Rice Market
Reports current in the market yesterday
claimed the stoppage of rice supplies from
the port of Minghow. Only 2,700 bags
of white rice were brought here by steamer
and rail during the day. Despite the di-
minished flow of fresh supplies, the open-
ing price in the market was very weak,
and no big deals were recorded throughout
the day.
Owing to the advent of heat, no brisk
demand was shown by the dealers. Con-
sequently, the price of first-grade white
rice dropped by $0.20. Outport dealers
were not buying for transportation, and
bought second-grade rice at a cheaper
rate in small amounts.
Local operators absorbed a few thousand
bags of Changchow first-grade rice at
$17.40. Second-grade and low-grade white
rice dropped by $0.10 each. The whole
day's trading was very slight.
Trading in provincial rice was very
satisfactory yesterday, and favorable busi-
ness was done throughout the day by
various operators. Considerable supplies
of rice arrived here yesterday from Nan-
king and Wuhu.
A better demand for Hauchow low-grade
provincial rice, which was recently shipped
to here for liquidation was displayed in
the market yesterday, and the price was
quoted at $11.70. Outport dealers do-
minated the bidding.
Local operators bought about 2,000 bags
of Nanking first-grade white rice at the
unchanged rate of $14.80 and Wuhu pro-
vincial rice at $14.50. The interior buyers
absorbed 1,000 bags of low-grade provin-
cial rice at $12.60, or $0.20 below the
previous closing rate.

《大美晚报》。
1929年6月10日
米市

昨日市场上流传的报告称，明霍（Minghow，音译）港的大米供应停止。当日仅有2,700袋白米通过轮船和铁路运抵此处。尽管新鲜供应减少，但市场开盘价非常疲软，全天未记录到大宗交易。

由于天气炎热，经销商并未表现出旺盛的需求。因此，一等白米的价格下跌了0.20美元。外地经销商未购货运出，仅以较低价格少量购买了二等米。

本地经营者以17.40美元的价格吸收了数千袋常州一等米。二等和低等白米各下跌0.10美元。全天的交易量非常小。

昨日外省米交易令人非常满意，各类经营者全天业务良好。昨日有大量大米从南京和芜湖运抵此处。

市场对近期运抵此处用于清算的杭州低等外省米的需求有所好转，报价为11.70美元。外地经销商主导了竞价。

本地经营者以14.80美元的不变价格购买了约2,000袋南京一等白米，并以14.50美元的价格购买了芜湖外省米。内地买家以12.60美元的价格吸收了1,000袋低等外省米，较前一收盘价低0.20美元。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 10 1939
14348

SHANGHAI STRESS
While the politically minded talk glibly about the "China situation," the actual conditions in Shanghai are giving rise to a great deal of anxiety to people on the spot. The report for May issued by the Industrial Section of the Shanghai Municipal Council shows the mounting cost of living and the growing plight of the workers. The further drop in the value of the Chinese dollar, owing to the withdrawal of support by the Anglo-Chinese Stabilization Fund, has struck an additional blow at large numbers of people in this town who are dependent upon the preservation of the value of the Chinese dollar at a reasonable figure to make ends meet. The explanation given to Reuter in Hongkong by authoritative circles on the subject of this action is worthy of special note. It is to the effect that the "Control temporarily withdrew its support to allow the exchange value of the dollar to be adjusted to a better economic level, and thereby bring the balance of trade into equilibrium." "As will be remembered," it goes on, "a similar step was taken in June, 1938, and when the level of eightpence was found, it was successfully maintained for a period of twelve months. It is confidently believed that a new level has now been found, and can be strongly maintained." Some days must elapse, we presume, before that level is definitely known, but if it is to be little more than sixpence, it is obvious that there must be heavy losses on the part of many people in Shanghai before things are readjusted for ordinary business purposes. Unfortunately, for many wage earners, both foreigners and Chinese, there is little hope of an early readjustment which will compensate for the very low level which the Chinese dollar now seems likely to take up. Even the poorest class of Chinese workers who do not buy any foreign goods cannot wholly escape, for reductions in the foreign exchange value of currencies of this nature must affect everyone ultimately and go right down to the lowest grades of society. There is little doubt that the prices of local goods and services will have to be raised considerably and that some time must elapse before business is able to feel at ease under a new set of conditions. Still worse, however, is the uncertainty as to future developments, and particularly the fear that the dollar will decline further, even if it should be pegged again for a time by the Stabilization Fund at around sixpence or sixpence-halfpenny. This fear is enhanced by the realization that the British Government's participation in the Stabilization Fund is rather a gesture of goodwill to those who are working in China under adverse conditions than an obligation on the part of Great Britain. Only the conclusion of the Sino-Japanese hostilities can, it seems to us, bring about conditions conducive to real health in commerce and industry in this country.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》。
1939年6月10日
14348

上海的困境

虽然那些关心政治的人滔滔不绝地谈论“中国局势”，但上海的实际状况却令当地人士深感焦虑。上海公共租界工部局工业科发布的五月份报告显示，生活成本不断上升，工人的处境日益艰难。由于英中平准基金撤回支持，中国法币价值进一步下跌，这对本市大量依赖法币维持在合理汇率以维持生计的人群造成了额外打击。权威人士在香港向路透社解释此举时提出的理由值得特别关注。其大意是：“平准基金暂时撤回支持，以便让法币的汇价调整至更合理的经济水平，从而使贸易收支恢复平衡。”报告接着说：“正如人们所记得的那样，1938年6月曾采取过类似措施，当时在找到八便士的水平后，成功维持了十二个月。现在人们深信已经找到了一个新的水平，并且能够有力地维持下去。”我们推测，要确切知道这一水平尚需数日时间，但如果该水平仅略高于六便士，那么在为正常商业目的重新调整之前，上海的许多人显然将遭受重大损失。不幸的是，对于许多外籍和华籍工薪阶层来说，几乎没有什么希望能在短期内进行调整，以弥补中国法币目前似乎可能达到的极低水平。即使是最贫穷的不购买任何外国商品的中国工人阶级也无法完全幸免，因为此类货币外汇价值的降低最终必然影响所有人，并波及社会的最底层。毫无疑问，本地商品和服务的价格将不得不大幅上涨，而且需要一段时间才能使商界在新的条件下感到安心。然而，更糟糕的是对未来发展的不确定性，特别是担心即使平准基金再次将法币暂时固定在六便士或六便士半左右，法币仍会进一步下跌。这种担忧因人们认识到英国政府参与平准基金与其说是英国的义务，不如说是对在不利条件下在华工作者的一种善意姿态而加剧。在我们看来，只有结束中日敌对状态，才能为本国工商业带来真正健康的有利条件。

page_data.en:
14349

While the question of livelihood
continues to worry many of the less
privileged people in Shanghai, the political
situation also casts its shadow of anxiety
on the scene. The troubles in Pootung
culminating in the death of Mr. R. M.
Tinkler—whatever the rights and wrongs
of the case, and as a proper inquiry will
be held into the manner in which Mr.
Tinkler met his death, we cannot express
any opinion on this subject—have
certainly not improved feeling between
Britons and Japanese here. In Tientsin,
the refusal of the British authorities to
hand over to the Japanese four Chinese
alleged to have been involved in the
murder of Mr. Cheng Shi-kang, Commis-
sioner of Customs, has led the Japanese
authorities to threaten extreme measures
against the Concession and is a fresh
source of irritation. The Kulangsu situa-
tion has not been settled and there has
been a renewal of agitation among Britons
and other foreigners for removal of the
restrictions on trading in the Yangtze
Valley and elsewhere. The average
unprejudiced person reacts to all this
with the pious wish that the hostilities
might be speedily ended and that some
sort of settlement might be reached in
the Far East which could be found work-
able by all parties. Of this, unfortunately,
at the moment there seems little prospect.
The only thing is for everyone concerned
to keep their heads and work steadily
and soberly day by day to make the best
of what appears to be a very bad job.
That some people are getting off very
lightly, if not actually profiting, under
the present unhappy conditions is natur-
ally exasperating to those who are bearing
the most crushing burdens but the
knowledge must be borne as courageously
as possible. There is a demand for every
reasonable economy, particularly in the
matter of public expenditure, and we
must hope that the Shanghai Municipal
Council will give a strong lead in this
direction. Restraint is called for on the
part of those who are able to profit by
the present conditions and the action of
certain landlords in putting up the rentals
of their premises to exorbitant figures is
to be deplored. Although it can be
argued that in quite recent years property
owners have not made particularly large
profits the idea that now is the oppor-
tunity to put on the screw is neither
public-spirited nor wise. Should there be
a serious breakdown in the economy of
Shanghai, property owners will suffer,
too, and it is wise to give the "smaller
man" a chance, and it is the "smaller
man," and not the large firms and cor-
porations, who is suffering acutely now.
page_data.zh:
14349

尽管生计问题继续困扰着上海许多弱势群体，政治局势也给现场投下了焦虑的阴影。浦东的骚乱以 R. M. Tinkler 先生之死达到高潮——无论此案是非曲直如何，鉴于将对 Tinkler 先生的死因进行适当调查，我们对此事不发表任何意见——但这确实没有改善此地英日两国人士之间的关系。在天津，英国当局拒绝向日方移交四名涉嫌参与杀害海关监督程锡庚先生的中国人，导致日本当局威胁对租界采取极端措施，这成为了新的摩擦源。鼓浪屿局势尚未解决，英国人和其他外国人再次发起运动，要求取消长江流域及其他地区贸易限制。普通的无偏见人士对所有这些情况的反应都是虔诚地希望敌对行动能迅速结束，并在远东达成某种各方都能接受的解决方案。不幸的是，目前看来这种前景渺茫。唯一能做的就是所有相关人士保持冷静，日复一日地稳步、理智地工作，尽量应对这看似非常糟糕的局面。当然，有些人目前在不幸的条件下过得相当轻松，甚至实际上从中获利，这让那些承受最沉重负担的人感到愤怒，但必须尽可能勇敢地承受这一现实。人们呼吁实行一切合理的节约措施，特别是在公共支出方面，我们希望上海公共租界工部局能在此方面发挥强有力的带头作用。那些能够从当前局势中获利的人需要克制，某些房东将其房屋租金提高到荒谬水平的行为令人遗憾。虽然可以辩称，在近几年里，业主们并没有获得特别大的利润，但认为现在是加紧盘剥的机会，这种想法既缺乏公德心也不明智。如果上海经济发生严重崩溃，业主们也将遭受损失，因此给“小人物”一个机会是明智之举，而现在深受其苦的正是这些“小人物”，而非大型商号和公司。

CHINA PRESS.

JUN 8 1939

Rice Market

Owing to the weather becoming not again
yesterday, the demand for white rice was
slight in the market, and the price re-
mained weak throughout the day's trading.
The outport dealers are reluctant to buy
more rice for stock, while local traders
did some fractional buying.

There was an oversupply of white rice,
because the holders were hurrying to sell
their supplies before the advent of the
damp season. The market continued to
receive fresh supplies, 3,000 bags of
white rice coming from the interior by
steamer and rail.

The opening price of Changchow first-
grade white rice fell by $0.10 below the
preceding day's final rate.

Local dealers bought a considerable
amount of low-grade white rice at $0.20
below Tuesday's closing rate. A slight
business was done in the market yester-
day.

The opening price of provincial rice
was weak, the price of high-grade pro-
vincial rice rose by $0.50, and the rest
fell by from $0.10 to $0.20. Both outport
and interior traders were not in the
market.

Taking advantage of lower quotations
on provincial rice, local dealers bought
a large amount of second-grade Wuhu
provincial rice. The total sales were
estimated at more than 3,000 bags of
various kinds of provincial rice.

The first-grade of Nanking provincial
rice was quoted at $14.50, the price re-
maining unchanged, the Wuhu provincial
rice sold at $12.90, and the low-grade of
provincial rice was quoted at from $12.50
to $12.90.

《大美晚报》。

1939年6月8日

米市

由于昨日天气仍未放晴，市场上对白米的需求微弱，全天交易价格持续疲软。外埠客商不愿多购大米入库，而本地商人则进行了少量零星采购。

由于持货者急于在潮湿季节来临前出售存货，白米供应过剩。市场继续收到新货，有3,000包白米通过轮船和铁路从内地运抵。

常州一等白米的开盘价较前一日收盘价下跌0.10美元。

本地商人以低于周二收盘价0.20美元的价格购买了大量低等级白米。昨日市场交易清淡。

外省米开盘价疲软，高等级外省米价格上涨0.50美元，其余品种下跌0.10至0.20美元。外埠和内地商人均未入市。

利用外省米报价较低的机会，本地商人购买了大量二等芜湖外省米。估计各类外省米总销量超过3,000包。

南京一等外省米报价为14.50美元，价格保持不变；芜湖外省米售价为12.90美元；低等级外省米报价在12.50至12.90美元之间。

CHINA PRESS.

JUN 2 1959

Flour And Wheat

Despite the suspension of sale of foreign
exchange by local foreign banks, the
opening price of native flour was very
firm in the market yesterday, although
foreign flour was quoted below native
flour.
Outport buyers were not interested in
buying at the market rate yesterday, and
bought fractionally for transportation,
having heavy supplies of foreign flour on
hand. The mills kept their price on the
level of Tuesday's final rate, and the
second-grade product was quoted at $4.40,
paid by order cheque.
Local buyers bought more than 8,000
bags of native flour in the market at
the above price. Both North China and
South Sea operators absorbed 20,000 bags.
The day's turnover was estimated at
30,000 bags of native wheat. No business
in foreign flour was recorded yesterday.
Trading in newly-harvested native wheat
continued narrow in the market yester-
day. The opening price was unfavorable.
The newly-harvested native wheat did not
interest the operators, because the mills
have already sent their representatives to
the growing centers directly to collect the
newly-harvested wheat at a lower price.
The market received 43 sample bags of
Kaiting native newly-harvested wheat,
quoted at $5.45 per bag. The supply was
immediately absorbed by local operators.
The price of stocked native wheat opened
at $5.80, and 300 bags were purchased by
local mills.

《大美晚报》。

1959年6月2日 [注：原文年份疑似OCR错误，根据上下文应为1939年]

面粉与小麦

尽管本地外资银行暂停出售外汇，但昨日国产面粉的开盘价在市场上非常坚挺，尽管洋面粉的报价低于国产面粉。

昨日外埠买家对按市场价购买兴趣不大，仅因运输需要进行了零星采购，因为他们手头存有大量洋面粉。各磨坊将价格维持在周二的最终水平，二等产品报价为4.40美元，凭指令支票支付。

本地买家以上述价格在市场上购买了8,000多包国产面粉。华北和华南运营商共吸纳了20,000包。

当日成交量估计为30,000包国产小麦。昨日没有记录到洋面粉的交易。

昨日市场上刚收获的国产小麦交易依然狭窄。开盘价不利。运营商对新收获的国产小麦不感兴趣，因为各磨坊已直接派遣代表前往产区，以较低价格收购新麦。

市场收到43袋样品嘉兴（Kaiting，音译）产新收国产小麦，报价为每袋5.45美元。这批货源随即被本地运营商吸纳。

库存国产小麦开盘价为5.80美元，本地磨坊购买了300包。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI TIMES.

JUN 7 1939

Improvement In Rice Marts
As Supplies Increase

Many Local Merchants Reported Overstocked As
Shipments From Interior Come In Regularly;
No Fears Of Shortage In Shanghai Areas

A distinct improvement in the local rice situation was reported to have been noted yesterday, and no anxiety was felt for any possible shortage of cereals for sometime to come, according to local rice merchants.

Heavy shipments of rice from the Nanking-Shanghai Railway areas, such as Soochow, Wusih, Changshu, and from Wuhu and other rice-producing areas, it was stated, have been made by local merchants, thus tending to swell the available stocks of rice in the local market. Local flour mills were also said to be making ready to undertake heavy shipment of wheat into Shanghai from the inland areas in Chekiang and Kiangsu. The 2,000 tons of Saigon rice, consigned by Messrs. Louis Dreyfus and Company, on behalf of local rice merchants, it was stated, are expected to arrive in Shanghai sometime next week.

According to a statement issued by the Shanghai Provision Dealers' Guild, the local available stocks of rice held by the various rice merchants on Monday totalled 578,959 bags, showing an increase of 16,767 bags as compared with the stocks of the previous week. As more rice has continued to arrive in Shanghai, no anxiety, local rice merchants stated, was being felt for a possible shortage of cereals for sometime to come.

The advent of the summer, it was further stated, would find more rice from the Pootung and surrounding areas of Shanghai being shipped to this city. Rice dealers as a whole, they added, had of late shown a greater inclination to unload their stocks on the local market, as the hot summer weather does not permit of over-stocking without danger of damage to the grains.

The immediate result of the steady increase in rice stocks has affected the prices. Changshu white rice was yesterday quoted at $17.10 per picul, and first quality Wusih rice at $16.90. All other cereals have also dropped by 10 to 20 cents per picul as compared with last week-end, it was reported.

Merchants Overstocked

As most of the local rice merchants have overstocked, they are generally not keen to buy in more cereals, but shipments, nevertheless, have continued to arrive. Hence, the wild fluctuations in prices which only two weeks ago were creating confusion in the local rice market, it was stated, have now subsided, and the market has generally ruled firm and taken on a more steady undertone. A further depressing trend was anticipated for the next few weeks in local rice merchants' circles yesterday in view of the fact that harvest time has drawn near, and more rice would shortly be imported into Shanghai from outlying areas. All in all, many factors have operated to bring a better outlook to the local rice market, as far as the general public is concerned.

1939年6月7日

随着供应增加，米市状况改善

随着内地货物定期运抵，许多本地商人报告存货过剩；上海地区无需担心短缺

据本地米商称，昨日观察到本地大米状况有明显改善，且在可预见的未来不会对谷物可能出现短缺感到焦虑。

据悉，本地商人已从京沪铁路沿线地区（如苏州、无锡、常熟）以及芜湖和其他产米区大量装运大米，从而增加了本地市场的可用库存。据说本地面粉厂也正准备从浙江和江苏内陆地区向上海大量装运小麦。据悉，由路易·德雷福斯公司（Messrs. Louis Dreyfus and Company）代表本地米商托运的2,000吨西贡大米，预计将于下周某个时候抵达上海。

根据上海米业公会发布的声明，周一各米商持有的本地可用大米库存总计为578,959包，较上周库存增加16,767包。本地米商表示，随着更多大米持续运抵上海，人们对未来一段时间内可能出现的谷物短缺不再感到焦虑。

此外还指出，随着夏季的到来，将有更多来自浦东及上海周边地区的大米运往本市。他们补充说，最近米商整体上更倾向于在本地市场抛售库存，因为炎热的夏季天气使得过量囤积粮食面临受损的风险。

大米库存的稳步增加立即影响了价格。昨日常熟白米报价为每担17.10美元，无锡一等米为16.90美元。据报道，与其他上周末相比，所有其他谷物的价格也每担下降了10至20美分。

商人存货过剩

由于大多数本地米商存货过剩，他们普遍不愿再购买更多谷物，但 shipments（货运）仍在继续抵达。因此，据悉两周前造成本地米市混乱的价格剧烈波动现已平息，市场总体走势坚挺，呈现出更加稳定的基调。鉴于收获季节临近，且将有更多大米从外围地区进口到上海，昨日本地米商圈子预计未来几周价格将进一步走低。总而言之，就公众而言，许多因素已使本地米市的前景好转。

JUN 7 1939

Rice Market

After a few weeks' downward trend, the
opening price of white rice rose yester-
day when only three junkloads and 2,000
bags of white rice were brought here
from the interior by steamer and rail.
Owing to rain and cool weather, only a
small amount of rice was displayed in the
market, and the selling price was kept
very steady by the holders, while a brisk
demand was shown by the dealers seeking
to replenish their stocks.
Local operators took active interest in
buying yesterday and the price rose $0.20
above Monday's final closing rate. Out-
port traders also absorbed a considerable
amount at the market rate for transpor-
tation. The first-grade of Changchow
white rice was quoted at $17.20 and other
kinds of rice showed similar increases.
A report current in the market yester-
day held that the stoppage of rice supplies
from Changchow in last few days has
been caused by the Changchow authori-
ties seeking to impose a new tax.
Business in provincial rice was very
quiet and steady in the market yesterday,
and the price remained very satisfactory,
while a large amount of provincial rice
was purchased by both local and outport
buyers.
Local operators absorbed a considerable
amount of Nanking provincial rice, the
price being quoted at $14.90, or $0.30
above the previous closing price, while the
interior traders were reluctant to buy for
stocks. Outport dealers bought a few
thousand bags of Wuhu provincial rice
at $14.50 and second-grade at $13.50.
Low-grade provincial rice was quoted at
$12.50.
Total sales of Nanking and Wuhu rice
during the day were estimated at 4,000
bags.

1939年6月7日

米市

在经历了几周的下跌趋势后，昨日白米开盘价上涨，当时仅有三船载量及2,000袋白米通过轮船和铁路从内地运抵此处。由于下雨且天气凉爽，市场上陈列的米量很少，持货商将售价维持得非常稳定，而寻求补货的经销商则表现出旺盛的需求。

本地经营者昨日积极买入，价格较周一的最终收盘价上涨了0.20美元。外埠交易商也按市场行市吸纳了相当数量的大米以供运输。常州一级白米报价为17.20美元，其他种类的米也出现了类似的涨幅。

昨日市场上流传的一份报告称，近几日常州大米供应中断的原因是常州当局试图征收新税。

昨日市场上外省米的交易非常清淡且平稳，价格保持令人满意的水平，同时本地和外埠买家购买了大量的外省米。

本地经营者吸纳了相当数量的南京外省米，报价为14.90美元，较前一收盘价高出0.30美元，而内地商人不愿进货囤积。外埠经销商以14.50美元的价格购买了几千袋芜湖外省米，二级米价格为13.50美元。低级外省米报价为12.50美元。

估计当日南京米和芜湖米的总销量为4,000袋。

CHINA PRESS

JUN 7 1939

Flour And Wheat

With flour and wheat offered at lower
prices than native wheat, operator interest
yesterday was focused on the former.

The market received 100,000 bags of
foreign wheat yesterday for liquidation,
and the price was quoted at $3.90, paid
by order cheque, or $0.10 below the price
of native wheat. Nor'a China operators
bought a large amount of flour. A few
hundred bags of native flour were pur-
chased by Tientsin traders.

The mills refused to sell at a lower
price to all the dealers in the market
yesterday, having only a limited supply
of flour in stock. The price of both
native and foreign wheat should weaken
further when the newly-harvested wheat
reaches the market in a day or two, it
was learned yesterday.

Local buyers did some fractional buying
of native wheat, and the price remained
unchanged at $4.40, paid in cheque. The
total sales of native wheat during the day
reached 50,000 bags.

Owing to the large quantity of foreign
flour in stock and the continued arrival
of native wheat, the newly-harvested
native wheat did not attract the mills
in the market yesterday. The opening
price of newly-harvested wheat opened
low, as there were only a few hundred
bags of sample wheat available for
quotation.

Fifty sample bags of Cheng Moo
native newly-harvested wheat arrived here
for liquidation in the market yesterday,
the opening price being quoted at $5.43
per bag, and Nanking newly-harvested
wheat opened at $6. The price of stocked
native wheat continued to be quoted at
$4.80, and 300 bags were absorbed by
local buyers.

1939年6月7日

面粉与小麦

由于面粉和小麦的报价低于本土小麦，昨日经营者的兴趣集中在前者。

昨日市场接收了10万袋用于清算的外国小麦，报价为3.90美元，凭指令支票支付，比本土小麦价格低0.10美元。华北经营者购买了大量面粉。天津商人购买了几百袋本土面粉。

昨日面粉厂拒绝以更低的价格向市场上的所有经销商出售，因为其库存面粉有限。据悉，当新一季收获的小麦在一两天内上市时，本土和外国小麦的价格都应会进一步走弱。

本地买家零星购买了一些本土小麦，价格保持在4.40美元不变，以支票支付。当日本土小麦的总销量达到5万袋。

由于库存外国面粉数量巨大，加上本土小麦持续到货，昨日新收获的本土小麦并未吸引市场上的面粉厂。新收获小麦的开盘价低开，因为仅有几百袋样麦可供报价。

昨日有五十袋样品的成牟（Cheng Moo，音译）本土新麦运抵此处进行市场清算，开盘价报价为每袋5.43美元，南京新麦开盘价为6美元。库存本土小麦的报价继续维持在4.80美元，本地买家吸纳了300袋。

CHINA PRESS
JUN 6 1939
Living Costs
Here Continue
Trend Upward
April Index 2.06 Pts.
Above Figure
For March
The general index of the cost of living of the workers in Shanghai rose continuously during the first four months of 1939, according to a survey made by the Chinese Economic and Statistical review.
The index for April was 2.06 points above the figure for March. It was also 3.39 points above the figure for March, 1938, and 53.57 points above the index for July, 1937, or the month of the Japanese invasion of China.
Comparing the April figures for the group indices with those of the previous month, the food group rose by 3.4 points, clothing by 2.96 and the miscellaneous group by 0.58. Fuel alone dropped by 5.14 points, but that was little consolation because of the advent of warm weather.
Partly because of the appreciation of rice in rice-producing districts caused by direct shipments to North China and partly due to speculation of unscrupulous local merchants, local rice quotations continued to go up in the month under review. When at its highest, the first grade of white rice had passed the $14 limit. Taking the retail prices of rice included in this index as an example, the average quotation for glutinous rice per shih rose by $3.246, or 22.38%, as compared with the previous month, that for first grade sien rice, i.e., rice from neighboring provinces, by $1.398, or 11.54% and that for the second grade non-glutinous rise, by $1.296 or 11.06%.
Rice Affects Index
The rise of the index of the food group in the month under review reflected, to a large extent, the influences of these quotations. Other items showing a gain in the food group included scallions, rising by 7.50%, soy bean oil, by 7.26%, chickens, by 5.08%, etc.
The prices of wheat flour, yellow bean sprouts, turnips, greens, however, all showed a fall. In the clothing group most of the items showed an advance in price, because the demand for them was in excess of their supply. The price of printed shirtings, rose most, appreciating by 15.70%. The next was striped shirtings, rising by 11.46% and the third cotton socks by 7.95%.
The price quotations in the Fuel group unanimously dropped. The three outstanding cases were firewood, dropping 10.84%, charcoal, dropping 7.71% and coal briquettes, dropping 4.21%. Some time ago, charcoal was banned from being exported from Wenchow. In the beginning of the month under review, the ban was lifted; hence the decline of the price. On account of increased production and competition among rival companies, the price of coal briquettes also decreased.

1939年6月6日
本地生活费用
继续呈上升趋势
四月指数比
三月数据高2.06点

根据《中国经济统计评论》的一项调查，1939年前四个月，上海工人生活费用总指数持续上升。

四月的指数比三月高出2.06点。也比1938年3月的数据高出3.39点，比1937年7月（即日本侵华的那个月）的指数高出53.57点。

将各分类指数的四月数据与上月相比，食品类上涨3.4点，衣着类上涨2.96点，杂项类上涨0.58点。唯有燃料类下跌5.14点，但由于天气转暖，这几乎算不上什么安慰。

部分原因是由于直接运往华北导致产米区米价升值，部分原因是由于本地不法商人的投机行为，回顾月份内的本地米价报价持续上涨。在最高峰时，一级白米已突破14美元的关口。以纳入该指数的米零售价格为例，糯米每石的平均报价较上月上涨3.246美元，即22.38%；一级籼米（即邻省米）上涨1.398美元，即11.54%；二级非糯米上涨1.296美元，即11.06%。

米价影响指数

回顾月份内食品类指数的上升，在很大程度上反映了这些报价的影响。食品类中其他显示价格上涨的项目包括：葱上涨7.50%，豆油上涨7.26%，鸡上涨5.08%等。

然而，面粉、黄豆芽、萝卜、青菜的价格均出现下跌。在衣着类中，大多数项目价格出现上涨，因为需求超过供应。印花布衫料价格上涨幅度最大，升值15.70%。其次是条纹布衫料，上涨11.46%，第三是棉袜，上涨7.95%。

燃料类的报价普遍下跌。三个显著案例是：柴火下跌10.84%，木炭下跌7.71%，煤球下跌4.21%。不久前，温州禁止出口木炭。在回顾月份的月初，禁令解除；因此价格下降。由于产量增加以及竞争公司之间的竞争，煤球价格也出现下降。

CHINA PRESS

JUN 6 1939

Rice Market

Because of the advent of warm weather,
business in white rice was very slight
yesterday and the price fell by $0.15
below the previous closing rate. Rice
supplies brought here during the day
totaled only three junkloads and 3,000 bags
of white rice, brought by steamer and
rail from Wuhu and the interior.
All dealers are reluctant to buy more
rice for their stocks during the damp
season. With a large amount of stocked
white rice in the market, the rice holders
offered lower liquidation prices, but no
business was done throughout the day's
trading, while the outport traders were
not in the market.
The selling prices of various kinds of
white rice weakened except for low-grade
rice, its price remaining unchanged.
Local traders did some fractional buying
at a reasonable price.
Provincial rice saw active trading in
yesterday's market and a satisfactory
amount was purchased by both local and
outport buyers at a good price.
The interior operators were interested
in second-grade and low-grade Wuhu pro-
vincial rice. The opening price of both
kinds rose yesterday and a considerable
amount was absorbed in the day's business.
The first-grade of Wuhu provincial rice
was ignored by dealers yesterday, and
the price remained unchanged. The day's
sales amounted to 4,000 bags of various
kinds of provincial rice.
The special-grade of Nanking provin-
cial rice was quoted at $14.70, Wuhu pro-
vincial rice was quoted at from $13 to
$14.50 and low-grade at $12.90, or $0.30
above the week-end's closing final rate.

1939年6月6日

米市

由于天气转暖，昨日白米交易非常清淡，价格较前一收盘价下跌0.15美元。当日运抵此处的米供应总量仅为三船载量及3,000袋白米，由轮船和铁路从芜湖及内地运来。

在潮湿季节，所有经销商都不愿再购入大米囤积。由于市场上有大量库存白米，持货商提供较低的清算价格，但全天交易未达成任何业务，且外埠交易商未出现在市场上。

除低级米价格保持不变外，各类白米的售价均走弱。本地交易商以合理价格进行了一些零星购买。

昨日市场上外省米交易活跃，本地和外埠买家均以良好的价格购买了令人满意的数量。

内地经营者对二级和低级芜湖外省米感兴趣。昨日这两种米的开盘价均上涨，并在当日交易中吸纳了相当数量。

昨日经销商无视芜湖一级外省米，价格保持不变。当日各种外省米的销量共计4,000袋。

南京特级外省米报价为14.70美元，芜湖外省米报价在13至14.50美元之间，低级米报价为12.90美元，较周末最终收盘价高出0.30美元。

CHINA PRESS

JUN 6 1939

Flour And Wheat

Trading in native flour was very slight
and narrow in yesterday's market, with
both North China and South Sea buyers
absorbing fractionally. Although demand
was dull, the price was kept steady by
the mills.
With a big amount of flour in stock
and lower foreign wheat prices in N.
China, the Tientsin traders were not in-
terested in further buying for transporta-
tion. As the result, the North China
buyers bought only a few thousand bags
of second-grade product at $4.40, paid
in order cheque.
With business condition turning to fav-
orable in South China, the South Sea
dealers bought more than 30,000 bags of
the second-grade product at market price.
Local operators also bought a considerable
amount for their stocks.
Although the price of foreign flour
fell to $4.85, the opening rate of native
flour remained very steady and firm in
the market yesterday, since no native
flour has been offered for liquidation by
mills in the market during the last few
days.
Trading in native wheat continued very
slight yesterday, with the mills unwilling
to buy stocked native wheat for their
stocks. A group of representatives of
various mills, according to a market re-
port, were sent to the producing centers
in the interior to collect the newly-har-
vested native wheat from the producers at
a cheap price.
The price of stocked native wheat re-
mained very weak in the market yesterday,
and the Kingpeh native wheat was quoted
at $5.60 per bag, or $0.30 below the last
week-end's closing rate, but no mills
showed interest in buying in the market.
Ningpo traders bought few hundred bags.
A few bags of newly-harvested native
wheat appeared in the market yesterday
for liquidation. There were 10 sample
bags of Nanking newly-harvested native
wheat, brought here on Sunday, and
quoted at $6 per bag in cash, and 10
sample bags of Cheng Moo newly-har-
vested native wheat, at $5.45 per bag.
Local operators absorbed all the sample
bags yesterday.

《字林西报》

1939年6月6日

面粉与小麦

昨日市场土粉交易甚为清淡且范围狭窄，华北及南洋买家仅零星吸纳。尽管需求疲软，但各磨坊维持价格稳定。

鉴于库存面粉量大，且华北外麦价格较低，天津商人对进一步购货转运兴趣缺缺。因此，华北买家仅以4.40美元（凭订货支票支付）的价格购入数千包二等品。

随着华南市况转好，南洋商人按市价购入超过30,000包二等品。本地经营者也为库存购入了相当数量。

尽管外粉价格跌至4.85美元，但昨日土粉开盘价在市场仍保持非常平稳坚挺，因为近几日并无磨坊向市场抛售土粉库存。

昨日土麦交易继续极为清淡，各磨坊不愿购入库存土麦以备存货。据市场报告称，由各磨坊代表组成的小组已前往内地产地，以低价从生产者处收购新收获的土麦。

昨日库存土麦价格在市场上依然十分疲软，京北土麦报价为每包5.60美元，较上周末收盘价低0.30美元，但无磨坊表现出入市购买兴趣。宁波商人购入数百包。

昨日市场有少量新收土麦上市抛售。其中有10包样本南京新收土麦，于周日运抵此处，现金报价为每包6美元；另有10包样本崇明（Cheng Moo，音译）新收土麦，报价为每包5.45美元。昨日本地经营者将所有样本包全部吸纳。

《字林西报》
1939年6月4日

米市

昨日早盘白米交易非常疲软，价格下跌。昨日运抵此处的白米供应包括六船载量以及由轮船和铁路从内地运来的2,000包。

交易时段后期，本地商人显示出旺盛需求，白米价格较前一收盘价上涨0.10美元。本地商人以合理价格购入大量一等米，而外地经营者全天未入市交易。

由于需求好转，持货者维持价格稳定。

外省米开盘价非常坚挺，昨日市场成交记录令人满意。大量大米从内地及芜湖运抵此处进行抛售。本地商人零星购入一等芜湖外省米。

尽管持货者在市场上维持较高价位，但外地商人继续吸纳二等外省米用于转运。当日外省米总销量估计为7,000包。芜湖低等级米主导市场。

CHINA PRESS.
JUN 4 1939
Flour And Wheat
Flour trading in yesterday's market was
unsatisfactory, with both North China and
South Sea operators remaining inactive.
There was only fractional purchasing for
transportation.
The North China traders remained un-
interested in buying for stocking. The
South Sea operators also refused to buy
and awaited further improvement.
The opening price of flour fell by
$0.20 below the previous closing rate, and
the second-grade product was quoted at
$4.20, or $4.40 paid in order cheque.
Tientsin traders bought a few thousand
bags of second-grade product for their
stock. Local buyers were not interested
in the market.
Business in native wheat was very
narrow and slight and the price continued
to drop irregularly, as it has done during
the last few weeks. With newly-harvested
wheat expected here in the early part of
next week, dealers were unwilling to stock
up native wheat.
All operators remained very quiet yes-
terday. Only few hundred bags of stock-
ed native wheat were absorbed fractionally
and the price fell to $5.80 per bag.
page_data.zh:
14065
《字林西报》
1939年6月4日
面粉与小麦
昨日市场面粉交易不尽如人意，华北及南洋经营者均保持不活跃状态。仅有零星采购用于转运。

华北商人对于囤货购买仍无兴趣。南洋经营者也拒绝购买，等待进一步改善。

面粉开盘价较前一收盘价下跌0.20美元，二等品报价为4.20美元，或凭订货支票支付4.40美元。

天津商人购入数千包二等品作为库存。本地买家对市场不感兴趣。

土麦业务非常狭窄且清淡，价格持续不规则下跌，正如过去几周的情况一样。由于预计下周初将有新收小麦运抵此处，商人们不愿囤积土麦。

昨日所有经营者均保持非常安静。仅零星吸纳数百包库存土麦，价格跌至每包5.80美元。

CHINA PRESS

JUN 3 1939

Rice Market

Trading in white rice was very narrow
and slight in yesterday's market, and the
price dropped below the previous day's
closing rate. Rice supplies brought here
during the day totaled six junkloads and
3,000 of white rice, brought by steamer
and rail from the interior.
With an oversupply of rice in the
market, the holders are hurrying to sell
their goods before the advent of heat.
All dealers are refusing to buy stocked
rice for transportation.
According to an official report, the
newly-harvested first grade rice would soon
be shipped to the market for liquidation.
First-grade white rice was quoted at
$17.20, or $0.20 below Thursday's final
rate, and the price of other kinds of
white rice remained unchanged.
The outport traders were not in the
market, and local operators absorbed a
small amount of second-grade rice at a
reasonable price.
The provincial rice remained very firm
yesterday, with the selling price kept
steady by the holders. The Hangchow
and Wuchow merchants bought a large
amount of provincial rice yesterday. Local
buyers also absorbed a considerable amount
for their stocks.
Despite the drop in the white rice rate,
the price of provincial rice remained un-
changed and first-grade provincial rice
was quoted at $14.20, while low grade sold
at $12.60. Total sales during the day
reached 5,000 bags by both local and out-
port buyers.
page_data.zh:
14029

《字林西报》

1939年6月3日

米市

昨日市场白米交易非常狭窄且清淡，价格跌至前一日收盘价以下。当日运抵此处的稻米供应总计为六船载量及3,000包白米，由轮船和铁路从内地运来。

由于市场大米供过于求，持货者正急于在酷暑来临前出售货物。所有商人均拒绝购买库存大米用于转运。

据官方报告称，新收获的一等米很快将运至市场抛售。

一等白米报价为17.20美元，较周四最终价低0.20美元，其他种类白米价格保持不变。

外地商人未入市，本地经营者以合理价格吸纳了少量二等米。

昨日外省米保持非常坚挺，持货者维持售价稳定。杭州及梧州商人昨日购入大量外省米。本地买家也为库存吸纳了相当数量。

尽管白米汇率下跌，但外省米价格保持不变，一等外省米报价为14.20美元，而低等级米售价为12.60美元。当日本地及外地买家总销量达到5,000包。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JUN 3 1939
A shipment of 2,000 tons of
Saigon rice is expected to be
brought to Shanghai by the middle
of this month through Messrs.
Louis Dreyfus and Company and
consigned to local Chinese rice
merchants, it was reported yester-
day. The rice is being paid for at
$19.40 per bag, or at $194 per ton,
or around £12,000 for the entire
shipment which has to be paid for
in foreign exchange through Chi-
nese Government banks, the report
stated.

《上海泰晤士报》
1939年6月3日
据报道，一批2,000吨的西贡米预计将于本月中旬由路易斯·德雷福斯公司（Messrs. Louis Dreyfus and Company）运抵上海，并交付给本地中国米商。报告称，该批大米按每包19.40美元计价，即每吨194美元，整批货物约合12,000英镑，需通过中国政府银行以外汇支付。

CHINA PRESS
JUN 3 1939

Flour And Wheat

After a big selling spree on Thursday, the business gradually quietened yesterday and the prices returned to nominal for outport and local dealers. The North China traders dominated the market and bought a considerable amount of second-grade product for transportation.
With a large amount of foreign flour available in the market for liquidation, the mills kept the price steady. There will be no further stocks of native flour for sale in the market till the early part of next week.
The North China operators bought a few thousand bags of second-grade product at $4.20 cash and $4.43 paid by order cheque, and the Tientsin operators absorbed 10,000 bags of fourth-grade product at $4.10. Local dealers were not in the market, awaiting price improvement.
The native wheat business still remained slight in yesterday's market, because the newly-harvested wheat is not expected here until a day or two later. The dealers were not willing to buy stocked native wheat at the market price, while holders of foreign wheat started to liquidate at a lower rate.
No big business was recorded during the day's trading. A few hundred bags of native wheat were shipped directly to the mills at $6 per bag.

《字林西报》
1939年6月3日

面粉与小麦

继周四的大规模抛售后，昨日业务逐渐平静，针对外地及本地商人的价格回归名义水平。华北商人主导市场，并购买了大量二等品用于转运。

鉴于市场有大量外粉可供抛售，各磨坊维持价格稳定。在下周初之前，市场上将不再有土粉库存出售。

华北经营者以现金4.20美元及凭订货支票支付4.43美元的价格购入数千包二等品，天津经营者则以4.10美元的价格吸纳了10,000包四等品。本地商人未入市，等待价格改善。

昨日市场土麦业务仍然清淡，因为新收小麦预计还要过一两天才能运抵此处。商人不愿以市价购买库存土麦，而外麦持货者开始以较低价格抛售。

当日交易未见大宗业务记录。数百包土麦以每包6美元的价格直接装运至各磨坊。

SHANGHAI TIMES.

JUN 3 1939

PURCHASE OF GREEN
TEA DESIRED

Importers Arranging To
Purchase Green Tea
From Chekiang

Preparations are now being made
by local tea merchants to purchase
large quantities of lower quality
green tea from Chekiang areas, as
heavy crops are now available, it
was learnt yesterday.
This variety of lower grade green
tea does not meet the foreign mar-
ket requirements and is destined
for home consumption. Local tea
importers and merchants are now
arranging with their respective
guilds for bona fide certificates
which they may present to the For-
eign Trade Commission of the
Ministry of Finance when import-
ing the tea to Shanghai. Importers
and merchants of tea which are for
the domestic market need not pay
for their purchases in foreign ex-
change, but certificates should be
obtained from the Foreign Trade
Commission before the shipment
will be admitted by the Chinese
Maritime Customs authorities, it
was reported.
